Abstract

Implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for medical imaging via physics-informed unsupervised learning. Classical INRs optimize an entire network from scratch for each subject, leading to inefficient training and suboptimal imaging quality. Recent initialization-based approaches attempt to inject population priors into pre-trained networks, yet they rely on high-quality images and often suffer from catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning. We present DisINR, a novel INR framework that explicitly disentangles shared and subject-specific representations. DisINR introduces a shared encoder-decoder pair and subject-specific encoders, whose features are jointly decoded for image reconstruction. By integrating differentiable forward models, it pre-trains the shared modules directly from limited raw measurements, removing the need for pre-acquired high-quality images. During test-time adaptation, only the subject-specific encoder is optimized, while the shared pair remains frozen, effectively preserving learned priors. Extensive evaluations on three representative medical imaging tasks show that DisINR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art INRs in both reconstruction accuracy and efficiency.

item.title: Beyond Fixed Thresholds and Domain-Specific Benchmarks for Explainable Multi-Task Classification in Autonomous Vehicles
item.author: Maryam Sadat Hosseini Azad, Shahriar Baradaran Shokouhi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种自适应置信度阈值选择方法，并引入了IUST-XAI-AD数据集，旨在提升自动驾驶系统的可解释性和跨文化适应性。

背景: 自动驾驶系统依赖深度学习模型进行场景理解，但这些模型缺乏透明度和安全性，难以建立人类信任。

目的: 为了解决深度学习模型的黑箱问题，实现可解释的自动驾驶感知系统，并设计准确且跨文化的系统。

方法: 引入了全面的置信度阈值敏感性分析，通过评估不同阈值值来识别最优决策边界；同时引入了包含958张图像的IUST-XAI-AD数据集。

主要发现: 传统固定阈值方法在多任务场景中表现不佳；自适应阈值选择方法提高了不同任务的性能；IUST-XAI-AD数据集揭示了跨文化驾驶行为模式。

结论: 该工作提供了方法论进展和实用评估工具，有助于加速开发更可靠、可解释且文化适应性强的自动驾驶系统。

翻译: Scene understanding is a vital part of autonomous driving systems, which requires the use of deep learning models. Deep learning methods are intrinsically black box models, which lack transparency and safety in autonomous driving. To make these systems transparent, multi-task visual understanding has become crucial for explainable autonomous driving perception systems, where simultaneous prediction of multiple driving behaviors and their underlying explanations is essential for safe navigation and human trust in autonomous vehicles. In order to design an accurate and cross-cultural explainable autonomous driving system, we introduce a comprehensive confidence threshold sensitivity analysis that evaluates various threshold values to identify optimal decision boundaries for different tasks. Our analysis demonstrates that traditional fixed threshold approaches are suboptimal for multi-task scenarios. Through extensive evaluation, we demonstrate that our adaptive threshold selection methodology improves F1-scores across different tasks. In addition, we introduce IUST-XAI-AD, a novel dataset consisting of 958 images with human annotations for driving decisions and corresponding reasoning. This dataset addresses the critical gap in domain-specific evaluation benchmarks for distinct driving contexts and provides a more challenging test environment compared to existing datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that confidence threshold sensitivity analysis can significantly improve model performance, while the introduction of the IUST-XAI-AD dataset reveals important insights about cross-cultural driving behavior patterns. The combined contributions of this work provide both methodological advances and practical evaluation tools that can accelerate the development of more reliable, explainable, and culturally-adaptive autonomous driving systems for global deployment.

Abstract

Scene understanding is a vital part of autonomous driving systems, which requires the use of deep learning models. Deep learning methods are intrinsically black box models, which lack transparency and safety in autonomous driving. To make these systems transparent, multi-task visual understanding has become crucial for explainable autonomous driving perception systems, where simultaneous prediction of multiple driving behaviors and their underlying explanations is essential for safe navigation and human trust in autonomous vehicles. In order to design an accurate and cross-cultural explainable autonomous driving system, we introduce a comprehensive confidence threshold sensitivity analysis that evaluates various threshold values to identify optimal decision boundaries for different tasks. Our analysis demonstrates that traditional fixed threshold approaches are suboptimal for multi-task scenarios. Through extensive evaluation, we demonstrate that our adaptive threshold selection methodology improves F1-scores across different tasks. In addition, we introduce IUST-XAI-AD, a novel dataset consisting of 958 images with human annotations for driving decisions and corresponding reasoning. This dataset addresses the critical gap in domain-specific evaluation benchmarks for distinct driving contexts and provides a more challenging test environment compared to existing datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that confidence threshold sensitivity analysis can significantly improve model performance, while the introduction of the IUST-XAI-AD dataset reveals important insights about cross-cultural driving behavior patterns. The combined contributions of this work provide both methodological advances and practical evaluation tools that can accelerate the development of more reliable, explainable, and culturally-adaptive autonomous driving systems for global deployment.

item.title: From Language to Logic: A Theoretical Architecture for VLM-Grounded Safe Navigation
item.author: Kristy Sakano, Kalonji Harrington, Mumu Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种架构，用于将人类提供的规则和偏好集成到非结构化户外环境中的自主机器人导航中。

背景: 非结构化户外环境下的自主机器人导航需要整合人类规则和偏好。

目的: 构建一个架构，将自然语言规则和语义偏好转化为可执行的规范，以指导导航。

方法: 将自然语言规则翻译为信号时序逻辑规范，将持久规则和地形偏好映射到二维成本地图，将动态需求表达为规范，假设使用视觉语言模型进行零样本场景理解，并构建满足规范的导航模型。

主要发现: unknown

结论: 该框架通过将人类指令转化为规范，并利用模型进行场景理解，实现了对导航的指导。

翻译: We propose an architecture for integrating high-level, human-provided safety rules and operator-aligned semantic preferences into autonomous robot navigation in unstructured outdoor environments. In our approach, natural-language rules are translated into Signal Temporal Logic specifications that guide planning and navigation during runtime. Persistent, environment-centric rules and terrain preferences are grounded into a 2D cost map, while temporally dynamic requirements are expressed as STL specifications to be monitored during runtime. We hypothesize the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for zero-shot scene understanding, enabling mapping between human instructions, semantic features, and environmental constraints. Within this framework, we construct an illustrative navigation model that is designed to satisfy a set of STL-encoded specifications and soft operator preferences through formal satisfaction metrics embedded into environmental properties and runtime monitoring.

Abstract

We propose an architecture for integrating high-level, human-provided safety rules and operator-aligned semantic preferences into autonomous robot navigation in unstructured outdoor environments. In our approach, natural-language rules are translated into Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications that guide planning and navigation during runtime. Persistent, environment-centric rules and terrain preferences are grounded into a 2D cost map, while temporally dynamic requirements are expressed as STL specifications to be monitored during runtime. item.title: RemoteZero: Geospatial Reasoning with Zero Human Annotations
item.author: Yao, Liang, Liu, Fan, Xu, Shengxiang, Zhang, Chuanyi, Min, Rui, Di, Shimin, Zheng, Yuhui
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种无需边界框监督的地理空间推理框架 RemoteZero，通过语义验证实现模型的自我进化。

背景: 地理空间推理需要将语义转化为精确位置。虽然推理路径已实现自动化，但模型仍依赖人工标注的地面真值坐标进行监督，这限制了模型在无标注数据上的自我进化能力。

目的: 为了打破这一瓶颈，提出一种无需边界框监督的框架，实现地理空间推理的自主进化。

方法: 利用多模态大语言模型在验证区域是否满足查询方面优于直接生成坐标的能力，用内在语义验证替代几何监督，并支持基于验证信号的迭代自我进化。

主要发现: RemoteZero 在无需边界框监督的情况下，取得了与强监督方法竞争性的性能表现。

结论: 自验证训练在地理空间推理定位中具有巨大潜力。

翻译: 地理空间推理需要模型将复杂的空间语义和用户意图解析为地球观测的精确目标位置。最近的进展解放了推理路径，允许模型生成自己的推理链。然而，仍然存在一个最终依赖：它们仍然由人工标注的地面真值坐标进行监督。这使得推理过程是自主的，但其空间终点不是，并且阻碍了在丰富的无标注遥感数据上进行真正的自我进化。为了打破这一瓶颈，我们介绍了 RemoteZero，这是一个用于地理空间推理的无边界框监督框架。RemoteZero 由一个简单的非对称性驱动：多模态大语言模型通常在验证一个区域是否满足查询方面比直接生成精确坐标更好。利用这种更强的判别能力，RemoteZero 用内在语义验证替代了几何监督，并支持无需边界框注释的强化学习训练。由此产生的框架进一步支持迭代自我进化，允许模型通过自己的验证信号从无标注遥感图像中改进。实验表明，RemoteZero 取得了与强监督方法竞争性的性能，证明了自验证训练在地理空间推理定位中的潜力。

Abstract

Geospatial reasoning requires models to resolve complex spatial semantics and user intent into precise target locations for Earth observation. Recent progress has liberated the reasoning path from manual curation, allowing models to generate their own inference chains. Yet a final dependency remains: they are still supervised by human-annotated ground-truth coordinates. This leaves the reasoning process autonomous, but not its spatial endpoint, and prevents true self-evolution on abundant unlabeled remote sensing data. To break this bottleneck, we introduce RemoteZero, a box-supervision-free framework for geospatial reasoning. RemoteZero is motivated by a simple asymmetry: an MLLM is typically better at verifying whether a region satisfies a query than at directly generating precise coordinates. Leveraging this stronger discriminative ability, RemoteZero replaces geometric supervision with intrinsic semantic verification and enables GRPO training without box annotations. The resulting framework further supports iterative self-evolution, allowing the model to improve from unlabeled remote sensing imagery through its own verification signal. Experiments show that RemoteZero achieves competitive performance against strong supervised methods, demonstrating the potential of self-verifying training for geospatial reasoning localization.

item.title: Ilov3Splat: Instance-Level Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding in Gaussian Splatting
item.author: Binh Long Nguyen, Kien Nguyen, Sridha Sridharan, Clinton Fookes, Peyman Moghadam
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Ilov3Splat 是一种基于 3D 高斯泼溅的实例级开放词汇 3D 场景理解框架。

背景: 现有方法依赖 2D 渲染匹配或点级语义关联，导致跨视图一致性差，缺乏连贯的实例级推理，限制了下游任务精度。

目的: 解决现有方法在跨视图一致性和实例级推理方面的局限性，实现基于自然语言描述的任意对象识别。

方法: 通过向高斯点云添加视图一致的特征场，利用多分辨率哈希嵌入编码语言对齐的 CLIP 特征，并使用对比损失在 SAM 掩码上训练实例特征场。推理时通过 CLIP 匹配和两阶段 3D 聚类检索相关高斯组。

主要发现: 在标准基准测试中，Ilov3Splat 在对象选择和实例分割方面优于先前的开放词汇 3D-GS 方法。

结论: 该框架无需类别监督或手动注释，能够灵活准确地识别 3D 场景中的任意对象，为语言驱动的 3D 场景理解提供了有效解决方案。

翻译: We introduce Ilov3Splat, a novel framework for instance-level open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding built on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS). Most prior work depends on 2D rendering-based matching or point-level semantic association, which undermines cross-view consistency, lacks coherent instance-level reasoning, and limits precision in downstream 3D tasks. To address these limitations, our method jointly optimizes scene geometry and semantic representations by augmenting Gaussian splats with view-consistent feature fields. Specifically, we leverage multi-resolution hash embedding to efficiently encode language-aligned CLIP features, enabling dense and coherent language grounding in 3D space. We further train an instance feature field using contrastive loss over SAM masks, supporting fine-grained object distinction across views. At inference time, CLIP-encoded queries are matched against the learned features, followed by two-stage 3D clustering to retrieve relevant Gaussian groups. This enables our framework to identify arbitrary objects in 3D scenes based on natural language descriptions, without requiring category supervision or manual annotations. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that Ilov3Splat outperforms prior open-vocabulary 3D-GS methods in both object selection and instance segmentation, offering a flexible and accurate solution for language-driven 3D scene understanding. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/Ilov3Splat.

item.title: Velox: Learning Representations of 4D Geometry and Appearance
item.author: Anagh Malik, Dorian Chan, Xiaoming Zhao, David B. Lindell, Oncel Tuzel, Jen-Hao Rick Chang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Velox的框架，用于学习具有描述性、压缩性和易获取性的4D对象潜在表示。

背景: 为了解决4D对象表示在描述性、压缩性和易获取性方面的不足。

目的: 构建一个能够忠实地捕捉对象几何和外观、具有压缩效率且仅需非结构化动态点云即可构建的4D对象潜在表示框架。

方法: Velox通过训练编码器将时空彩色点云压缩为动态形状标记，并利用4D表面解码器和高斯解码器进行监督学习。

主要发现: 在视频到4D生成、3D跟踪以及通过图像到4D生成的布料模拟等三个下游任务中均表现出强劲的性能。

结论: 该框架在所有评估场景中均表现出强大的性能，证明了其表示的实用性。

翻译: 我们介绍了一个用于学习4D对象潜在表示的框架，这些表示具有描述性，忠实地捕捉对象几何和外观；具有压缩性，有助于下游效率；且具有易获取性，只需最少的输入，即非结构化动态点云，即可构建。具体而言，Velox训练一个编码器将时空彩色点云压缩为一组动态形状标记。这些标记使用两个互补的解码器进行监督：一个4D表面解码器，用于建模捕捉几何的时间变化表面分布；以及一个高斯解码器，用于将标记映射到3D高斯，有助于学习外观。为了证明我们表示的效用，我们在三个下游任务上评估了它——视频到4D生成、3D跟踪，以及通过图像到4D生成的布料模拟——并在所有设置中观察到强劲的性能。

Abstract

We introduce a framework for learning latent representations of 4D objects which are descriptive, faithfully capturing object geometry and appearance; compressive, aiding in downstream efficiency; and accessible, requiring minimal input, i.e., an unstructured dynamic point cloud, to construct. Specifically, Velox trains an encoder to compress spatiotemporal color point clouds into a set of dynamic shape tokens. These tokens are supervised using two complementary decoders: a 4D surface decoder, which models the time-varying surface distribution capturing the geometry; and a Gaussian decoder, which maps the tokens to 3D Gaussians, helping learn appearance. To demonstrate the utility of our representation, we evaluate it across three downstream tasks -- video-to-4D generation, 3D tracking, and cloth simulation via image-to-4D generation -- and observe strong performances in all settings.

item.title: Angle-I2P: Angle-Consistent-Aware Hierarchical Attention for Cross-Modality Outlier Rejection
item.author: Muyao Peng, Shun Zou, Pei An, You Yang, Qiong Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Image-to-point-cloud registration (I2P) 是机器人技术中的基础任务。现有深度学习方法表现良好，但在初始匹配对内点比例低时，传统 PnP 方法效果不佳。本文提出 Angle-I2P 方法，通过角度一致几何约束和分层注意力机制解决此问题，并在多个数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

背景: I2P 是机器人操作、抓取和定位等应用中的基础任务。现有的深度学习方法通过在特征空间对齐图像和点云特征来建立对应关系，已取得良好效果。

目的: 解决当初始匹配对的内点比例较低时，传统 Perspective-n-Points (PnP) 方法难以获得准确结果的问题。

方法: 提出了一种名为 Angle-I2P 的离群点拒绝网络。该方法利用基于角度一致性的尺度不变跨模态几何约束来区分内点和离群点，并采用全局到局部的分层注意力机制来过滤刚性变换下的不一致匹配。

主要发现: 在 7Scenes、RGBD Scenes V2 和自收集数据集上实现了最先进的性能，且在所有基准测试中均有持续改进。

结论: 实验结果表明，Angle-I2P 方法有效提升了内点比例和配准召回率，在多个数据集上取得了最佳性能。

翻译: Image-to-point-cloud registration (I2P) is a fundamental task in robotic applications such as manipulation, grasping, and localization. Existing deep learning-based I2P methods seek to align image and point cloud features in a learned representation space to establish correspondences, and have achieved promising results. However, when the inlier ratio of the initial matching pairs is low, conventional Perspective-n-Points (PnP) methods may struggle to achieve accurate results. To address this limitation, we propose Angle-I2P, an outlier rejection network that leverages angle-consistent geometric constraints and hierarchical attention. First, we design a scale-invariant, crossmodality geometric constraint based on angular consistency. This explicit geometric constraint guides the model in distinguishing inliers from outliers. Furthermore, we propose a global-tolocal hierarchical attention mechanism that effectively filters out geometrically inconsistent matches under rigid transformation, thereby improving the Inlier Ratio (IR) and Registration Recall (RR). Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the 7Scenes, RGBD Scenes V2, and a self-collected dataset, with consistent improvements across all benchmarks.

Abstract

Image-to-point-cloud registration (I2P) is a fundamental task in robotic applications such as manipulation,grasping, and localization. Existing deep learning-based I2P methods seek to align image and point cloud features in a learned representation space to establish correspondences, and have achieved promising results. However, when the inlier ratio of the initial matching pairs is low, conventional Perspective-n-Points (PnP) methods may struggle to achieve accurate results. To address this limitation, we propose Angle-I2P, an outlier rejection network that leverages angle-consistent geometric constraints and hierarchical attention. First, we design a scale-invariant, crossmodality geometric constraint based on angular consistency. This explicit geometric constraint guides the model in distinguishing inliers from outliers. Furthermore, we propose a global-tolocal hierarchical attention mechanism that effectively filters out geometrically inconsistent matches under rigid transformation, thereby improving the Inlier Ratio (IR) and Registration Recall (RR). Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the 7Scenes, RGBD Scenes V2, and a self-collected dataset, with consistent improvements across all benchmarks.

item.title: Open-Source Image Editing Models Are Zero-Shot Vision Learners
item.author: Wei Liu, Jiaxin Lin, Rui Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究评估了三个开源图像编辑模型在密集视觉预测任务上的零样本视觉理解能力，发现它们无需微调即可表现出非平凡的视觉理解能力。

背景: 现有研究表明大型生成模型具备零样本视觉能力，但证据多依赖闭源模型或需要微调，开源编辑模型是否具备此能力尚不明确。

目的: 探究公开可用的图像编辑模型是否具备开箱即用的零样本视觉能力，以及这种能力是否是图像编辑预训练的涌现属性。

方法: 选取三个开源图像编辑模型，在单目深度估计、表面法线估计和语义分割任务上进行系统评估，且未进行任何微调。

主要发现: 开源图像编辑模型表现出非平凡的零样本视觉理解能力。具体而言，FireRed在表面法线估计上表现优异，Qwen在语义分割上表现良好，且LongCat和Qwen在深度估计任务上也有不错表现。

结论: 零样本视觉能力可能是图像编辑预训练的涌现属性而非模型特定的产物。研究已公开代码和结果作为可复现基准。

翻译: 近期研究表明，大型生成模型能够解决它们未被明确训练过的视觉任务。然而，现有证据依赖于闭源模型或需要任务特定的指令微调，这留下了疑问：公开可用的图像编辑模型是否具备开箱即用的零样本视觉能力。我们对三个开源图像编辑模型——Qwen-Image-Edit、FireRed-Image-Edit 和 LongCat-Image-Edit——在密集视觉预测任务上进行了系统评估，且未进行任何微调。我们在 NYUv2 和 DIODE 上对单目深度估计进行了基准测试，在 NYUv2 上对表面法线估计进行了基准测试，在 Cityscapes 上对语义分割进行了基准测试，涵盖了几何和语义场景理解。结果表明，开源图像编辑模型表现出非平凡的零样本视觉理解能力。在 NYUv2 表面法线上，FireRed-Image-Edit 达到了 17.69 度的平均角度误差，超过了微调后的 Marigold（20.86 度），并在没有任何任务特定训练的情况下匹配了指令微调的 Vision Banana（17.78 度）。在 NYUv2 深度估计上，LongCat-Image-Edit 在仿射对齐下获得了 0.822 的 delta1，Qwen-Image-Edit 在 DIODE Indoor 上领先（0.868）。在 Cityscapes 语义分割上，Qwen-Image-Edit 在 19 类级别上达到了 25.7 mIoU，在更粗粒度的 7 类级别上达到了 49.5 mIoU。通过比较三个独立训练的编辑器，我们测试零样本视觉能力是否是图像编辑预训练的涌现属性，而不是模型特定的产物。代码、评估脚本和所有结果均已公开发布，以作为未来工作的可复现基准。

Abstract

Recent studies have shown that large generative models can solve vision tasks they were not explicitly trained for. However, existing evidence relies on closed-source models~(Veo~3, Nano Banana Pro) or requires task-specific instruction tuning, leaving open whether publicly available image-editing models possess zero-shot vision abilities out of the box. We conduct a systematic evaluation of three open-source image-editing models -- Qwen-Image-Edit, FireRed-Image-Edit, and LongCat-Image-Edit -- on dense visual prediction tasks \emph{without any fine-tuning}. We benchmark monocular depth estimation on NYUv2 and DIODE, surface normal estimation on NYUv2, and semantic segmentation on Cityscapes, covering both geometric and semantic scene understanding. Results show that open-source image-editing models exhibit non-trivial zero-shot visual understanding. On NYUv2 surface normals, FireRed-Image-Edit achieves a mean angular error of $17.69^\circ$, surpassing the fine-tuned Marigold ($20.86^\circ$) and matching the instruction-tuned Vision Banana ($17.78^\circ$) without any task-specific training. On NYUv2 depth estimation, LongCat-Image-Edit obtains $δ_1{=}0.822$ with affine alignment, and Qwen-Image-Edit leads on DIODE Indoor ($δ_1{=}0.868$). On Cityscapes semantic segmentation, Qwen-Image-Edit reaches 25.7 mIoU at the 19-class level and 49.5 mIoU at a coarser 7-category level. By comparing three independently trained editors, we test whether zero-shot vision ability is an emergent property of image-editing pretraining rather than a model-specific artifact. Code, evaluation scripts, and all results are publicly released to serve as a reproducible baseline for future work.

item.title: HeterSEED: Semantics-Structure Decoupling for Heterogeneous Graph Learning under Heterophily
item.author: Li, Xinyi, Li, Ming, Bai, Lu, Cui, Lixin, Cao, Feilong, Lv, Ke, Jiang, Yunliang, Liò, Pietro
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为HeterSEED的框架，用于解决异构图中的异质性学习问题。

背景: 现实世界中的异构图常表现出显著的异质性，即连接的节点往往具有不同的标签或语义角色。传统的基于特征相似性的异构图神经网络可能会传播误导信息。

目的: 构建一个语义-结构解耦的框架，以准确捕获语义并减少误导性信息的传播。

方法: HeterSEED将表示学习解耦为异构语义通道（捕获类型和关系感知的局部语义）和结构感知的异质性通道（通过伪标签引导分区分离同配和异配邻居，并使用基于元路径的结构权重聚合），最后通过节点级自适应融合机制结合。

主要发现: 理论上证明HeterSEED比依赖特征相似性的标准模型表达能力更强，且能减少由异配邻居引入的预测偏差；实验在五个真实世界数据集上验证了其有效性，特别是在强异配场景下优于现有基线。

结论: HeterSEED在处理异质性异构图时表现优异，能有效提升模型性能。

翻译: 许多现实世界的异构图表现出显著的异质性，其中连接的节点通常具有不同的标签或扮演不同的语义角色。在这种设置下，主要基于特征相似性沿着元路径或元关系聚合消息的标准异构图神经网络可能会传播误导性信息，因为特征相似性可能与底层关系语义不一致。在本文中，我们提出了HeterSEED，这是一个用于异质性下异构图学习的语义-结构解耦框架。HeterSEED将表示学习解耦为异构语义通道，用于捕获类型和关系感知的局部语义，以及结构感知的异质性通道，该通道通过伪标签引导的分区分离同配和异配邻居，并使用基于元路径的结构权重聚合它们。随后，节点级自适应融合机制结合这两个通道以产生上下文相关的节点表示。理论上，我们证明了在异质性下的异构图上，HeterSEED比主要依赖特征相似性的标准异构图神经网络表达能力更强，并证明了能减少由异配邻居引入的预测偏差。在五个真实世界异构图上的实验，包括两个百万节点和一亿边的超大规模网络，表明HeterSEED始终优于代表性的异构图神经网络和最近的异质性感知基线，特别是在强异配情况下。

Abstract

Many real-world heterogeneous graphs exhibit pronounced heterophily, where connected nodes often have dissimilar labels or play different semantic roles. In such settings, standard heterogeneous graph neural networks that aggregate messages along metapaths or meta-relations primarily based on feature similarity can propagate misleading information, since feature similarity may be misaligned with underlying relational semantics. In this paper, we propose HeterSEED, a semantics-structure decoupling framework for heterogeneous graph learning under heterophily. HeterSEED decouples representation learning into a heterogeneous semantic channel that captures type- and relation-aware local semantics and a structure-aware heterophily channel that separates homophilic and heterophilic neighborhoods via pseudo-label-guided partitioning and aggregates them using metapath-based structural weights. A node-level adaptive fusion mechanism then combines the two channels to produce context-dependent node representations. Theoretically, we establish that, on heterogeneous graphs under heterophily, HeterSEED is strictly more expressive than standard heterogeneous graph neural networks that rely primarily on feature similarity and provably reduces the prediction bias introduced by heterophilic neighbors. Experiments on five real-world heterogeneous graphs, including two large-scale networks at the million-node and hundred-million-edge scale, demonstrate that HeterSEED consistently outperforms representative heterogeneous graph neural networks and recent heterophily-aware baselines, especially in strongly heterophilic regimes.

item.title: ReflectDrive-2: Reinforcement-Learning-Aligned Self-Editing for Discrete Diffusion Driving
item.author: Wang, Huimin, Wang, Yue, Cui, Bihao, Li, Pengxiang, Lu, Ben, Wang, Mingqian, Wang, Tong, Tang, Chuan, Zhang, Teng, Zhan, Kun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ReflectDrive-2 是一种用于自动驾驶的掩码离散扩散规划器，它将计划表示为离散轨迹标记，通过并行掩码解码生成，并支持原地轨迹修订。

背景: 现有的自动驾驶规划方法在轨迹生成和修正方面存在局限性，需要一种能够高效进行原地修订的规划器。

目的: 提出一种能够通过同一模型进行原地轨迹修订的规划方法，以提升自动驾驶决策质量。

方法: 使用掩码离散扩散规划器，将计划表示为离散轨迹标记。引入 AutoEdit 功能，利用同一模型重写选定标记，无需辅助网络。采用两阶段训练：第一阶段使用结构感知扰动监督恢复专家轨迹；第二阶段使用强化学习微调完整决策-草稿-反思流程。设计高效的反思解码堆栈，结合共享前缀 KV 重用、交替步解码和融合设备端去掩码。

主要发现: 完整的流程 RL 对于耦合草稿和编辑至关重要。仅监督训练时，AutoEdit 提升效果有限，最多提升 0.3。引入 RL 后，AutoEdit 的增益提升至 1.9。在 NAVSIM 数据集上，仅使用摄像头输入达到 91.0 PDMS，最佳设置下达到 94.8 PDMS。平均延迟为 31.8 毫秒。

结论: ReflectDrive-2 通过结合强化学习和高效解码堆栈，显著提升了自动驾驶规划的性能和效率。

翻译: 我们介绍了 ReflectDrive-2，这是一种用于自动驾驶的掩码离散扩散规划器，具有独立的动作专家，它将计划表示为离散轨迹标记，并通过并行掩码解码生成。这种离散标记空间支持原地轨迹修订：AutoEdit 使用同一模型重写选定的标记，而无需辅助细化网络。为了训练这一能力，我们使用了两阶段程序。首先，我们沿着纵向进度和横向航向方向构建专家轨迹的结构感知扰动，并监督模型恢复原始专家轨迹。然后，我们使用强化学习微调完整的决策-草稿-反思流程，将终端驾驶奖励分配给最终的后编辑轨迹，并通过完整流程转换传播策略梯度信用。完整的流程 RL 证明对于耦合草稿和编辑至关重要：在仅监督训练的情况下，推理时的 AutoEdit 最多将 PDMS 提高了 0.3，而 RL 将其增益提高到 1.9。我们还为决策-草稿-反思流程共同设计了一个高效的反思解码堆栈，结合共享前缀 KV 重用、交替步解码和融合的设备端去掩码。在 NAVSIM 上，ReflectDrive-2 使用仅摄像头输入实现了 91.0 PDMS，在最佳设置下实现了 94.8 PDMS，同时在 NVIDIA Thor 上以 31.8 毫秒的平均延迟运行。

Abstract

We introduce ReflectDrive-2, a masked discrete diffusion planner with separate action expert for autonomous driving that represents plans as discrete trajectory tokens and generates them through parallel masked decoding. This discrete token space enables in-place trajectory revision: AutoEdit rewrites selected tokens using the same model, without requiring an auxiliary refinement network. To train this capability, we use a two-stage procedure. First, we construct structure-aware perturbations of expert trajectories along longitudinal progress and lateral heading directions and supervise the model to recover the original expert trajectory. We then fine-tune the full decision--draft--reflect rollout with reinforcement learning (RL), assigning terminal driving reward to the final post-edit trajectory and propagating policy-gradient credit through full-rollout transitions. Full-rollout RL proves crucial for coupling drafting and editing: under supervised training alone, inference-time AutoEdit improves PDMS by at most $0.3$, whereas RL increases its gain to $1.9$. We also co-design an efficient reflective decoding stack for the decision--draft--reflect pipeline, combining shared-prefix KV reuse, Alternating Step Decode, and fused on-device unmasking. On NAVSIM, ReflectDrive-2 achieves $91.0$ PDMS with camera-only input and $94.8$ PDMS in a best-of-6 oracle setting, while running at $31.8$ ms average latency on NVIDIA Thor.

item.title: Multi-Level Bidirectional Biomimetic Learning for EEG-Based Visual Decoding
item.author: Jingtao Liu, Peiliang Gong, Chuhang Zheng, Yiheng Liu, Qi Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 MB2L 的多级双向仿生学习框架，用于解决 EEG 与视觉刺激之间的跨模态对齐问题。

背景: EEG 视觉神经解码旨在对齐神经响应与视觉刺激，但受限于配对数据不足，且数字图像与生物视觉感知之间存在根本性不匹配（受视网膜映射和个体神经解剖结构影响）。

目的: 解决跨模态对齐问题，提高 EEG 到图像检索的准确率。

方法: 提出了 MB2L 框架，包含带有视觉先验的自适应模糊（根据视网膜先验重新加权视觉输入）、仿生视觉特征提取（学习与皮层分层处理一致的多级视觉表征），以及多级双向对比学习（在共享语义空间中对齐 EEG 和视觉特征）。

主要发现: 在零样本 EEG 到图像检索任务上，Top-1 准确率达到 80.5%，Top-5 准确率达到 97.6%，显著优于 prior 方法，且在跨被试和实验设置中表现出强大的泛化能力。

结论: MB2L 方法有效解决了感知结构不匹配问题，显著提升了神经解码的性能。

翻译: 基于脑电的视觉神经解码旨在对齐神经响应与视觉刺激，以进行图像检索等任务。然而，有限的配对数据以及高保真数字图像与生物视觉感知之间的根本性不匹配——由于视网膜映射和个体特定的神经解剖结构而扭曲——严重阻碍了跨模态对齐。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 MB2L，一种多级双向仿生学习框架，将结构化的生理归纳偏置纳入表征学习。具体而言，我们提出了带有视觉先验的自适应模糊，通过根据视网膜先验重新加权视觉输入来减轻感知结构不匹配。我们进一步提出了仿生视觉特征提取，以学习与皮层分层处理一致的多级视觉表征，增强被试不变的编码。这些模块通过多级双向对比学习进行联合优化，通过双向对比目标在共享语义空间中对齐 EEG 和视觉特征。实验表明，MB2L 在零样本 EEG 到图像检索上实现了 80.5% 的 Top-1 和 97.6% 的 Top-5 准确率，显著优于 prior 方法，并展示了在跨被试和实验设置中的强大泛化能力。

Abstract

EEG-based visual neural decoding aims to align neural responses with visual stimuli for tasks such as image retrieval. However, limited paired data and a fundamental mismatch between high-fidelity digital images and biological visual perception - distorted by retinotopic mapping and subject-specific neuroanatomy - severely impede cross-modal alignment. To address this, we propose MB2L, a Multi-Level Bidirectional Biomimetic Learning framework that incorporates structured physiological inductive biases into representation learning. Specifically, we propose Adaptive Blur with Visual Priors to mitigate perceptual-structural mismatch by reweighting visual inputs according to retinotopic priors. We further propose Biomimetic Visual Feature Extraction to learn multi-level visual representations consistent with hierarchical cortical processing, enhancing subject-invariant encoding. These modules are jointly optimized via Multi-level Bidirectional Contrastive Learning, which aligns EEG and visual features in a shared semantic space through bidirectional contrastive objectives. Experiments show MB2L achieves 80.5% Top-1 and 97.6% Top-5 accuracy on zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval, significantly outperforming prior methods and demonstrating strong generalization across subjects and experimental settings.

item.title: Vol-Mark: A Watermark for 3D Medical Volume Data Via Cubic Difference Expansion and Contrastive Learning
item.author: Jiangnan Zhu, Yuntao Wang, Shengli Pan, Yujie Gu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Vol-Mark 的可逆零水印方法，用于保护医学3D数据的所有权和真实性。

背景: 医学技术广泛使用3D体积数据进行诊断，但在远程医疗网络共享时存在数据篡改和未经授权复制的安全风险。

目的: 解决远程医疗中数据共享的安全问题，保护医学体积数据的所有权和真实性。

方法: 1. 利用对比学习提取特征的特征提取器。2. 引入立方体差分扩展技术，利用3D整数小波变换嵌入水印。3. 使用多数投票机制增强可靠性。4. 通过假设检验进行所有权验证。

主要发现: 该方法在常规、几何和混合攻击下表现出色，在大多数攻击场景下ACC超过0.90，显著优于现有方法。

结论: Vol-Mark 方法能有效验证数据完整性和所有权，在保持低失真和诊断准确性的同时，具备优异的鲁棒性。

翻译: Today, advances in medical technology extensively utilize 3D volume data for accurate and efficient diagnostics. However, sharing these data across networks in telemedicine poses significant security risks of data tampering and unauthorized copying. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel reversible-zero watermarking approach, termed Vol-Mark, for medical volume data to protect their ownership and authenticity in telemedicine. The proposed Vol-Mark method offers two key benefits: 1) it designs a volume data feature extractor that leverages contrastive learning to efficiently extract discriminative and stable volumetric features, ensuring robustness against 3D attacks; 2) it introduces the cubic difference expansion (c-DE) technique, which leverages the 3D integer wavelet transform to embed watermark bits into neighboring voxels within cubes at low-frequency coefficients. The voxel differences within each cube are expanded to create embedding space, and a majority voting mechanism is employed during extraction to enhance reliability. The embedding process incurs low distortion and supports lossless removal, thereby preserving the integrity and diagnostic accuracy of medical volume data. Through these two benefits, Vol-Mark enables both integrity verification and ownership verification. Integrity verification is first performed, and ownership verification through hypothesis testing is further conducted to enhance reliability, particularly under data tampering or watermark removal attacks. Comprehensive experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed method and its superior robustness against conventional, geometric, and hybrid attacks on medical volume data. In particular, through multiple tasks evaluations, Vol-Mark consistently achieves an ACC above 0.90 in most attack scenarios, outperforming existing methods by a clear margin.

Abstract

Today, advances in medical technology extensively utilize 3D volume data for accurate and efficient diagnostics. However, sharing these data across networks in telemedicine poses significant security risks of data tampering and unauthorized copying. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel reversible-zero watermarking approach, termed Vol-Mark, for medical volume data to protect their ownership and authenticity in telemedicine. The proposed Vol-Mark method offers two key benefits: 1) it designs a volume data feature extractor that leverages contrastive learning to efficiently extract discriminative and stable volumetric features, ensuring robustness against 3D attacks; 2) it introduces the cubic difference expansion (c-DE) technique, which leverages the 3D integer wavelet transform to embed watermark bits into neighboring voxels within cubes at low-frequency coefficients. The voxel differences within each cube are expanded to create embedding space, and a majority voting mechanism is employed during extraction to enhance reliability. The embedding process incurs low distortion and supports lossless removal, thereby preserving the integrity and diagnostic accuracy of medical volume data. Through these two benefits, Vol-Mark enables both integrity verification and ownership verification. Integrity verification is first performed, and ownership verification through hypothesis testing is further conducted to enhance reliability, particularly under data tampering or watermark removal attacks. Comprehensive experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed method and its superior robustness against conventional, geometric, and hybrid attacks on medical volume data. In particular, through multiple tasks evaluations, Vol-Mark consistently achieves an ACC above 0.90 in most attack scenarios, outperforming existing methods by a clear margin.

item.title: Spatial-Magnifier: Spatial upsampling for multichannel speech enhancement
item.author: Lee, Dongheon, Pandey, Ashutosh, Parekh, Sanjeel, Wong, Daniel, Donley, Jacob, Xu, Buye, Azcarreta, Juan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Spatial-Magnifier 的神经网络和 SARL 框架，用于从少量真实麦克风信号生成虚拟麦克风信号以提升语音增强效果。

背景: 多麦克风语音增强算法的空间指向性随麦克风数量增加而提高，但将大型阵列放入边缘设备受物理限制。

目的: 克服边缘设备中麦克风数量受限的物理限制，提高语音提取性能。

方法: 提出神经网络 Spatial-Magnifier，从有限的真麦克风测量值生成虚拟麦克风信号；引入 SARL 框架，利用估计的虚拟麦克风信号和特征来调节下游语音增强系统。

主要发现: 该框架在各种语音提取系统（包括端到端多通道语音增强和神经波束成形）中优于现有的空间上采样基线；该方法几乎恢复了所有麦克风都可用时的预言机性能。

结论: 该方法在边缘设备上有效，能够通过虚拟麦克风信号接近全阵列的性能。

翻译: 虽然多麦克风语音增强算法的空间指向性随麦克风数量增加而提高，但在现实世界的边缘设备中，将大型拾音阵列放入受到物理限制。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了 Spatial-Magnifier，这是一种神经网络，旨在从有限的真麦克风测量值中生成虚拟麦克风信号。此外，我们引入了空间音频表示学习框架，利用估计的虚拟麦克风信号和特征来调节下游语音增强系统。实验结果表明，所提出的框架在各种语音提取系统（包括端到端多通道语音增强和神经波束成形）中优于现有的空间上采样基线。所提出的方法几乎恢复了所有麦克风都可用时的预言机性能。

Abstract

While the spatial directivity of multichannel speech enhancement algorithms improves with the number of microphones, fitting large capture arrays into real-world edge devices is typically limited by physical constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose Spatial-Magnifier, a neural network designed to generate virtual microphone (VM) signals from a limited set of real microphone (RM) measurements. Moreover, we introduce the Spatial Audio Representation Learning (SARL) framework, which leverages estimated VM signals and features to condition a downstream speech enhancement system. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms existing spatial upsampling baselines across various speech extraction systems, including end-to-end multichannel speech enhancement and neural beamforming. The proposed method nearly recovers the oracle performance achieved when all microphones are available.

item.title: OpenWatch: A Multimodal Benchmark for Hand Gesture Recognition on Smartwatches
item.author: Bonazzi, Pietro, Ahmed, Youssef, Eckert, Daniel, Ronco, Andrea, Zeng, Junjie, Dai, Dengxin, Magno, Michele
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了首个用于腕部手势识别的开放访问多模态基准 OpenWatch，包含超过 50 名参与者的 IMU 和 PPG 数据，并提出了 MixToken 和 NormWear-Lora 两种新方法。

背景: 尽管智能手表在全球范围内被广泛采用，但用于腕部手势识别的开放基准仍然非常有限。

目的: 介绍 OpenWatch 基准，提出独立于受试者的评估协议，并开发两种新的手势识别方法。

方法: 使用同步的惯性测量单元和光电容积描记法进行多模态数据采集；提出 MixToken 方法融合 IMU 特征；提出 NormWear-Lora 模块用于智能手表基础模型；包含传统和深度学习方法进行时间序列分类。

主要发现: PPG 信号为智能手表基础模型提供了显著的预测益处；特定任务架构在准确性和内存效率方面显著优于微调的基础模型。

结论: 为资源受限的可穿戴传感提供了关于架构设计、模态融合、数据增强和基础模型适应之间权衡的明确经验指导。

翻译: 尽管智能手表在全球范围内被广泛采用，但用于腕部手势识别的开放基准仍然非常有限。本文介绍了首个用于腕部手势识别的开放访问多模态基准 OpenWatch，该基准使用商业智能手表上的同步惯性测量单元和光电容积描记法。它包含超过 50 名参与者 10 小时的 IMU 和 PPG 数据，以及 59 个标记的手势序列。此外，本文提出了一个独立于受试者的评估协议，包括用于时间序列分类的传统和深度学习方法。在此基础上，开发了两种新的手势识别方法：MixToken 和 NormWear-Lora。基准测试结果表明，PPG 信号为智能手表基础模型提供了显著的预测益处。此外，特定任务架构在准确性和内存效率方面显著优于微调的智能手表基础模型。最后，还为资源受限的可穿戴传感提供了关于专用架构设计、模态融合、数据增强和基础模型适应之间权衡的明确经验指导。

Abstract

Despite widespread adoption of smartwatches worldwide, open-benchmarks for wrist-based gesture recognition remain surprisingly limited. In this work, we introduce the first open-access multi-modal benchmark, OpenWatch, for wrist-based gesture recognition using synchronized inertial and physiological sensing on a commercial smartwatch. It contains over 10 hours of Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and Photoplethysmography (PPG) data across 50 participants and a vocabulary of 59 labelled gesture sequences. Furthermore, we present a subject-independent evaluation protocol including traditional and deep learning methods for time-series classification. On top of this, we develop two novel methodologies for hand-gesture recognition: (i) MixToken, a task-specific mixture-of-experts that fuses per-channel IMU filterbank features with cross-channel statistical tokens through learned logit mixing, and (ii) NormWear-Lora, a low-rank adaptation module for smartwatch foundation models. Our benchmarking results reveal that PPG signals carries a substantial predictive benefit (+12.5% F1-score) for foundational smartwatch models. In addition, we show that task-specific architectures (i.e. MixToken) substantially outperforms finetuned smartwatch foundation models in terms of accuracy (F1-score=90% vs 66%) and memory efficiency (223k vs 136M parameters). Finally, we also provide clear empirical guidance on the trade-offs between specialized architecture design, modality fusion, data augmentations, and foundation-model adaptation for resource-constrained wearable sensing.

item.title: Dr-PoGO: Direct Radar Pose-Graph Optimization
item.author: Cedric Le Gentil, Weican Li, Leonardo Brizi, Timothy D. Barfoot
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种使用二维旋转雷达的SLAM方法Dr-PoGO，该方法利用直接配准技术进行里程计和回环检测。

背景: 相比相机或激光雷达，毫米波雷达不受视线限制，能够穿透灰尘、雨雪等天气条件，提供鲁棒的感知能力。

目的: 为了解决现有雷达SLAM方法通常依赖点云或特征提取进行自运动估计的问题，提出一种基于直接配准技术的SLAM方法。

方法: Dr-PoGO利用直接配准技术进行里程计和回环配准。利用RaPlace算法提供回环候选，通过结合视觉特征和描述符进行粗到精的配准以获得初始变换，最后通过位姿图优化得到全局轨迹。

主要发现: Dr-PoGO在各种真实汽车环境中，在超过300公里的数据集上表现出了最先进的性能。

结论: Dr-PoGO在真实场景中表现优异，且其实现代码已公开发布。

翻译: 本文介绍了Dr-PoGO，一种使用二维旋转雷达的SLAM方法。与需要视线的相机或激光雷达不同，毫米波雷达可以“看”穿灰尘、下雪、下雨等。因此，无论天气条件如何，它都是一种鲁棒感知的极佳模态。虽然现有的基于雷达的SLAM方法通常依赖点云或特征的提取来进行自运动估计，但Dr-PoGO利用直接配准技术进行里程计和回环配准。一个现成的雷达聚焦的场所识别算法RaPlace提供回环候选。由于RaPlace不提供相对变换，Dr-PoGO引入了一种粗到精的配准，使用视觉特征和描述符来获得直接变换精炼的初始猜测。全局轨迹在位姿图优化中进行优化。Dr-PoGO在各种真实汽车环境中超过300公里的数据上展示了最先进的性能。我们的实现是公开可用的：https://github.com/utiasASRL/dr_pogo。

深度解读

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

This paper introduces Dr-PoGO, a method for Simultaneous Localization And Mapping (SLAM) using a 2D spinning radar. Unlike cameras or lidars that require line-of-sight, millimetre-wave radars can `see' through dust, falling snow, rain, etc. Accordingly, it is a great modality for robust perception regardless of the weather conditions. While most existing radar-based SLAM methods rely on the extraction of point clouds or features to perform ego-motion estimation, Dr-PoGO leverages direct registration techniques for odometry (DRO) and loop-closure registration. An off-the-shelf radar-focused place recognition algorithm, RaPlace, provides loop-closure candidates. As RaPlace does not provide relative transformations, Dr-PoGO introduces a coarse-to-fine registration that uses visual features and descriptors to obtain an initial guess for the direct transformation refinement. The global trajectory is optimized in a pose-graph optimization. Dr-PoGO demonstrates state-of-the-art performance over 300km of data in various real-world automotive environments. Our implementation is publicly available: https://github.com/utiasASRL/dr_pogo.

item.title: DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap): A Controllable and Interactive Red-Teaming Platform for AI Agents
item.author: Chen, Zhaorun, Liu, Xun, Tong, Haibo, Guo, Chengquan, Nie, Yuzhou, Zhang, Jiawei, Kang, Mintong, Xu, Chejian, Liu, Qichang, Liu, Xiaogeng, Shi, Tianneng, Xiao, Chaowei, Koyejo, Sanmi, Liang, Percy, Guo, Wenbo, Song, Dawn, Li, Bo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AI agents 在自动化复杂任务时面临严重的安全风险，本文提出了 DTap 平台和 DTap-Red 代理，用于评估 AI agent 的安全性。

背景: AI agents 执行高风险任务，易受攻击者操纵造成危害。评估 agent 安全性面临动态环境的挑战，缺乏可控且可复现的评估环境。

目的: 构建可控且交互式的红队测试平台，以解决大规模风险评估环境缺失的问题。

方法: 引入 DTap 平台（覆盖14个域和50+模拟环境），提出 DTap-Red 自主红队代理（探索注入向量），并构建 DTap-Bench 数据集。

主要发现: 通过大规模评估揭示了系统性的漏洞模式。

结论: 为开发安全的下一代 AI agent 提供了见解。

翻译: AI agents are increasingly deployed across diverse domains to automate complex workflows through long-horizon and high-stakes action executions. Due to their high capability and flexibility, such agents raise significant security and safety concerns. A growing number of real-world incidents have shown that adversaries can easily manipulate agents into performing harmful actions, such as leaking API keys, deleting user data, or initiating unauthorized transactions. Evaluating agent security is inherently challenging, as agents operate in dynamic, untrusted environments involving external tools, heterogeneous data sources, and frequent user interactions. However, realistic, controllable, and reproducible environments for large-scale risk assessment remain largely underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce the DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap), the first controllable and interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents, spanning 14 real-world domains and over 50 simulation environments that replicate widely used systems such as Google Workspace, Paypal, and Slack. To scale the risk assessment of agents in DTap, we further propose DTap-Red, the first autonomous red-teaming agent that systematically explores diverse injection vectors (e.g., prompt, tool, skill, environment, combinations) and autonomously discovers effective attack strategies tailored to varying malicious goals. Using DTap-Red, we curate DTap-Bench, a large-scale red-teaming dataset comprising high-quality instances across domains, each paired with a verifiable judge to automatically validate attack outcomes. Through DTap, we conduct large-scale evaluations of popular AI agents built on various backbone models, spanning security policies, risk categories, and attack strategies, revealing systematic vulnerability patterns and providing valuable insights for developing secure next-generation agents.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决 AI 智能体缺乏有效安全测试和可靠性验证的问题。它提出了一个名为 DTap 的可控交互式红队测试平台。这个问题在现实中非常重要，因为随着 AI 智能体应用越来越广泛，确保它们的安全性和可靠性是防止潜在风险的关键。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了一个名为DTap的可控且交互式红队测试平台，用于评估AI Agent的安全性。

Abstract

AI agents are increasingly deployed across diverse domains to automate complex workflows through long-horizon and high-stakes action executions. Due to their high capability and flexibility, such agents raise significant security and safety concerns. A growing number of real-world incidents have shown that adversaries can easily manipulate agents into performing harmful actions, such as leaking API keys, deleting user data, or initiating unauthorized transactions. Evaluating agent security is inherently challenging, as agents operate in dynamic, untrusted environments involving external tools, heterogeneous data sources, and frequent user interactions. However, realistic, controllable, and reproducible environments for large-scale risk assessment remain largely underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce the DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap), the first controllable and interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents, spanning 14 real-world domains and over 50 simulation environments that replicate widely used systems such as Google Workspace, Paypal, and Slack. To scale the risk assessment of agents in DTap, we further propose DTap-Red, the first autonomous red-teaming agent that systematically explores diverse injection vectors (e.g., prompt, tool, skill, environment, combinations) and autonomously discovers effective attack strategies tailored to varying malicious goals. Using DTap-Red, we curate DTap-Bench, a large-scale red-teaming dataset comprising high-quality instances across domains, each paired with a verifiable judge to automatically validate attack outcomes. Through DTap, we conduct large-scale evaluations of popular AI agents built on various backbone models, spanning security policies, risk categories, and attack strategies, revealing systematic vulnerability patterns and providing valuable insights for developing secure next-generation agents.

item.title: Replay-Based Continual Learning for Physics-Informed Neural Operators
item.author: Yizheng Wang, Mohammad Sadegh Eshaghi, Xiaoying Zhuang, Timon Rabczuk, Yinghua Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 神经算子在分布内问题中表现良好，但在分布外数据上性能下降。本文提出了一种基于持续学习的物理信息神经算子方法。

背景: 现有神经算子方法在遇到分布外数据时性能显著下降。

目的: 解决神经算子在处理分布外数据时的性能退化问题，引入持续学习机制。

方法: 提出一种基于重放和蒸馏的持续学习策略，结合迁移学习 LoRA。该方法完全基于物理信息，无需标签数据，仅利用输入场和物理约束进行训练，特别针对基于 Transolver 架构的神经算子。

主要发现: 该方法在流体力学（达西流）、生物力学（二维超弹性脑肿瘤）和固体力学（三维线性弹性 TPMS）三个物理问题上进行了验证。结果表明该方法能有效缓解灾难性遗忘，同时保持对新数据的快速适应能力。

结论: 与传统联合训练策略相比，该方法显著提高了训练效率，同时减少了额外的内存使用和计算成本。

翻译: 神经算子在分布内问题中通常表现出强大的预测性能。然而，现有方法的一个关键局限性在于它们在遇到分布外数据时性能显著下降。为了解决这个问题，这项工作将持续学习引入物理信息神经算子，特别关注基于 Transolver 架构的神经算子，并提出了一种简单而有效的基于重放的持续学习策略。所提出的方法是完全物理信息且不需要标记数据的，仅依靠输入场和物理约束进行训练。当新的分布外数据可用时，通过基于蒸馏的约束将少量过去数据纳入，以保留先前获得的知识并减轻灾难性遗忘。同时，采用迁移学习 LoRA 来实现对新数据的快速适应。该框架在三个代表性物理问题上进行了系统验证，包括流体力学中的达西流问题、生物力学中的二维超弹性脑肿瘤问题以及固体力学中的三维线性弹性 TPMS 问题。结果表明，所提出的方法有效地减轻了先前学习数据上的灾难性遗忘，同时保持对新数据的快速适应能力。与传统联合训练策略相比，所提出的方法显著提高了训练效率，同时减少了额外的内存使用和计算成本。

Abstract

Neural operators generally demonstrate strong predictive performance on in-distribution (ID) problems. However, a critical limitation of existing methods is their significant performance degradation when encountering out-of-distribution (OOD) data. To address this issue, this work introduces continual learning into physics-informed neural operators, with particular emphasis on neural operators built upon the Transolver architecture, and proposes a simple yet effective replay-based continual learning strategy. The proposed method is fully physics-informed and does not require labeled data, relying solely on input fields together with physical constraints for training. When new OOD data become available, a small number of past data are incorporated through a distillation-based constraint to preserve previously acquired knowledge and alleviate catastrophic forgetting. Meanwhile, a transfer learning LoRA is employed to enable rapid adaptation to the new data. The proposed framework is systematically validated on three representative physical problems, including the Darcy flow problem in fluid mechanics, a two-dimensional hyperelastic brain tumor problem in biomechanics, and a three-dimensional linear elastic Triply Periodic Minimal Surfaces problem in solid mechanics. The results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting on previously learned data while maintaining fast adaptability to new data. Compared with conventional joint training strategies, the proposed method significantly improves training efficiency while reducing additional memory usage and computational cost.

item.title: Bridging Input Feature Spaces Towards Graph Foundation Models
item.author: Eliasof, Moshe, Mantri, Krishna Sri Ipsit, Bevilacqua, Beatrice, Ribeiro, Bruno, Schönlieb, Carola-Bibiane
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 ALL-IN 的方法，旨在解决图学习在不同数据集间输入特征不一致的问题，实现跨数据集的迁移能力。

背景: 与视觉和语言领域不同，图学习缺乏共享的输入空间。不同图数据集的输入特征在语义、数值范围和维度上存在差异。这种不匹配阻碍了图模型在不同数据集间的泛化，限制了其作为基础模型的应用。

目的: 提出一种简单且具有理论依据的方法，使图模型能够在具有不同输入特征的数据集之间实现迁移学习。

方法: 将节点特征投影到一个共享的随机空间，并通过基于协方差的统计量构建表示，从而消除对原始特征空间的依赖。该方法计算节点协方差算子和节点表示，并证明了它们对输入特征的排列和正交变换具有不变性。

主要发现: 理论上，计算得到的节点协方差算子和节点表示在分布上对输入特征的排列具有不变性，且期望算子对输入特征的一般正交变换具有不变性。实验上，ALL-IN 在未见过的具有新输入特征的数据集上的节点级和图级任务中表现出色，无需更改架构或重新训练。

结论: 该研究为输入无关且可迁移的图模型指明了一个有前景的方向。

翻译: 与视觉和语言领域不同，图学习缺乏共享的输入空间，因为输入特征不仅在语义上，而且在数值范围和维度上因图数据集而异。这种错位阻碍了图模型在不同数据集间泛化，限制了其作为基础模型的使用。在这项工作中，我们提出了 ALL-IN，这是一种简单且具有理论依据的方法，能够使具有不同输入特征的数据集之间实现迁移。我们的方法将节点特征投影到一个共享的随机空间，并通过基于协方差的统计量构建表示，从而消除对原始特征空间的依赖。我们表明，计算得到的节点协方差算子和由此产生的节点表示在分布上对输入特征的排列具有不变性。我们进一步证明，期望算子对输入特征的一般正交变换表现出不变性。实验上，ALL-IN 在未见过的具有新输入特征的数据集上的各种节点级和图级任务中实现了强大的性能，而无需更改架构或重新训练。这些结果指向了输入无关、可迁移的图模型的一个有前景的方向。

Abstract

Unlike vision and language domains, graph learning lacks a shared input space, as input features differ across graph datasets not only in semantics, but also in value ranges and dimensionality. This misalignment prevents graph models from generalizing across datasets, limiting their use as foundation models. In this work, we propose ALL-IN, a simple and theoretically grounded method that enables transferability across datasets with different input features. Our approach projects node features into a shared random space and constructs representations via covariance-based statistics, thus eliminating dependence on the original feature space. We show that the computed node-covariance operators and the resulting node representations are invariant in distribution to permutations of the input features. We further demonstrate that the expected operator exhibits invariance to general orthogonal transformations of the input features. Empirically, ALL-IN achieves strong performance across diverse node- and graph-level tasks on unseen datasets with new input features, without requiring architecture changes or retraining. These results point to a promising direction for input-agnostic, transferable graph models.

item.title: A Foundation Model for Zero-Shot Logical Rule Induction
item.author: Phua, Yin Jun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: NRI 是一种用于零样本规则归纳的预训练模型，通过统计属性表示逻辑子句，无需重新训练即可泛化。

背景: 现有的归纳逻辑编程方法具有归纳性，其参数绑定到特定谓词，每次新任务都需要重新训练。

目的: 引入 NRI，实现零样本规则归纳，并构建符号推理的基础模型。

方法: 使用统计编码器，将子句表示为类条件率、熵和共现等统计属性；采用并行解码器保持逻辑析取的排列不变性；使用积 T-范数松弛使规则执行可微分。

主要发现: 在规则恢复、对标签噪声和虚假相关性的鲁棒性以及零样本迁移到现实世界基准测试方面进行了评估。

结论: 该工作开启了符号推理基础模型的可能性。

翻译: 归纳逻辑编程从数据中学习可解释的逻辑规则。现有方法具有归纳性：其学习到的参数绑定到特定谓词，并且对于每个新任务都需要重新训练。我们介绍了神经规则诱导器 NRI，这是一种用于零样本规则归纳的预训练模型。与其编码子句身份，NRI 使用类条件率、熵和共现等域无关的统计属性来表示子句，这些属性在变量身份和计数之间泛化，而无需重新训练。该模型由统计编码器和并行槽解码器组成。并行解码保留了逻辑析取的排列不变性；自回归解码器则会施加任意的子句顺序。积 T-范数松弛使规则执行可微分，允许仅基于预测准确度进行端到端训练。我们在规则恢复、对标签噪声和虚假相关性的鲁棒性以及零样本迁移到现实世界基准测试方面评估了 NRI，我们认为这项工作开启了符号推理基础模型的可能性。

Abstract

Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) learns interpretable logical rules from data. Existing methods are transductive: their learned parameters are bound to specific predicates and require retraining for each new task. We introduce Neural Rule Inducer (NRI), a pretrained model for zero-shot rule induction. Rather than encoding literal identities, NRI represents literals using domain-agnostic statistical properties such as class-conditional rates, entropy, and co-occurrence, which generalize across variable identities and counts without retraining. The model consists of a statistical encoder and a parallel slot-based decoder. Parallel decoding preserves the permutation invariance of logical disjunction; an autoregressive decoder would instead impose an arbitrary clause order. Product T-norm relaxation makes rule execution differentiable, allowing end-to-end training on prediction accuracy alone. We evaluate NRI on rule recovery, robustness to label noise and spurious correlations, and zero-shot transfer to real-world benchmarks, and we believe this work opens up the possibility of foundation models for symbolic reasoning. Code and the reference checkpoint are available at this https URL .

item.title: DART: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for Comprehensive Rope Condition Monitoring
item.author: Rani, Anju, Ortiz-Arroyo, Daniel, Durdevic, Petar
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DART的视觉语言基础模型，用于合成纤维绳索的损伤评估，通过统一的多任务架构实现了从单张图像中获取多种监测信息。

背景: 在近海、海事和工业环境中，合成纤维绳索的条件监测不仅需要分类，还需要连续的严重程度估计、维护建议、异常标志、劣化时间线和自动报告，且仅依赖单张检查图像。

目的: 提出DART模型，通过统一的跨模态架构解决完整的绳索检查工作流程，提供可操作的检查智能。

方法: DART扩展了JEPA架构，将Vision Transformer与Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct结合，通过严重程度条件跨模态融合模块。主要创新包括：1. HD-MASK显著性引导掩码策略；2. 每类可学习的严重程度门控；3. 对比损伤解耦损失。

主要发现: 在4270张图像上训练后，DART无需微调即可支持下游任务：损伤分类准确率93.22，连续严重程度回归相关性0.94，少样本识别在20张图像下达到89.2的宏F1值。

结论: DART作为一个通用的条件监测骨干网络，超越了分类任务，能够从单一共享表示中提供可操作的检查智能。

翻译: The condition monitoring (CM) of synthetic fibre ropes (SFRs) used in offshore, maritime, and industrial settings demands more than a classifier: inspectors need continuous severity estimates, maintenance recommendations, anomaly flags, deterioration timelines, and automated reports, all from a single inspection image. We present DART (Damage Assessment via Rope Transformer), a vision-language foundation model that addresses the full rope inspection workflow through a unified multi-task architecture. DART extends the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to the cross-modal domain by coupling a Vision Transformer (ViT-H/14) with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct via a Severity-Conditioned Cross-Modal Fusion (SC-CMF) module. Three architectural innovations drive the model's versatility: (1) HD-MASK, a saliency-guided masking strategy that focuses self-supervised reconstruction on damage-dense patches; (2) per-class learnable severity gates that adaptively weight language grounding by damage category; and (3) a Contrastive Damage Disentanglement (CDD) loss that shapes the embedding space to simultaneously encode damage type, severity ordering, and cross-modal semantics. Trained once on 4,270 images spanning 14 fine-grained rope damage classes, the frozen DART backbone supports downstream tasks without any task-specific fine-tuning: damage classification (93.22 % accuracy, 91.04 % macro-F1, +38.5 pp over a vision-only baseline), continuous severity regression (Spearman rho = 0.94, within-1-ordinal accuracy 99.6 %), few-shot recognition (89.2 % macro-F1 at 20 shots). These results demonstrate that DART functions as a general-purpose CM backbone that goes well beyond classification, providing actionable inspection intelligence from a single shared representation.

Abstract

The condition monitoring (CM) of synthetic fibre ropes (SFRs) used in offshore, maritime, and industrial settings demands more than a classifier: inspectors need continuous severity estimates, maintenance recommendations, anomaly flags, deterioration timelines, and automated reports, all from a single inspection image. We present DART (Damage Assessment via Rope Transformer), a vision-language foundation model that addresses the full rope inspection workflow through a unified multi-task architecture. DART extends the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to the cross-modal domain by coupling a Vision Transformer (ViT-H/14) with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct via a Severity-Conditioned Cross-Modal Fusion (SC-CMF) module. Three architectural innovations drive the model's versatility: (1) HD-MASK, a saliency-guided masking strategy that focuses self-supervised reconstruction on damage-dense patches; (2) per-class learnable severity gates that adaptively weight language grounding by damage category; and (3) a Contrastive Damage Disentanglement (CDD) loss that shapes the embedding space to simultaneously encode damage type, severity ordering, and cross-modal semantics. Trained once on 4,270 images spanning 14 fine-grained rope damage classes, the frozen DART backbone supports downstream tasks without any task-specific fine-tuning: damage classification (93.22 % accuracy, 91.04 % macro-F1, +38.5 pp over a vision-only baseline), continuous severity regression (Spearman rho = 0.94, within-1-ordinal accuracy 99.6 %), few-shot recognition (89.2 % macro-F1 at 20 shots). These results demonstrate that DART functions as a general-purpose CM backbone that goes well beyond classification, providing actionable inspection intelligence from a single shared representation.

item.title: KernelBenchX: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
item.author: Wang, Han, Zhang, Jintao, Jiang, Kai, Wang, Haoxu, Chen, Jianfei, Zhu, Jun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: KernelBenchX是一个基准测试工具，用于评估基于LLM的Triton内核生成能力，并揭示了任务结构、迭代优化和正确性与效率之间的关系。

背景: 基于LLM的Triton内核生成引起了广泛关注，但关于其能力在何处失效以及原因的实证问题仍未得到解答。

目的: 提出KernelBenchX基准测试，通过176个任务在15个类别中的正确性和硬件效率评估，回答LLM内核生成能力在何处失效以及原因。

方法: 使用KernelBenchX对五个代表性方法进行系统性比较，评估正确性和硬件效率，分析任务结构、迭代优化和正确性与效率的关系。

主要发现: 1. 任务结构比方法设计更能决定正确性，类别解释的语义正确性方差远高于方法设计。2. 迭代优化提高了正确性但未提升性能，新挽救的内核性能低于持续正确的内核。3. 正确性不代表效率，大量正确内核比PyTorch慢，跨硬件加速比差异巨大。4. 量化任务完全未解决，表明存在对数值计算契约的系统误解而非表面语法错误。

结论: 未来进展取决于处理全局协调、显式建模数值精度以及将硬件效率纳入生成过程。

翻译: 基于LLM的Triton内核生成引起了广泛关注，但关于其能力在何处失效以及原因的实证问题仍未得到解答。我们提出了KernelBenchX，这是一个基准测试工具，旨在通过在15个类别中的176个任务上对正确性和硬件效率进行类别感知评估来回答这个问题。我们对五个代表性方法的系统性比较得出了三个主要发现。首先，任务结构比方法设计更能决定正确性。类别解释的语义正确性方差几乎是方法设计的三倍，且所有五种方法在72%的融合任务中都失败了，而数学任务则一致得到解决。其次，迭代优化提高了正确性，但未提高性能。在GEAK迭代过程中，编译率从52.3%上升到68.8%，而平均加速比从1.58倍下降到1.44倍；新挽救的内核性能始终低于持续正确的内核（第0轮到第1轮的加速比为1.16倍 vs 1.58倍）。第三，正确性并不代表效率。46.6%的正确内核比PyTorch eager基准慢，跨硬件加速比差异达到21.4倍。此外，尽管编译率非零，量化任务仍未解决（0/30成功），这表明存在对数值计算契约的系统误解，而非表面语法错误。这些发现表明，未来的进步取决于处理全局协调、显式建模数值精度以及将硬件效率纳入生成过程。代码可在该网址获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决如何评估大语言模型生成GPU内核能力的问题。随着大模型在编程领域的应用，需要一种标准化的方法来衡量它们生成的GPU内核代码是否正确且高效，这对推动AI应用性能优化具有重要意义。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了 KernelBench-X，这是一个用于评估大语言模型生成 GPU 内核性能的综合基准。

Abstract

LLM-based Triton kernel generation has attracted significant interest, yet a fundamental empirical question remains unanswered: where does this capability break down, and why? We present KernelBenchX, a benchmark designed to answer this question through category-aware evaluation of correctness and hardware efficiency across 176 tasks in 15 categories. Our systematic comparison of five representative methods yields three main findings. First, task structure determines correctness more than method design. Category explains nearly three times more variance in semantic correctness than method (9.4% vs 3.3% explained deviance), and 72% of Fusion tasks fail across all five methods while Math tasks are solved consistently. Second, iterative refinement improves correctness, but not performance. Across GEAK iterations, compile rate rises from 52.3% to 68.8% while average speedup declines from $1.58\times$ to $1.44\times$; newly rescued kernels consistently underperform persistently correct ones ($1.16\times$ vs $1.58\times$ speedup in round~0$\to$1). Third, correctness does not imply efficiency. 46.6% of correct kernels are slower than the PyTorch eager baseline, and cross-hardware speedup variance reaches $21.4\times$. Besides, quantization remains completely unsolved (0/30 successes) despite non-trivial compilation rates, revealing systematic misunderstanding of numerical computation contracts rather than surface-level syntax errors. These findings suggest that future progress depends on handling global coordination, explicitly modeling numerical precision, and incorporating hardware efficiency into generation. The code is available at this https URL

item.title: TabEmbed: Benchmarking and Learning Generalist Embeddings for Tabular Understanding
item.author: Minjie Qiang, Mingming Zhang, Xiaoyi Bao, Xing Fu, Yu Cheng, Weiqiang Wang, Zhongqing Wang, Ningtao Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 TabEmbed 的通用嵌入模型，旨在解决表格数据的表示学习问题，并通过 TabBench 基准测试验证了其有效性。

背景: 自然语言处理的基础模型已建立统一表示，但表格数据领域尚未探索；现有方法存在局限性，如基于大语言模型的方法缺乏检索兼容的向量输出，文本嵌入模型难以捕捉表格结构和数值语义。

目的: 介绍 Tabular Embedding Benchmark (TabBench) 以评估嵌入模型的表格理解能力，并填补现有方法在表格数据表示上的空白。

方法: 提出首个通用嵌入模型 TabEmbed，将多样化的表格任务重新表述为语义匹配问题，利用大规模对比学习和正向感知的硬负样本挖掘技术，在共享嵌入空间内统一表格分类和检索任务。

主要发现: 在 TabBench 上的实验结果表明，TabEmbed 显著优于最先进的文本嵌入模型，为通用表格表示学习建立了新的基准。

结论: TabEmbed 成功实现了表格分类和检索的统一，代码和数据集已公开。

翻译: Foundation models have established unified representations for natural language processing, yet this paradigm remains largely unexplored for tabular data. Existing methods face fundamental limitations: LLM-based approaches lack retrieval-compatible vector outputs, whereas text embedding models often fail to capture tabular structure and numerical semantics. To bridge this gap, we first introduce the Tabular Embedding Benchmark (TabBench), a comprehensive suite designed to evaluate the tabular understanding capability of embedding models. We then propose TabEmbed, the first generalist embedding model that unifies tabular classification and retrieval within a shared embedding space. By reformulating diverse tabular tasks as semantic matching problems, TabEmbed leverages large-scale contrastive learning with positive-aware hard negative mining to discern fine-grained structural and numerical nuances. Experimental results on TabBench demonstrate that TabEmbed significantly outperforms state-of-the-art text embedding models, establishing a new baseline for universal tabular representation learning. Code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/qiangminjie27/TabEmbed and https://huggingface.co/datasets/qiangminjie27/TabBench.

item.title: Attention-Based Chaotic Self-Supervision for Medical Image Classification
item.author: Joao Batista Florindo, Amanda Pontes de Oliveira Ornelas
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于混沌去噪自编码器的自监督学习预训练策略，并结合注意力融合机制，在医学图像分类任务上取得了优异性能。

背景: 深度学习模型在医学图像分类中表现良好，但通常依赖大型标注数据集或ImageNet的迁移学习。自监督学习是替代方案，但常见的掩码自编码器可能破坏细粒度诊断特征。

目的: 提出一种新的自监督预训练策略，以学习鲁棒且领域特定的特征，并设计注意力融合机制结合通用和特定领域表示的优势。

方法: 提出了混沌去噪自编码器CDAE预训练策略。不使用随机掩码，而是对输入图像应用混沌变换，让自编码器重构原始图像。此外，提出了注意力融合机制，将CDAE训练的编码器与标准编码器的特征结合。

主要发现: 在ISIC 2018数据集上，准确率为0.9221，F1-macro为0.8530；在APTOS 2019数据集上，准确率为0.8644，F1-macro为0.7433。

结论: 该方法在两个公开医学数据集上表现出了高性能，证明了其有效性。

翻译: 用于医学图像分类的深度学习模型通常能取得良好的结果，但通常依赖于大型标注数据集或从ImageNet进行的标准迁移学习。自监督学习（SSL）已成为一种强大的替代方案，但像掩码自编码器（MAE）这样的常见方法可能会通过使用随机掩码无意中破坏细粒度的诊断特征。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的SSL预训练策略，即混沌去噪自编码器（CDAE）。我们不使用掩码，而是对输入图像应用混沌变换，让自编码器重构原始图像。我们假设这迫使编码器通过“逆转混沌”来学习鲁棒且领域特定的特征。此外，我们提出了一种注意力融合机制，将来自我们CDAE训练的编码器的特征与标准编码器相结合，利用通用和特定领域表示的优势。我们的方法在两个公开医学数据集上进行了评估：ISIC 2018（皮肤病变）和APTOS 2019（糖尿病视网膜病变）。所提出的模型取得了高性能，在ISIC 2018上的准确率为0.9221，F1-macro为0.8530，在APTOS 2019上的准确率为0.8644，F1-macro为0.7433，证明了我们方法的有效性。

Abstract

Deep learning models for medical image classification usually achieve promising results but typically rely on large, annotated datasets or standard transfer learning from ImageNet. Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has emerged as a powerful alternative, yet common methods like masked autoencoders (MAEs) may inadvertently destroy fine-grained diagnostic features by using random masking. In this paper, we propose a novel SSL pre-training strategy, the Chaotic Denoising Autoencoder (CDAE). Instead of masking, we apply a chaotic transformation to the input image, tasking an autoencoder to reconstruct the original. We hypothesize this forces the encoder to learn robust, domain-specific features by "inverting the chaos". Furthermore, we propose an attentive fusion mechanism that combines features from our CDAE-trained encoder with a standard encoder, leveraging the strengths of both general and domain-specific representations. Our method is evaluated on two public medical datasets: ISIC 2018 (skin lesions) and APTOS 2019 (diabetic retinopathy). The proposed model achieves high performance, with an accuracy of 0.9221 and an F1-macro of 0.8530 on ISIC 2018, and an accuracy of 0.8644 and F1-macro of 0.7433 on APTOS 2019, demonstrating the efficacy of our approach.

item.title: Low-Rank Adaptation of Geospatial Foundation Models for Wildfire Mapping Using Sentinel-2 Data
item.author: Shibli, Ali, Nascetti, Andrea, Ban, Yifang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究评估了三种地理空间基础模型在北美火情燃烧面积制图任务中的表现，并比较了不同的微调策略。

背景: 火情燃烧面积制图对损害评估、排放建模及理解火情气候相互作用至关重要。尽管地理空间基础模型在卫星图像处理上表现强大，但如何高效适应下游地球观测任务仍缺乏明确理解。

目的: 评估 Terramind、DINOv3 和 Prithvi-v2 三种模型在北美火情燃烧面积制图中的效果，并研究如何应对地理和时间域偏移。

方法: 利用2017至2023年的3820起火情事件数据，在多样化的生物群落中进行空间和时间泛化测试。系统比较了全量微调、仅解码器微调和低秩适应方法。

主要发现: 低秩适应方法在跨域泛化中表现最佳，且参数更新量小于1%。Prithvi-v2 结合 LoRA 达到了最高的整体准确率。

结论: 地理空间基础模型通过轻量级参数高效方法（如 LoRA）适应后，能为大规模火情燃烧面积制图提供稳健且可扩展的解决方案。

翻译: 火情燃烧面积制图对于损害评估、排放建模以及理解不同生态区域的火情气候相互作用至关重要。最近的地理空间基础模型为卫星图像提供了强大的通用表示，但如何高效地将这些模型适应于下游地球观测任务，特别是在地理和时间域偏移的情况下，仍缺乏清晰的理解。本研究利用2017年至2023年的3820起火情事件数据，使用Sentinel-2数据在加拿大和美国评估了三种最先进的地理空间基础模型——Terramind、DINOv3和Prithvi-v2——在火情燃烧面积制图中的应用。我们在多样化的生物群落中进行了空间和时间泛化测试。我们系统地比较了全量微调、仅解码器微调和低秩适应方法来适应每个模型。在所有实验中，低秩适应提供了最强的跨域泛化能力，同时仅更新不到1%的参数，展示了准确性和效率之间良好的权衡。Prithvi-v2 结合低秩适应达到了最高的整体准确率，并且相比全量微调有最大的改进。这些发现表明，地理空间基础模型在使用轻量级参数高效方法（如低秩适应）进行适应时，为大规模火情燃烧面积制图提供了一种稳健且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract

Wildfire burned-area mapping is essential for damage assessment, emissions modeling, and understanding fire-climate interactions across diverse ecological regions. Recent geospatial foundation models provide strong general-purpose representations for satellite imagery, yet there is still no clear understanding of how to efficiently adapt these models for downstream Earth observation tasks, particularly under geographic and temporal domain shift. This study evaluates three state-of-the-art Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) - Terramind, DINOv3, and Prithvi-v2 - for burned-area mapping across the United States and Canada using Sentinel-2 data. Leveraging 3,820 wildfire events from 2017-2023, we conduct spatial and temporal generalization tests across diverse biomes. We systematically compare full fine-tuning, decoder-only fine-tuning, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for adapting each model. Across all experiments, LoRA provides the strongest cross-domain generalization while updating less than 1% of parameters, demonstrating a favorable trade-off between accuracy and efficiency. Prithvi-v2 with LoRA achieves the highest overall accuracy and the largest improvement compared to full fine-tuning. These findings indicate that geospatial foundation models, when adapted using lightweight parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA, offer a robust and scalable solution for large-scale burned-area mapping. Code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Chaotic Contrastive Learning for Robust Texture Classification
item.author: Joao B Florindo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种结合自监督学习与确定性混沌动力学的纹理分类框架。

背景: 纹理分类是计算机视觉的关键任务，面临类间相似度高、结构模式对尺度和光照敏感的挑战。现有方法如CNN和Vision Transformer往往依赖大量标注数据，且过度依赖颜色和形状特征，导致跨域泛化能力差。

目的: 解决纹理分类中的挑战，提高模型的泛化能力。

方法: 1. 提出混沌对比预训练策略，利用Logistic、Tent和Sine映射作为非线性数据增强。2. 基于遍历理论，利用混沌扰动迫使网络学习拓扑鲁棒特征。3. 引入基于注意力的特征集成，融合监督大骨干网络的高层语义特征与混沌预训练小编码器的低频结构特征。

主要发现: 在六个纹理数据集上进行了实验，该方法优于现有的最先进方法，并在所有数据集上取得了有前景的准确率。

结论: 该方法在纹理分类任务上表现优越，验证了结合自监督学习与混沌动力学的有效性。

翻译: 纹理分类是计算机视觉中的一个关键任务，由于类间相似度高以及结构模式对尺度和光照变化的敏感性，它面临着独特的挑战。虽然卷积神经网络和最近的视觉Transformer已经设定了性能基准，但由于过度依赖颜色和形状特征，它们通常需要大量的标注数据，或者在跨域泛化方面表现不佳。本文介绍了一种新颖的框架，将自监督学习与确定性混沌动力学相结合。我们提出了一种混沌对比预训练策略，其中逐像素的混沌映射，特别是Logistic、Tent和Sine映射，充当非线性数据增强技术。这些基于遍历理论的混沌扰动，通过模拟复杂的环境噪声和反射变化，迫使网络学习拓扑鲁棒特征。此外，我们引入了一种基于注意力的特征集成方法，将来自监督大骨干网络的高层语义表示与来自混沌预训练小编码器的低频结构特征融合在一起。在六个纹理基准数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法优于最先进的方法，并在所有分析的数据集上取得了有前景的准确率。

Abstract

Texture classification is a pivotal task in computer vision, presenting unique challenges due to high inter-class similarity and the sensitivity of structural patterns to scale and illumination changes. While Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and recent Vision Transformers have set performance benchmarks, they often require extensive labeled datasets or struggle to generalize across domains due to an over-reliance on color and shape features. This paper introduces a novel framework that synergizes Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) with deterministic chaotic dynamics. We propose a chaotic contrastive pre-training strategy, where pixel-wise chaotic maps, specifically Logistic, Tent, and Sine maps, act as non-linear data augmentation techniques. These chaotic perturbations, grounded in ergodic theory, force the network to learn topologically robust features by mimicking complex environmental noise and reflectance variations. Furthermore, we introduce an attention-based feature ensemble that fuses high-level semantic representations from a supervised large backbone with low-frequency structural features from a chaos-pretrained tiny encoder. Experimental results on six texture benchmarks (FMD, UMD, KTH-TIPS2-b, DTD, GTOS, and 1200Tex) demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches and achieving promising accuracies on all the analyzed datasets.

item.title: The Predictive-Causal Gap: An Impossibility Theorem and Large-Scale Neural Evidence
item.author: Liu, Kejun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 报告了预测表示学习中的一种系统性失败模式，即最优编码器倾向于跟踪环境而非系统。

背景: 预测表示学习领域。

目的: 证明这种失败不是优化伪影，而是预测目标的结构属性，并分析其对学习的影响。

方法: 在2695个线性高斯动力学配置和Duffing-GRU非线性任务中训练神经网络进行预测，对比了未约束预测器和操作接地方法。

主要发现: 最优编码器平均因果保真度为0.49，仅2.5%的配置超过0.70；维度增加时编码器变得因果盲；在非线性任务中，未约束预测器在55%的任务中学习环境主导表示，而操作接地仅为24%；操作接地仅部分抑制差距。

结论: 预测因果差距是学习的结构极限，对自监督表示学习、世界模型和扩展范式有重要影响。

翻译: 我们报告了预测表示学习中的一种系统性失败模式。在2695个被训练用于预测线性高斯动力学的神经网络配置中，最优编码器跟踪的是环境而不是它旨在建模的系统。平均因果保真度——即分配给系统自由度的编码器敏感度比例——为0.49，只有2.5%的配置超过0.70。随着维度的增加，这种失败加剧：在维度为100时，最优编码器变得因果盲（保真度约为10的负8次方），同时比因果表示实现了92%的更低预测误差。我们证明这并非优化伪影，而是预测目标的结构属性：当环境模式比系统模式更慢或噪声更少时，人口风险的每一个最小化器都编码前者。表现出这种预测因果差距的动力学集合在参数空间中是开放的且具有正测度。在非线性Duffing-GRU扫描中，未约束预测器在55%的任务中学习环境主导表示（95%置信区间41到68%），而操作接地仅为24%（p值约为0.0023）；在环境转移下的中位数分布外MSE膨胀为1.82倍，而操作接地为1.00倍。操作接地——将损失限制在系统可观测量上——部分抑制了差距，但在没有明确的系统环境边界的情况下，因果保真度从未恢复。结果将预测因果差距识别为学习的结构极限，对自监督表示学习、世界模型和扩展范式有影响。

Abstract

We report a systematic failure mode in predictive representation learning. Across 2695 neural network configurations trained to predict linear-Gaussian dynamics, the optimal encoder tracks the environment rather than the system it is meant to model. The mean causal fidelity -- the fraction of encoder sensitivity allocated to system degrees of freedom -- is 0.49, and only 2.5% of configurations exceed 0.70. The failure intensifies with dimension: at N=100, the optimal encoder becomes causally blind (fidelity ~10^{-8}) while achieving 92% lower prediction error than the causal representation. We prove this is not an optimization artifact but a structural property of the predictive objective: when environment modes are slower or less noisy than system modes, every minimizer of the population risk encodes the former. The set of dynamics exhibiting this predictive-causal gap is open and of positive measure in parameter space. In a nonlinear Duffing-GRU sweep, unconstrained predictors learn environment-dominant representations in 55% of tasks (95% CI 41--68%) versus 24% under operational grounding (p=2.3e-3); the median out-of-distribution MSE inflation under environment shift is 1.82x versus 1.00x. Operational grounding -- restricting the loss to system observables -- partially suppresses the gap, but causal fidelity is never recovered without an explicit system-environment boundary. The results identify the predictive-causal gap as a structural limit of learning, with implications for self-supervised representation learning, world models, and the scaling paradigm.

item.title: Height-Guided Projection Reparameterization for Camera-LiDAR Occupancy
item.author: Yuan Wu, Zhiqiang Yan, Jiawei Lian, Zhengxue Wang, Jian Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 HiPR 的相机激光雷达占用预测框架，通过高度引导的投影重参数化来提高特征聚合的可靠性。

背景: 3D 占用预测旨在从传感器观测中推断密集的体素级场景语义。大多数先前的方法依赖于固定的投影空间，其中 3D 参考点沿柱体均匀采样，这难以捕捉现实世界场景的稀疏性和高度变化，导致对应关系模糊和特征聚合不可靠。

目的: 为了解决固定投影空间难以捕捉场景稀疏性和高度变化的问题，本文提出了一种新的框架来提高特征聚合的可靠性。

方法: 提出了 HiPR 框架，包含高度引导的投影重参数化。首先将激光雷达编码为 BEV 高度图以捕获点云的最大高度。然后使用高度先验调整每个柱体的采样范围，实现投影空间的自适应重参数化。同时，通过掩码去除高度图中的无效部分。此外，引入了渐进式高度条件化策略以减轻训练不稳定性。

主要发现: 大量实验表明，HiPR 一致地优于现有的最先进方法，同时保持实时推理能力。

结论: HiPR 在 3D 占用预测任务中表现优异，且具备实时推理能力。

翻译: 3D occupancy prediction aims to infer dense, voxel-wise scene semantics from sensor observations, where the 2D-to-3D view transformation serves as a crucial step in bridging image features and volumetric representations. Most previous methods rely on a fixed projection space, where 3D reference points are uniformly sampled along pillars. However, such sampling struggles to capture the sparsity and height variations of real-world scenes, leading to ambiguous correspondences and unreliable feature aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose HiPR, a camera-LiDAR occupancy framework with Height-Guided Projection Reparameterization. HiPR first encodes LiDAR into a BEV height map to capture the maximum height of the point cloud. HiPR then adjusts the sampling range of each pillar using the height prior, enabling adaptive reparameterization of the projection space. As a result, the projected points are redistributed into geometrically meaningful regions rather than fixed ranges. Meanwhile, we mask out the invalid parts of the height map to avoid misleading the feature aggregation. In addition, to alleviate the training instability caused by noisy LiDAR-derived heights, we introduce a training-time Progressive Height Conditioning strategy, which gradually transitions the conditioning signal from ground-truth heights to LiDAR heights. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiPR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods while maintaining real-time inference. The code and pretrained models can be found at https://github.com/Rayn-Wu/HiPR.

item.title: A Bayesian Approach for Task-Specific Next-Best-View Selection with Uncertain Geometry
item.author: Jingsen Zhu, Silvia Sellán, Alexander Terenin
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯决策理论的框架，用于点云3D重建中的任务特定主动下一步最佳视图选择。

背景: 传统的主动视图选择方法通常均匀减少不确定性，而非针对特定任务需求。

目的: 实现针对特定下游任务优化的相机选择，仅减少对任务有影响的区域的不确定性。

方法: 通过在隐式表面空间放置先验分布，利用随机表面重建方法计算后验分布，并据此推理下一个扫描视图。

主要发现: 在语义分类、分割和PDE引导的物理模拟三个任务中，该方法在更少的视图数量下取得了优于基线和通用不确定性减少技术的性能。

结论: 该框架能够以更少的视图数量实现更好的任务性能。

翻译: 我们开发了一个用于点云3D重建中任务特定主动下一步最佳视图选择的框架，通过将问题表述为贝叶斯决策理论的语言。我们的框架通过（a）在隐式表面空间放置先验分布，（b）使用最近开发的随机表面重建方法计算结果后验分布，然后（c）使用后验分布仔细推理下一个扫描视图来实现。这使我们能够以直接针对重建数据预期用途的方式执行相机选择——也就是说，我们仅减少那些对当前任务有影响的区域的不确定性，而不是以前均匀减少空间不确定性的方法。我们在三个不同的下游任务上评估了我们的方法：语义分类、分割和PDE引导的物理模拟。实验结果表明，与常用的基线和先前的通用不确定性减少技术相比，我们的框架以更少的视图实现了卓越的任务性能。

Abstract

We develop a framework for task-specific active next-best-view selection in 3D reconstruction from point clouds, by casting the problem in the language of Bayesian decision theory. Our framework works by (a) placing a prior distribution over the space of implicit surfaces, (b) using recently-developed stochastic surface reconstruction methods to calculate the resulting posterior distribution, then (c) using the posterior distribution to carefully reason about which view to scan next. This enables us to perform camera selection in a manner that is directly optimized for the intended use of the reconstructed data - meaning, we reduce uncertainty only in those regions that make a difference in the task at hand, as opposed to prior approaches that reduce it uniformly across space. We evaluate our method across three distinct downstream tasks: semantic classification, segmentation, and PDE-guided physics simulation. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves superior task performance with fewer views compared to commonly used baselines and prior general uncertainty-reduction techniques.

item.title: CPCANet: Deep Unfolding Common Principal Component Analysis for Domain Generalization
item.author: Chen, Yu-Hsi, Seghouane, Abd-Krim
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于CPCA的CPCANet框架，通过展开Flury-Gautschi算法实现结构化域不变子空间的发现，在域泛化任务中取得了SOTA性能。

背景: 域泛化旨在学习在分布外变化下保持鲁棒且能有效泛化到未见目标域的表示。尽管现有的不变学习策略和架构进展取得了良好性能，但通过二阶统计量显式发现结构化域不变子空间的研究仍然较少。

目的: 提出CPCANet框架，将CPCA的统计特性集成到端到端可训练框架中，强制发现跨不同域的共享子空间。

方法: 基于共同主成分分析CPCA，将迭代Flury-Gautschi算法展开为全微分神经网络层，构建端到端可训练的框架。

主要发现: 在四个标准DG基准测试中实现了零样本迁移的SOTA性能，且架构无关，无需数据集特定的调优。

结论: 为学习分布偏移下的鲁棒表示提供了一种简单高效的方法。

翻译: 域泛化旨在学习在分布外变化下保持鲁棒且能有效泛化到未见目标域的表示。尽管现有的不变学习策略和架构进展取得了良好性能，但通过二阶统计量显式发现结构化域不变子空间的研究仍然较少。本文提出CPCANet，一种基于共同主成分分析的新颖框架，将迭代Flury-Gautschi算法展开为全微分神经网络层。该方法将CPCA的统计特性集成到端到端可训练框架中，强制发现跨不同域的共享子空间，同时保持可解释性。在四个标准DG基准测试上的实验表明，CPCANet在零样本迁移中实现了最先进的性能。此外，CPCANet架构无关且无需数据集特定的调优，为学习分布偏移下的鲁棒表示提供了一种简单高效的方法。代码可在该网址获取。
