Abstract

Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video is essential for bridging visual intelligence and the physical world, yet remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs). Prior approaches either verbalize spatial-temporal reasoning entirely as text, which is inherently verbose and imprecise for complex dynamics, or rely on external geometric modules that increase inference complexity without fostering intrinsic model capability. In this paper, we present 4DThinker, the first framework that enables VLMs to "think with 4D" through dynamic latent mental imagery, i.e., internally simulating how scenes evolve within the continuous hidden space. Specifically, we first introduce a scalable, annotation-free data generation pipeline that synthesizes 4D reasoning data from raw videos. We then propose Dynamic-Imagery Fine-Tuning (DIFT), which jointly supervises textual tokens and 4D latents to ground the model in dynamic visual semantics. Building on this, 4D Reinforcement Learning (4DRL) further tackles complex reasoning tasks via outcome-based rewards, restricting policy gradients to text tokens to ensure stable optimization. Extensive experiments across multiple dynamic spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that 4DThinker consistently outperforms strong baselines and offers a new perspective toward 4D reasoning in VLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhangquanchen/4DThinker.

item.title: TFM-Retouche: A Lightweight Input-Space Adapter for Tabular Foundation Models
item.author: Nguyen, Duong, Jawhar, Mohammed, Chesneau, Nicolas
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TFM-Retouche 是一种轻量级的输入空间残差适配器，旨在通过在输入空间进行微调来适应特定任务，且与预训练模型的架构无关。

背景: 表格基础模型（TFMs）虽然具备强大的零样本学习能力，但其归纳偏置在推理时保持固定。现有的微调方法（如全量微调或 LoRA）要么计算成本高，要么需要针对特定架构定制，且关于权重空间微调是否能提升准确性和校准度的证据尚不明确。

目的: 提出一种架构无关的轻量级输入空间适配方法，以降低适应特定数据集或任务的计算成本，并解决权重空间微调效果不确定的问题。

方法: TFM-Retouche 在输入空间学习残差修正，通过冻结的 TFM 骨干网络进行端到端训练。该方法包含一个后训练身份保护机制，当验证集上的适应无效时回退到原始模型。

主要发现: 在 TabArena-Lite 数据集上，基于 TabICLv2 的 TFM-Retouche 方法在排行榜上排名第一。通过轻量级微调和集成，其综合 Elo 分数比冻结的 TabICLv2 基础模型提高了 56 分，且在预测质量与训练及推理时间之间达到了帕累托前沿。

结论: TFM-Retouche 是一种高效且有效的适配方法，能够在保持模型架构不变的情况下显著提升性能，且计算开销小。

翻译: 表格基础模型（TFMs），如 TabPFN-2.6、TabICLv2、ConTextTab、Mitra、LimiX 和 TabDPT，通过上下文学习实现了强大的零样本性能，但其归纳偏置在推理时保持固定。将预训练的 TFM 适应到特定数据集或任务通常需要全量微调（计算昂贵）或参数高效微调方法（如 LoRA，需针对每个 TFM 的内部架构定制）。此外，关于权重空间微调是否能提高准确性或校准度的证据尚不明确。我们介绍了 TFM-Retouche，这是一种轻量级的输入空间残差适配器，在设计中与冻结的 TFM 骨干网络架构无关。TFM-Retouche 在输入空间学习微小的残差修正，以将输入数据与预训练模型的归纳偏置对齐。该适配器通过冻结的 TFM 进行端到端训练，并配备后训练身份保护机制，当验证集上的适应无效时回退到未修改的 TFM。在 TabArena-Lite（涵盖二分类、多分类和回归的 51 个数据集）上，TabICLv2-Retouche——即在 TabICLv2 上实例化的框架——是排行榜上排名第一的方法，通过轻量级任务微调和集成，将综合 Elo 分数比冻结的 TabICLv2 基础模型提高了 56 分，且在预测质量与训练及推理时间之间处于帕累托前沿。

Abstract

Tabular foundation models (TFMs), such as TabPFN-2.6, TabICLv2, ConTextTab, Mitra, LimiX, and TabDPT, achieve strong zero-shot performance through in-context learning, but their inductive biases remain fixed at inference time. Adapting a pretrained TFM to a specific dataset or task typically requires either full fine-tuning, which is computationally expensive, or parameter-efficient tuning methods (PEFT) such as LoRA, which must be tailored to the internal architecture of each TFM. Furthermore, the evidence on whether weight-space fine-tuning improves accuracy or calibration is mixed \citep{tanna_exploring_2026,rubachev_finetuning_2025}. We introduce TFM-Retouche, a lightweight input-space residual adapter that is architecture-agnostic by design with respect to the frozen TFM backbone. TFM-Retouche learns a small residual correction in the input space to align the input data with the inductive biases of the pretrained model. The adapter is trained end-to-end through the frozen TFM, with a post-training identity guard that falls back to the unmodified TFM whenever adaptation does not help on held-out validation. On TabArena-Lite (51 datasets spanning binary classification, multiclass classification, and regression), TabICLv2-Retouche -- the framework instantiated on TabICLv2 -- is the top-ranked method on the leaderboard with light per-task tuning and ensembling, lifting aggregate Elo by +56 over the frozen TabICLv2 base and sitting on the Pareto front of predictive quality versus both training and inference time.

item.title: PRISM: Iterative Cross-Modal Posterior Refinement for Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs
item.author: Trimble Chang, Yihang Liu, Mingjing Han, Han Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PRISM是一个用于动态文本属性图表示学习的迭代跨模态后验细化框架。

背景: 动态文本属性图用于建模节点语义和时间依赖交互紧密耦合的演化系统。多模态学习是增强DyTAG表示学习的一个有前景但未被充分探索的方向。然而，现有方法通常依赖刚性模态划分和单步融合策略，限制了捕捉节点语义和交互行为之间内在及演化依赖的能力。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在捕捉节点语义和交互行为之间内在及演化依赖方面的局限性，提出一种新的框架来增强DyTAG的表示学习。

方法: PRISM框架将DyTAG信息组织为语义和行为模态，提供比载体级模态划分更内在的划分方式。它不进行单步融合，而是通过跨模态交互学习一条细化轨迹，逐步将语义先验转化为受行为证据条件化的后验状态。

主要发现: 在DTGB基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PRISM在时间链预测和目标节点检索任务上实现了强大的性能。消融研究验证了语义-行为建模和迭代后验细化的有效性。

结论: PRISM通过迭代跨模态后验细化，有效提升了DyTAG的表示学习能力，在特定任务上表现优异。

翻译: 动态文本属性图为建模节点语义和时间依赖交互紧密耦合的演化系统提供了强大的框架。最近，多模态学习作为增强DyTAG表示学习的一个有前景但未被充分探索的方向而出现。然而，现有方法通常依赖刚性模态划分和单步融合策略，这限制了它们捕捉节点语义和交互行为之间内在及演化依赖的能力。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了PRISM，一个用于DyTAG表示学习的迭代跨模态后验细化框架。PRISM将DyTAG信息组织为语义和行为模态，为载体级模态划分提供了更内在的替代方案。PRISM不进行单步融合，而是学习一条细化轨迹，通过跨模态交互与行为证据，逐步将语义先验转化为受行为证据条件化的后验状态。在DTGB基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PRISM在时间链预测和目标节点检索任务上实现了强大的性能。进一步的消融研究验证了语义-行为建模和迭代后验细化的有效性。

Abstract

Dynamic text-attributed graphs (DyTAGs) provide a powerful framework for modeling evolving systems in which node semantics and time-dependent interactions are tightly coupled. Recently, multimodal learning has emerged as a promising yet underexplored direction for enhancing DyTAG representation learning. However, existing methods typically rely on rigid modality partitions and one-shot fusion strategies, which limit their ability to capture the intrinsic and evolving dependencies between node semantics and interaction behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{PRISM}, an iterative cross-modal posterior refinement framework for DyTAG representation learning. PRISM organizes DyTAG information into semantic and behavioral modalities, providing a more intrinsic alternative to carrier-level modality partitions. Instead of fusing the two modalities in a single step, PRISM learns a refinement trajectory that progressively transforms semantic priors into behavior-conditioned posterior states through cross-modal interaction with behavioral evidence. Extensive experiments on DTGB benchmark datasets show that PRISM achieves strong performance on temporal link prediction and destination node retrieval tasks. Further ablation studies validate the effectiveness of semantic--behavioral modeling and iterative posterior refinement.

item.title: OpenGaFF: Open-Vocabulary Gaussian Feature Field with Codebook Attention
item.author: Kunyi Li, Michael Niemeyer, Sen Wang, Stefano Gasperini, Nassir Navab, Federico Tombari
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于3D Gaussian Splatting的开放词汇3D场景理解新框架OpenGaFF。

背景: 基于高斯表示的开放词汇3D场景理解面临多视图观察中语义预测碎片化和空间不一致的挑战。

目的: 构建OpenGaFF框架，通过加强几何与语义的耦合，提高3D空间中相似结构的空间一致性，并强制执行对象级别的语义一致性。

方法: 核心是高斯特征场，将语义建模为高斯几何和外观的连续函数；引入结构化码本作为共享语义原语；提出码本引导的注意力机制进行语言特征检索。

主要发现: 在标准2D和3D开放词汇基准测试中，该方法优于先前方法，具有改进的分割质量、更强的3D语义一致性和可解释的码本。

结论: 该方法实现了稳健的开放词汇推理，并减少了对象内的特征方差。

翻译: Understanding open-vocabulary 3D scenes with Gaussian-based representations remains challenging due to fragmented and spatially inconsistent semantic predictions across multi-view observations. In this paper, we present OpenGaFF, a novel framework for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding built upon 3D Gaussian Splatting. At the core of our method is a Gaussian Feature Field that models semantics as a continuous function of Gaussian geometry and appearance. By explicitly conditioning semantic predictions on geometric structure, this formulation strengthens the coupling between geometry and semantics, leading to improved spatial coherence across similar structures in 3D space. To further enforce object-level semantic consistency, we introduce a structured codebook that serves as a set of shared semantic primitives. Furthermore, a codebook-guided attention mechanism is proposed to retrieve language features via similarity matching between query embeddings and learned codebook entries, enabling robust open-vocabulary reasoning while reducing intra-object feature variance. Extensive experiments on standard 2D and 3D open-vocabulary benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms prior approaches, achieving improved segmentation quality, stronger 3D semantic consistency and a semantically interpretable codebook that provides insight into the learned representation.

item.title: Uncovering Entity Identity Confusion in Multimodal Knowledge Editing
item.author: Wu, Shu, Ye, Xiaotian, Mou, Xinyu, Liu, Dongsheng, Wang, Xiaohan, Zhang, Mengqi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了多模态知识编辑中的实体身份混淆问题，通过构建基准和提出约束编辑策略来减少该问题。

背景: 多模态知识编辑旨在修正大视觉语言模型在部署后的内部知识，但编辑后模型的行为模式研究不足。

目的: 识别并研究编辑模型中的系统性失败模式，即实体身份混淆。

方法: 构建了EC-Bench基准测试来直接探测图像实体绑定在编辑前后的变化。分析了EIC的成因，并探索了通过约束编辑到I-E处理阶段来缓解EIC的策略。

主要发现: EIC源于现有方法无法区分图像实体绑定和实体实体关系知识，导致模型将新实体名称视为虚假标签。通过约束编辑到I-E处理阶段可以减少EIC。

结论: 讨论了忠实MKE的原则性要求，并为未来研究提供了方法论指导。

翻译: 多模态知识编辑旨在修正大视觉语言模型在部署后的内部知识，但编辑后模型的行为模式仍鲜有研究。本文识别了编辑模型中的一种系统性失败模式，称为实体身份混淆：编辑后的模型表现出一种荒谬的行为，即仅关于原始实体身份的文本查询意外地返回了关于新实体的信息。为了严格调查EIC，我们构建了EC-Bench，一个诊断基准，直接探测图像实体绑定在编辑前后的变化。我们的分析表明，EIC源于现有方法无法区分模型中的图像实体绑定和实体实体关系知识，导致模型将E-E关联作为捷径过度拟合：图像仍被视为原始实体，而新实体的名称仅作为虚假的身份标签。我们进一步探索了潜在的缓解策略，表明将编辑限制在模型的I-E处理阶段鼓励编辑更忠实地作用于I-E绑定，从而大幅减少EIC。基于这些发现，我们讨论了忠实MKE的原则性要求，并为未来的研究提供了方法论指导。

Abstract

Multimodal knowledge editing (MKE) aims to correct the internal knowledge of large vision-language models after deployment, yet the behavioral patterns of post-edit models remain underexplored. In this paper, we identify a systemic failure mode in edited models, termed Entity Identity Confusion (EIC): edited models exhibit an absurd behavior where text-only queries about the original entity's identity unexpectedly return information about the new entity. To rigorously investigate EIC, we construct EC-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly probes how image-entity bindings shift before and after editing. Our analysis reveals that EIC stems from existing methods failing to distinguish between Image-Entity (I-E) binding and Entity-Entity (E-E) relational knowledge in the model, causing models to overfit E-E associations as a shortcut: the image is still perceived as the original entity, with the new entity's name serving only as a spurious identity label. We further explore potential mitigation strategies, showing that constraining edits to the model's I-E processing stage encourages edits to act more faithfully on I-E binding, thereby substantially reducing EIC. Based on these findings, we discuss principled desiderata for faithful MKE and provide methodological guidance for future research.

item.title: Skill1: Unified Evolution of Skill-Augmented Agents via Reinforcement Learning
item.author: Shi, Yaorui, Chen, Yuxin, Lu, Zhengxi, Miao, Yuchun, Liu, Shugui, GU, Qi, Cai, Xunliang, Wang, Xiang, Zhang, An
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Skill1 的框架，通过单一策略同时进化技能选择、利用和蒸馏能力，以实现跨任务的目标。

背景: 持久化技能库允许语言模型代理跨任务重用策略，维护它需要技能选择、利用和蒸馏三个耦合能力。现有方法孤立优化这些能力，导致进化不完整且相互冲突。

目的: 提出 Skill1 框架，训练单一策略共同进化技能选择、利用和蒸馏，以实现共享的任务结果目标。

方法: Skill1 使用单一策略，通过生成查询搜索技能库、重新排序候选者选择技能、基于技能解决问题以及从轨迹中蒸馏新技能。所有学习均来自单一的任务结果信号，利用低频趋势奖励选择，高频变化奖励蒸馏。

主要发现: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的实验表明，Skill1 优于先前的基于技能和强化学习的方法。训练动态证实了三种能力的共同进化，且移除任何奖励信号都会降低进化效果。

结论: Skill1 成功实现了技能选择、利用和蒸馏的共同进化，优于基线模型。

翻译: A persistent skill library allows language model agents to reuse successful strategies across tasks. Maintaining such a library requires three coupled capabilities. The agent selects a relevant skill, utilizes it during execution, and distills new skills from experience. Existing methods optimize these capabilities in isolation or with separate reward sources, resulting in partial and conflicting evolution. We propose Skill1, a framework that trains a single policy to co-evolve skill selection, utilization, and distillation toward a shared task-outcome objective. The policy generates a query to search the skill library, re-ranks candidates to select one, solves the task conditioned on it, and distills a new skill from the trajectory. All learning derives from a single task-outcome signal. Its low-frequency trend credits selection and its high-frequency variation credits distillation. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that Skill1 outperforms prior skill-based and reinforcement learning baselines. Training dynamics confirm the co-evolution of the three capabilities, and ablations show that removing any credit signal degrades the evolution.

item.title: Listwise Policy Optimization: Group-based RLVR as Target-Projection on the LLM Response Simplex
item.author: Qu, Yun, Wang, Qi, Mao, Yixiu, Zou, Heming, Jiang, Yuhang, Li, Yingyue, Xu, Wutong, Cai, Lizhou, Liu, Weijie, Bai, Clive, Yang, Kai, Chen, Yangkun, Yang, Saiyong, Ji, Xiangyang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为列表策略优化（LPO）的新方法，用于改进大型语言模型的强化学习训练。

背景: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）已成为 LLM 后训练的标准方法，其中基于组的策略梯度是现有主流优化策略。

目的: 揭示现有优化策略的几何结构，并提出显式进行目标投影的框架。

方法: 提出列表策略优化（LPO）。该方法通过将近端 RL 目标限制在响应单纯形上来阐明隐式目标，并利用精确的散度最小化进行策略投影。

主要发现: 该框架实现了目标函数的单调改进，且投影梯度具有有界、零和及自校正特性；同时通过解耦的投影步骤提供了散度选择的灵活性。

结论: 在多样化的推理任务和 LLM 基座上，LPO 在匹配目标下始终优于典型的策略梯度基线，同时保持了优化稳定性和响应多样性。

翻译: 强化学习与可验证奖励已成为大型语言模型后训练中激励推理能力的标准方法。在现有的方法中，基于组的策略梯度最为普遍，它为每个提示采样一组响应，并通过组相对优势信号更新策略。这项工作揭示了这些优化策略共享一种共同的几何结构：每个策略都隐式地在响应单纯形上定义了一个目标分布，并通过一阶近似向其投影。基于这一洞察，我们提出了列表策略优化（LPO）来显式地执行目标投影，通过将近端 RL 目标限制在响应单纯形上来阐明隐式目标，然后通过精确的散度最小化来投影策略。该框架提供了（i）列表目标函数的单调改进，具有有界、零和及自校正的投影梯度，以及（ii）通过解耦投影步骤实现散度选择的灵活性，具有不同的结构特性。在多样化的推理任务和 LLM 基座上，LPO 在匹配目标下始终优于典型的策略梯度基线，同时内在地保持了优化稳定性和响应多样性。

Abstract

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard approach for large language models (LLMs) post-training to incentivize reasoning capacity. Among existing recipes, group-based policy gradient is prevalent, which samples a group of responses per prompt and updates the policy via group-relative advantage signals. This work reveals that these optimization strategies share a common geometric structure: each implicitly defines a target distribution on the response simplex and projects toward it via first-order approximation. Building on this insight, we propose Listwise Policy Optimization (LPO) to explicitly conduct the target-projection, which demystifies the implicit target by restricting the proximal RL objective to the response simplex, and then projects the policy via exact divergence minimization. This framework provides (i) monotonic improvement on the listwise objective with bounded, zero-sum, and self-correcting projection gradients, and (ii) flexibility in divergence selection with distinct structural properties through the decoupled projection step. On diverse reasoning tasks and LLM backbones, LPO consistently improves training performance over typical policy gradient baselines under matched targets, while intrinsically preserving optimization stability and response diversity.

item.title: BioMedArena: An Open-source Toolkit for Building and Evaluating Biomedical Deep Research Agents
item.author: Wu, Jinge, Zhou, Hongjian, Zeng, Mingde, Zhu, Jiayuan, Wu, Junde, Pan, Jiazhen, Wu, Sean, Wu, Honghan, Liu, Fenglin, Clifton, David A.
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: BioMedArena 是一个开源工具包，旨在解决深度研究代理评估中的工程税问题。通过解耦评估层并简化模型集成，它实现了公平比较，并在生物医学基准上取得了显著的性能提升。

背景: 构建深度研究代理涉及大量胶水代码，由于工具注册表和评估框架的差异，同一模型在不同论文中报告的准确率不同。引入新模型需要数周的时间进行特定于模型的工程工作，这被称为每篇论文的工程税。

目的: 发布 BioMedArena，一个开源工具包，以减轻这种工程税，并为公平比较不同的基础模型作为深度研究代理提供竞技场。

方法: BioMedArena 将生物医学代理评估解耦为六个层：基准加载、工具暴露、工具选择、执行模式、上下文管理和评分。它暴露了 147 个生物医学基准和 75 个生物医学工具。添加新模型、基准或工具只需注册几行提供者适配器。它提供了 6 个代理框架和 6 个上下文管理策略。

主要发现: 该工具包提供了 12 个具有竞争力的研究能力的骨干模型。它在 8 个代表性的生物医学基准上实现了最先进的结果，与之前的 SOTA 相比，平均提升了 15.03 个百分点。

结论: 该工具包、配置和每个任务的轨迹可在提供的 URL 获取。

翻译: 构建深度研究代理如今是一项胶水代码练习：同一骨干模型在相同基准上的评估，由于工具注册表和评估框架的差异，在不同论文中报告的准确率不同，且将新的基础模型集成到可比的评估环境中需要数周的时间进行特定于模型的工程工作。我们将此称为每篇论文的工程税，并发布了 BioMedArena，这是一个开源工具包，它不仅减轻了这种税负，还为在评估深度研究代理时公平比较不同的基础模型提供了一个竞技场。BioMedArena 将生物医学代理评估解耦为六个层——基准加载、工具暴露、工具选择、执行模式、上下文管理和评分——并暴露了 147 个生物医学基准和 9 个功能家族中的 75 个生物医学工具。添加新的模型、基准或工具简化为注册几行提供者适配器。我们进一步提供了 6 个代理框架和 6 个上下文管理策略，它们提供了 12 个具有竞争力的研究能力的骨干模型，性能显著提升，在 8 个代表性的生物医学基准上实现了最先进的结果，与之前的 SOTA 相比，平均提升了 15.03 个百分点。该工具包、配置和每个任务的轨迹可在提供的 URL 获取。

Abstract

Building a deep research agent today is an exercise in glue code: the same backbone evaluated on the same benchmark can report different accuracies in different papers because harness and tool registry all differ, and integrating a new foundation model into a comparable evaluation surface costs weeks of model-specific engineering. We call this the per-paper engineering tax and release BioMedArena, an open-source toolkit that not only alleviates it but also provides an arena for fair comparison of different foundation models when evaluating them as deep-research agents. BioMedArena decouples six layers of biomedical agent evaluation -- benchmark loading, tool exposure, tool selection, execution mode, context management, and scoring -- and exposes 147 biomedical benchmarks and 75 biomedical tools across 9 functional families. Adding a new model, benchmark, or tool reduces to registering a few-line provider adapter. We further provide 6 agent harnesses with 6 context-management strategies, which provide 12 backbones with competitive research capabilities and significantly improved performance, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on 8 representative biomedical benchmarks, with an average lift of +15.03 percentage points over prior SOTA. The toolkit, configurations, and per-task traces are available at this https URL

item.title: Event-Causal RAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Long Video Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
item.author: Peizheng Yan, Yu Zhao, Liang Xie, Juntong Qi, Mingming Wang, Erwei Yin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Event-Causal RAG 的轻量级检索增强框架，用于无限长视频推理，通过事件因果图和双向检索策略提升性能。

背景: 现有大型视觉语言模型在超长或无限视频推理上表现不足，受限于自注意力机制的高复杂度，且检索增强生成方法存在记忆碎片化、结构建模弱及成本高的问题。

目的: 构建一个轻量级框架，以实现无限长视频的推理能力，解决长时记忆保持和跨时间因果推断的难题。

方法: 将流式视频分割为语义连贯的事件，用状态-事件-状态图表示，构建全局事件知识图谱，存储在支持语义匹配和因果拓扑检索的双存储记忆中，并采用双向检索策略获取相关因果链和视频证据。

主要发现: Event-Causal RAG 在长视频理解基准测试中持续优于基于片段的检索基线和长上下文视频模型，特别是在需要多事件整合和跨长时间间隔因果推断的问题上表现更好，同时具有更好的内存效率和稳健的流式性能。

结论: 该方法有效解决了无限长视频推理中的记忆和因果推断难题，提升了模型性能和效率。

翻译: Recent large vision-language models have achieved strong performance on short- and medium-length video understanding, yet they remain inadequate for ultra-long or even infinite video reasoning, where models must preserve coherent memory over extended durations and infer causal dependencies across temporally distant events. Existing end-to-end video understanding methods are fundamentally limited by the O(n^2) complexity of self-attention, while recent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches still suffer from fragmented clip-level memory, weak modeling of temporal and causal structure, and high storage and online inference costs. We present Event-Causal RAG, a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework for infinite long-video reasoning. Instead of indexing fixed-length clips, our method segments streaming videos into semantically coherent events and represents each event as a structured State-Event-State (SES) graph, capturing the event together with its surrounding state transitions. These graphs are merged into a global Event Knowledge Graph and stored in a dual-store memory that supports both semantic matching and causal-topological retrieval. On top of this memory, we design a bidirectional retrieval strategy to efficiently identify the most relevant event causal chains and provide them, together with the associated video evidence, to a backbone video foundation model for answer generation. Experiments on long-video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that Event-Causal RAG consistently outperforms strong clip-based retrieval baselines and long-context video models, particularly on questions requiring multi-event integration and causal inference across long temporal gaps, while also achieving improved memory efficiency and robust streaming performance.

Abstract

Recent large vision-language models have achieved strong performance on short- and medium-length video understanding, yet they remain inadequate for ultra-long or even infinite video reasoning, where models must preserve coherent memory over extended durations and infer causal dependencies across temporally distant events. Existing end-to-end video understanding methods are fundamentally limited by the $O(n^2)$ complexity of self-attention, while recent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches still suffer from fragmented clip-level memory, weak modeling of temporal and causal structure, and high storage and online inference costs. We present Event-Causal RAG, a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework for infinite long-video reasoning. Instead of indexing fixed-length clips, our method segments streaming videos into semantically coherent events and represents each event as a structured State-Event-State (SES) graph, capturing the event together with its surrounding state transitions. These graphs are merged into a global Event Knowledge Graph and stored in a dual-store memory that supports both semantic matching and causal-topological retrieval. On top of this memory, we design a bidirectional retrieval strategy to efficiently identify the most relevant event causal chains and provide them, together with the associated video evidence, to a backbone video foundation model for answer generation. Experiments on long-video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that Event-Causal RAG consistently outperforms strong clip-based retrieval baselines and long-context video models, particularly on questions requiring multi-event integration and causal inference across long temporal gaps, while also achieving improved memory efficiency and robust streaming performance.

item.title: The Granularity Axis: A Micro-to-Macro Latent Direction for Social Roles in Language Models
item.author: Qin, Chonghan, Feng, Xiachong, Song, Ziyun, Feng, Xiaocheng, Xiong, Jing, Kong, Lingpeng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究表明大型语言模型的内部表示编码了社会角色的粒度，从微观个体到宏观组织或国家。

背景: 大型语言模型经常被提示扮演各种社会角色，但它们是否编码了这些角色的粒度尚不清楚。

目的: 确定大型语言模型的内部表示是否编码了社会角色的粒度。

方法: 定义了一个基于对比的粒度轴，通过比较宏观和微观角色的隐藏状态来构建。在Qwen3-8B模型上构建了75个社会角色，分为5个粒度级别，收集了91200个响应。提取隐藏状态并投影到该轴上，同时测试了激活引导和模型间的可迁移性。

主要发现: 该轴与角色表示空间的主轴高度对齐，解释了大部分方差。角色投影随粒度级别单调递增，且在跨层、提示变体、数据集划分中保持稳定。该轴在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上具有可迁移性。沿该轴的激活引导能改变响应粒度，表明粒度是可因果操纵的。

结论: 社会角色粒度不仅是表面风格特征，更是角色条件化语言模型行为中一种结构化、有序且可因果操纵的潜在方向。

翻译: 大型语言模型经常被提示扮演从个人到机构的各种社会角色，但它们内部表示是否编码了这些角色的粒度（从微观个体体验到宏观组织、机构或国家推理）尚不清楚。我们证明了它们确实编码了。我们将基于对比的粒度轴定义为宏观和微观角色隐藏状态之间的差异。在Qwen3-8B中，该轴与角色表示空间的主轴余弦相似度为0.972，解释了52.6%的方差，表明粒度是组织提示社会角色的主导几何轴。我们在五个粒度级别上构建了75个社会角色，并在共享问题和提示变体上收集了91200个角色条件响应，然后提取角色级隐藏状态并将其投影到该轴上。角色投影在所有五个级别上单调递增，在层、提示变体、端点定义、保留分割和评分过滤子集中保持稳定，并转移到Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。该轴在因果上也相关：沿它的激活引导以预测方向改变响应粒度，在允许本地响应的提示上，Llama在五点宏观量表上从2.00移动到3.17。两个模型在可控性上有所不同，表明引导取决于每个模型的默认运行状态。总的来说，我们的发现表明社会角色粒度不仅仅是风格表面特征，而是角色条件化语言模型行为中一种结构化、有序且可因果操纵的潜在方向。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) are routinely prompted to take on social roles ranging from individuals to institutions, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations encode the granularity of such roles, from micro-level individual experience to macro-level organizational, institutional, or national reasoning. We show that they do. We define a contrast-based Granularity Axis as the difference between mean macro- and micro-role hidden states. In Qwen3-8B, this axis aligns with the principal axis (PC1) of the role representation space at cosine 0.972 and accounts for 52.6% of its variance, indicating that granularity is the dominant geometric axis organizing prompted social roles. We construct 75 social roles across five granularity levels and collect 91,200 role-conditioned responses over shared questions and prompt variants, then extract role-level hidden states and project them onto the axis. Role projections increase monotonically across all five levels, remain stable across layers, prompt variants, endpoint definitions, held-out splits, and score-filtered subsets, and transfer to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The axis is also causally relevant: activation steering along it shifts response granularity in the predicted direction, with Llama moving from 2.00 to 3.17 on a five-point macro scale under positive steering on prompts that admit local responses. The two models differ in controllability, suggesting that steering depends on each model's default operating regime. Overall, our findings suggest that social role granularity is not merely a stylistic surface feature, but a structured, ordered, and causally manipulable latent direction in role-conditioned language model behavior.

item.title: TIDE: Every Layer Knows the Token Beneath the Context
item.author: Jaiswal, Ajay, Hannah, Lauren, Kim, Han-Byul, Hoang, Duc, Farajtabar, Mehrdad, Cho, Minsik
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出 TIDE 方法，通过引入 EmbeddingMemory 解决现代大语言模型中单次注入假设导致的结构性问题，并提升模型性能。

背景: 现代大语言模型普遍存在一种设计选择：token 索引仅在输入嵌入层查找一次，随后被丢弃。这种单次注入假设导致了两个结构性缺陷。

目的: 旨在解决单次注入假设带来的两个结构性缺陷，并提升模型在语言建模和下游任务中的表现。

方法: 提出了一种名为 TIDE 的方法。它通过 EmbeddingMemory 扩展标准 Transformer，利用 K 个独立的 MemoryBlock 将 token 索引映射为上下文无关的语义向量，并通过深度条件化的 softmax 路由器和可学习的空银行注入到每一层。

主要发现: 理论和实验均表明，TIDE 能够解决与单 token 身份注入相关的问题，并在多种语言建模和下游任务中提高了性能。

结论: TIDE 成功解决了单次注入假设带来的结构性问题，并有效提升了模型性能。

翻译: 我们重新审视了现代大语言模型中普遍接受但研究不足的设计选择：token 索引仅在输入嵌入层查找一次，随后被永久丢弃。这种单次注入假设导致了两个结构性缺陷：一是稀有词问题，由于词汇的 Zipf 型分布，稀有词的嵌入由于接收到的累积梯度信号少于常见词，导致长期训练不足；二是上下文坍塌问题，参数有限的模型将分布相似的 token 映射为无法区分的隐藏状态。作为解决这两个问题的尝试，我们提出了 TIDE，它通过 EmbeddingMemory 扩展标准 Transformer：这是一个由 K 个独立的 MemoryBlock 组成的集合，用于将 token 索引映射为上下文无关的语义向量，这些向量计算一次并通过深度条件化的 softmax 路由器和可学习的空银行注入到每一层。我们在理论和实验上确立了 TIDE 在解决与单 token 身份注入相关的问题方面的益处，以及在多种语言建模和下游任务中提高性能的效果。

深度解读

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

We revisit a universally accepted but under-examined design choice in every modern LLM: a token index is looked up once at the input embedding layer and then permanently discarded. This single-injection assumption induces two structural failures: (i) the Rare Token Problem, where a Zipf-type distribution of vocabulary causes rare-token embeddings are chronically under-trained due to receiving a fraction of the cumulative gradient signal compared to common tokens; and (ii) the Contextual Collapse Problem, where limited parameters models map distributionally similar tokens to indistinguishable hidden states. As an attempt to address both, we propose TIDE, which augments the standard transformer with EmbeddingMemory: an ensemble of K independent MemoryBlocks that map token indices to context-free semantic vectors, computed once and injected into every layer through a depth-conditioned softmax router with a learnable null bank. We theoretically and empirically establish the benefits of TIDE in addressing the issues associated with single-token identity injection as well as improve performance across multiple language modeling and downstream tasks.

item.title: UniPrefill: Universal Long-Context Prefill Acceleration via Block-wise Dynamic Sparsification
item.author: Qihang Fan, Huaibo Huang, Zhiying Wu, Bingning Wang, Ran He
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 UniPrefill 的预填充加速框架，适用于多种模型架构，并实现了与 vLLM 的无缝集成。

背景: 随着大型语言模型能力的提升，它们对更长的上下文长度需求增加。虽然提出了混合架构来减轻计算负担，但现有的稀疏注意力机制仅在全注意力模型上有效，且难以集成到现代推理引擎中。

目的: 为了解决现有长上下文预填充加速方法在混合架构上性能下降且不兼容连续批处理的问题，提出一种通用的加速框架。

方法: 提出 UniPrefill 框架，在 token 级别直接加速模型计算，并将其作为连续批处理算子实现，扩展了 vLLM 的调度策略以支持预填充-解码协同处理和张量并行。

主要发现: UniPrefill 在首字生成时间上实现了高达 2.1 倍的加速，且随着并发请求数量的增加，加速效果更加明显。

结论: 该方法成功解决了现有方法的局限性，实现了高效的推理加速和系统集成。

翻译: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance rapidly, they are becoming increasingly capable while simultaneously demanding ever-longer context lengths. To improve the inference efficiency of long-context processing, several novel low-complexity hybrid architectures have recently been proposed, effectively alleviating the computational burden of long-context inference. However, existing research on long-context prefill acceleration remains predominantly focused on sparse attention mechanisms, which achieve their maximum speedup only on full-attention models. When transferred to emerging architectures--such as linear/full attention hybrids or sliding window/full attention hybrids--these prefill acceleration approaches suffer significant performance degradation. Furthermore, such methods are generally incompatible with continuous batching, making them difficult to integrate into modern inference engines such as vLLM. To this end, we propose UniPrefill, a prefill acceleration framework applicable to virtually any model architecture, which directly accelerates the model's computation at the token level. We further implement UniPrefill as a continuous batching operator and extend vLLM's scheduling strategy to natively support prefill-decode co-processing and tensor parallel for UniPrefill, enabling its seamless integration into vLLM. UniPrefill achieves up to 2.1x speedup in Time-To-First-Token (TTFT), with the acceleration becoming increasingly pronounced as the number of concurrent requests grows.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决长上下文模型在预填充阶段的计算效率问题。它提出了一种基于块级动态稀疏化的方法来加速这一过程。这个问题很重要，因为长上下文模型在处理长文本时速度较慢，加速预填充能显著降低延迟，提升用户体验。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过分块动态稀疏化技术，加速大模型在处理长上下文时的预填充阶段。整体实现流程是将输入序列划分为多个块，然后根据重要性动态筛选出需要重点处理的块，跳过或简化处理不重要的块，从而在不显著降低性能的前提下提升计算效率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为UniPrefill的通用方法，通过基于块的动态稀疏化技术，实现了对长上下文预填充过程的加速。

Abstract

As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance rapidly, they are becoming increasingly capable while simultaneously demanding ever-longer context lengths. To improve the inference efficiency of long-context processing, several novel low-complexity hybrid architectures have recently been proposed, effectively alleviating the computational burden of long-context inference. However, existing research on long-context prefill acceleration remains predominantly focused on sparse attention mechanisms, which achieve their maximum speedup only on full-attention models. When transferred to emerging architectures--such as linear/full attention hybrids or sliding window/full attention hybrids--these prefill acceleration approaches suffer significant performance degradation. Furthermore, such methods are generally incompatible with continuous batching, making them difficult to integrate into modern inference engines such as vLLM. To this end, we propose UniPrefill, a prefill acceleration framework applicable to virtually any model architecture, which directly accelerates the model's computation at the token level. We further implement UniPrefill as a continuous batching operator and extend vLLM's scheduling strategy to natively support prefill-decode co-processing and tensor parallel for UniPrefill, enabling its seamless integration into vLLM. UniPrefill achieves up to 2.1x speedup in Time-To-First-Token (TTFT), with the acceleration becoming increasingly pronounced as the number of concurrent requests grows.

item.title: When to Trust Imagination: Adaptive Action Execution for World Action Models
item.author: Wang, Rui, Zhang, Yue, Lin, Jiehong, Luo, Kuncheng, Wang, Jianan, Wang, Zhongrui, Qi, Xiaojuan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种自适应的 World Action Models (WAMs) 执行方法，通过 Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention (FFDC) 验证预测与现实的匹配度，从而动态调整动作执行长度。

背景: World Action Models (WAMs) 是一种通过联合预测未来视觉观测和动作的机器人操作范式。但现有方法通常执行固定数量的预测动作，无法感知预测的未来是否与实际物理执行一致。

目的: 将自适应 WAM 执行形式化为未来与现实验证问题，使机器人在预测可靠时执行更长时间，在现实偏离想象时提前重新规划。

方法: 提出了 Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention (FFDC)，这是一个轻量级验证器，联合推理预测的未来动作、视觉动态、真实观测和语言指令，以估计剩余动作执行的可信度。同时引入了 Mixture-of-Horizon Training 来提高长轨迹覆盖。

主要发现: 在 RoboTwin 基准测试中，方法减少了 69.10% 的 WAM 前向传播次数和 34.02% 的执行时间，同时成功率达到 2.54%。在真实世界实验中，成功率达到 35%。

结论: 该方法实现了鲁棒性与效率的良好平衡，在保持长时序执行效率的同时，在接触丰富或困难阶段恢复了响应性。

翻译: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation by jointly predicting future visual observations and future actions. However, current WAMs typically execute a fixed number of predicted actions after each model inference, leaving the robot blind to whether the imagined future remains consistent with the actual physical rollout. In this work, we formulate adaptive WAM execution as a future-reality verification problem: the robot should execute longer when the WAM-predicted future remains reliable, and replan earlier when reality deviates from imagination. To this end, we propose Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention (FFDC), a lightweight verifier that jointly reasons over predicted future actions, predicted visual dynamics, real observations, and language instructions to estimate whether the remaining action rollout can still be trusted. FFDC enables adaptive action chunk sizes as an emergent consequence of prediction-observation consistency, preserving the efficiency of long-horizon execution while restoring responsiveness in contact-rich or difficult phases. We further introduce Mixture-of-Horizon Training to improve long-horizon trajectory coverage for adaptive execution. Experiments on the RoboTwin benchmark and in the real world demonstrate that our method achieves a strong robustness-efficiency trade-off: on RoboTwin, it reduces WAM forward passes by 69.10% and execution time by 34.02%, while improving success rate by 2.54% over the short-chunk baseline; in real-world experiments, it improves success rate by 35%.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是在执行动作之前，如何判断“想象”或预测的准确性，即何时信任世界模型生成的预测结果的问题。在现实机器人技术中，预测模型往往存在误差，如果盲目信任预测，机器人容易在复杂环境中失败；只有学会判断何时该相信预测、何时该采取保守策略，才能让机器人在真实世界中安全、高效地完成任务。

However, current WAMs typically execute a fixed number of predicted actions after each model inference, leaving the robot blind to whether the imagined future remains consistent with the actual physical rollout. In this work, we formulate adaptive WAM execution as a future-reality verification problem: the robot should execute longer when the WAM-predicted future remains reliable, and replan earlier when reality deviates from imagination. To this end, we propose Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention (FFDC), a lightweight verifier that jointly reasons over predicted future actions, predicted visual dynamics, real observations, and language instructions to estimate whether the remaining action rollout can still be trusted. FFDC enables adaptive action chunk sizes as an emergent consequence of prediction-observation consistency, preserving the efficiency of long-horizon execution while restoring responsiveness in contact-rich or difficult phases. We further introduce Mixture-of-Horizon Training to improve long-horizon trajectory coverage for adaptive execution. Experiments on the RoboTwin benchmark and in the real world demonstrate that our method achieves a strong robustness-efficiency trade-off: on RoboTwin, it reduces WAM forward passes by 69.10% and execution time by 34.02%, while improving success rate by 2.54% over the short-chunk baseline; in real-world experiments, it improves success rate by 35%.

item.title: Rethinking RL for LLM Reasoning: It's Sparse Policy Selection, Not Capability Learning
item.author: Akgül, Ömer Faruk, Kannan, Rajgopal, Neiswanger, Willie, Prasanna, Viktor
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文通过分析强化学习在大型语言模型推理中的作用，发现RL并非教授新策略，而是重新分配概率。基于此，作者提出了一种无需RL的轻量级方法ReasonMaxxer，在保持性能的同时大幅降低了训练成本。

背景: 强化学习已成为提升大型语言模型推理能力的标准方法，但证据表明RL可能并未教授新策略，而是重新分配了基础模型已知的解的概率质量。

目的: 探讨如果强化学习仅仅是引导模型走向其已知路径，那么强化学习的优化循环本身是否是必要的。

方法: 作者通过分析多个模型家族和强化学习算法的token级别数据，发现RL的影响集中在高熵决策点。基于此，提出了ReasonMaxxer方法，该方法仅在熵门控的决策点应用对比损失，使用少量基础模型样本进行训练，无需在线生成。

主要发现: 1. RL的有益影响是稀疏的，仅影响1到3%的token位置。2. 被修正的token总是位于基础模型的top-5替代方案中。3. 基础模型的熵可以识别这些位置。4. 整个修正过程是低维的，仅需模型参数的一小部分。5. 针对这些位置的修正能恢复大部分准确率增益。

结论: 推理改进可以被重新定义为稀疏策略选择而非能力获取。提出的ReasonMaxxer方法在多个模型家族和数学推理基准测试中匹配或超过了全强化学习性能，且训练成本降低了三个数量级。

翻译: Reinforcement learning has become the standard for improving reasoning in large language models, yet evidence increasingly suggests that RL does not teach new strategies; it redistributes probability mass over solutions the base model already contains. In this work, we ask: if RL merely steers the model toward paths it already knows, is the RL optimization loop itself necessary? Through token-level analysis across multiple model families and RL algorithms, we find that RL's beneficial footprint is a sparse, predictable correction concentrated at high-entropy decision points where the model is uncertain which branch to take. Only 1--3% of token positions are affected, the promoted token always lies within the base model's top-5 alternatives, and targeted corrections at those few positions causally recover a large fraction of RL's accuracy gain, while random corrections fail. The base model's own entropy identifies these positions without any RL-trained model, and the entire correction is low-dimensional, representable in a tiny fraction of model parameters. These findings reframe reasoning improvement as sparse policy selection, not capability acquisition. We translate this insight into ReasonMaxxer, a minimal RL-free method that applies contrastive loss only at entropy-gated decision points, using a few hundred base-model rollouts and no online generation. Across three model families, six scales, and six math reasoning benchmarks, ReasonMaxxer matches or exceeds full RL performance while requiring only tens of problems and minutes of single-GPU training, a reduction in training cost of roughly three orders of magnitude.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文重新思考了强化学习在大型语言模型推理中的作用，提出推理能力的提升并非源于模型能力的习得，而是通过在预定义的稀疏策略之间进行选择实现的。

Abstract

Reinforcement learning has become the standard for improving reasoning in large language models, yet evidence increasingly suggests that RL does not teach new strategies; it redistributes probability mass over solutions the base model already contains. In this work, we ask: if RL merely steers the model toward paths it already knows, is the RL optimization loop itself necessary? Through token-level analysis across multiple model families and RL algorithms, we find that RL's beneficial footprint is a sparse, predictable correction concentrated at high-entropy decision points where the model is uncertain which branch to take. Only 1--3\% of token positions are affected, the promoted token always lies within the base model's top-5 alternatives, and targeted corrections at those few positions causally recover a large fraction of RL's accuracy gain, while random corrections fail. The base model's own entropy identifies these positions without any RL-trained model, and the entire correction is low-dimensional, representable in a tiny fraction of model parameters. These findings reframe reasoning improvement as sparse policy selection, not capability acquisition. We translate this insight into ReasonMaxxer, a minimal RL-free method that applies contrastive loss only at entropy-gated decision points, using a few hundred base-model rollouts and no online generation. Across three model families, six scales, and six math reasoning benchmarks, ReasonMaxxer matches or exceeds full RL performance while requiring only tens of problems and minutes of single-GPU training, a reduction in training cost of roughly three orders of magnitude.

item.title: Modality-Aware Contrastive and Uncertainty-Regularized Emotion Recognition
item.author: Yan Zhuang, Minhao Liu, Yanru Zhang, Jiawen Deng, Fuji Ren
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种模态感知对比与不确定性正则化框架，用于解决多模态情感识别中的异构模态组合问题。

背景: 随着人机交互的快速发展，多模态情感识别受到广泛关注。然而，不同模态在语义、质量和可用性上存在显著差异，导致模态组合高度异构，给情感理解带来挑战。

目的: 提出模态感知对比与不确定性正则化框架，旨在通过表示一致性视角，实现跨异构模态组合的鲁棒情感预测。

方法: 包含两个核心组件：一是基于模态组合和类别的对比学习机制，促使具有相同情感类别和可用模态的样本在表示空间中靠近；二是样本级不确定性引导的正则化，自适应分配样本权重以优化训练。

主要发现: 实验表明，MCUR 优于现有方法，在 MOSI 数据集上平均 F1 增益为 2.2%，在 MOSEI 数据集上为 2.67%，在 IEMOCAP 数据集上为 4.37%。

结论: MCUR 框架能够有效解决异构模态组合带来的挑战，实现一致且可靠的情感理解。

翻译: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) has attracted growing attention with the rapid advancement of human-computer interaction. However, different modalities exhibit substantial discrepancies in semantics, quality, and availability, leading to highly heterogeneous modality combinations and posing significant challenges to achieving consistent and reliable emotion understanding. To address this challenge, we propose the Modality-Aware Contrastive and Uncertainty-Regularized (MCUR) framework, which approaches MER from the perspective of representation consistency, aiming to enable robust emotion prediction across heterogeneous modality combinations. MCUR incorporates two core components: (1) Modality Combination-Based and Category-Based Contrastive Learning mechanism (MCB-CL), which encourages samples with the same emotion category and the same available modalities to be close in the representation space; and (2) Sample-wise Uncertainty-Guided Regularization (SUGR), which adaptively assigns sample-wise uncertain weights to samples to optimize training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MCUR consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving average F1 gains of 2.2% on MOSI, 2.67% on MOSEI, and 4.37% on IEMOCAP.

Abstract

Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) has attracted growing attention with the rapid advancement of human-computer interaction. However, different modalities exhibit substantial discrepancies in semantics, quality, and availability, leading to highly heterogeneous modality combinations and posing significant challenges to achieving consistent and reliable emotion understanding. To address this challenge, we propose the Modality-Aware Contrastive and Uncertainty-Regularized (MCUR) framework, which approaches MER from the perspective of representation consistency, aiming to enable robust emotion prediction across heterogeneous modality combinations. MCUR incorporates two core components: (1) Modality Combination-Based and Category-Based Contrastive Learning mechanism (MCB-CL), which encourages samples with the same emotion category and the same available modalities to be close in the representation space; and (2) Sample-wise Uncertainty-Guided Regularization (SUGR), which adaptively assigns sample-wise uncertain weights to samples to optimize training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MCUR consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving average F1 gains of 2.2% on MOSI, 2.67% on MOSEI, and 4.37% on IEMOCAP.

item.title: On-Orbit Real-Time Wildfire Detection Under On-Board Constraints
item.author: Matthias Rötzer, Veronika Pörtge, Martin Ickerott, Jayendra Praveen Kumar Chorapalli, Dimitri Scheftelowitsch, Max Bereczky, Dmitry Rashkovetsky, Sai Manoj Appalla, Julia Gottfriedsen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种部署在九星商业热红外星座上的在轨野火检测系统，通过轻量级密集表示学习方法，在极端类别不平衡条件下实现了高效检测。

背景: 现有的MODIS和VIIRS等操作监测系统使用上下文热阈值管道，无法处理未校准的MWIR单波段图像，且在极端类别不平衡下，野火常表现为亚像素或单像素热异常。

目的: 针对在轨野火检测的苛刻约束，研究轻量级密集表示学习方法，以解决未校准MWIR图像中野火检测的难题。

方法: 使用专有的九星MWIR数据集，比较密集掩码自编码DenseMAE和混合DenseMAE+EMA指数移动平均蒸馏变体，通过线性探测和全分布像素级平均精度评估表示。

主要发现: DenseMAE预训练使下游模型在延迟-精度帕累托前沿上更加紧凑；最快模型达到0.640测试AP和0.69事件级Fire-F1，延迟65.34毫秒，引擎0.52MB；最佳配置达到0.699 AP和0.744 Fire-F1，低于1MB，优于监督基线。

结论: 该系统在满足模型大小和推理延迟的苛刻约束下，通过SSL预训练显著提升了检测性能。

翻译: 我们提出了一种部署在九星商业热红外星座上的在轨野火检测系统，在苛刻的联合约束下运行：亚兆字节模型足迹，NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX上每批次亚150毫秒的TensorRT FP16推理，以及端到端告警管道，目标是从卫星飞越到火情通信在10分钟以内。该系统在200米地面采样距离下处理未校准的中波红外MWIR单波段图像，其中野火在极端类别不平衡下经常表现为亚像素或单像素热异常——这是目前主导操作火情监测的上下文热阈值管道MODIS、VIIRS所未解决的问题。我们使用专有的九星MWIR数据集，针对该领域进行了轻量级密集表示学习的实证研究。我们比较了密集掩码自编码DenseMAE和混合DenseMAE+EMA指数移动平均蒸馏变体，并通过线性探测和全分布像素级平均精度AP在极端类别不平衡下评估表示。DenseMAE预训练使下游模型在延迟-精度帕累托前沿上更加紧凑：我们最快的SSL预训练模型达到0.640测试AP和0.69事件级Fire-F1，每批次延迟65.34毫秒，引擎0.52MB，无需剪枝或压缩。最佳配置达到0.699 AP和0.744 Fire-F1，低于1MB，在可比约束下优于监督基线0.650 AP。

Abstract

We present a deployed system for on-orbit wildfire detection aboard a nine-satellite commercial thermal infrared constellation, operating under demanding joint constraints: sub-megabyte model footprint, sub-150 ms per-batch TensorRT FP16 inference on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX, and an end-to-end alert pipeline targeting under 10 minutes from satellite overpass to fire event communication. The system operates on uncalibrated mid-wave infrared (MWIR) single-band imagery at 200 m ground sampling distance, where fires frequently appear as sub-pixel or single-pixel thermal anomalies under extreme class imbalance -- challenges not addressed by the contextual thermal-thresholding pipelines (MODIS, VIIRS) that currently dominate operational fire monitoring. We present an empirical study of lightweight dense representation learning for this regime using a proprietary nine-satellite MWIR dataset. We compare dense masked autoencoding (DenseMAE) and a hybrid DenseMAE+EMA (exponential moving average) distillation variant, and evaluate representations via linear probing and full-distribution pixel-level average precision (AP) under extreme class imbalance. DenseMAE pretraining enables compact downstream models on the latency-accuracy Pareto frontier: our fastest SSL-pretrained model achieves 0.640 test AP and 0.69 event-level Fire-F1 with 65.34 ms latency per batch and a 0.52 MB engine, without pruning or compression. The best configuration reaches 0.699 AP and 0.744 Fire-F1 below 1 MB, outperforming a supervised baseline (0.650 AP) under comparable constraints.

item.title: Molecules Meet Language: Confound-Aware Representation Learning and Chemical Property Steering in Transformer-VAE Latent Spaces
item.author: Zakaria Elabid, Jan Andrzejewski, Bartosz Brzoza, Attila Cangi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究分子生成模型中潜在空间的化学组织性，通过引入混淆感知评估方法，验证了在纠缠的潜在空间中实现化学性质引导的可行性。

背景: 分子生成模型通常假设潜在空间具有有意义的几何结构，但表面上的性质可预测性可能反映的是序列级别的捷径而非化学组织。

目的: 研究在无监督自回归 Transformer-VAE 模型中，如何分离化学信号与 SELFIES 伪影，并验证化学性质引导是否有效。

方法: 在训练好的无监督自回归 Transformer-VAE 上冻结模型，使用线性探针拟合 RDKit 描述符，并将探针权重作为候选全局引导方向。引入基于残差化、伪影方向对齐分析和解码分子遍历的混淆感知评估方法。

主要发现: 在混淆感知评估下，发现对 cLogP、FractionCSP3、HeavyAtomCount、TPSA、BertzCT 和 HBA 具有稳健的单调引导。非线性探针显示某些性质具有稳定的全局方向，而其他性质更适合用局部潜在梯度描述。

结论: 化学上有意义的引导可以在纠缠的分子潜在空间中涌现，但只有通过解码分子验证并控制表示级别的混淆时才会发生。

翻译: 分子生成模型通常假设潜在空间具有有意义的几何结构，但表面上的性质可预测性可能反映的是序列级别的捷径而非化学组织。我们在基于 SELFIES 训练的无监督自回归 Transformer-VAE 中研究了这一问题。训练后，我们冻结模型，使用线性探针拟合 RDKit 描述符，并将探针权重作为候选全局引导方向。为了将化学信号与 SELFIES 伪影分离，我们引入了基于残差化、伪影方向对齐分析和解码分子遍历的混淆感知评估。这是必要的，因为 SELFIES 长度、分支标记、环标记和标记熵在潜在空间中编码得非常强。在这种混淆感知评估下，我们发现对 cLogP、FractionCSP3、HeavyAtomCount、TPSA、BertzCT 和 HBA 具有稳健的单调引导。非线性探针进一步显示，某些性质允许稳定的全局方向，而其他性质更适合用局部潜在梯度描述。总的来说，我们的结果表明，化学上有意义的引导可以在纠缠的分子潜在空间中涌现，但只有通过解码分子验证并控制表示级别的混淆时才会发生。

Abstract

Molecular generative models often assume meaningful latent geometry, but apparent property predictability can reflect sequence-level shortcuts rather than chemical organization. We study this issue in an unsupervised autoregressive Transformer-VAE trained on SELFIES. After training, we freeze the model, fit linear probes to RDKit descriptors, and use the probe weights as candidate global steering directions. To separate chemical signal from SELFIES artifacts, we introduce a confound-aware evaluation based on residualization, confound-direction alignment analysis, and decoded-molecule traversal. This is necessary because SELFIES length, branch tokens, ring tokens, and token entropy are strongly encoded in the latent space. Under this confound-aware evaluation, we find robust monotonic steering for cLogP, FractionCSP3, HeavyAtomCount, TPSA, BertzCT, and HBA. Nonlinear probes further show that some properties admit stable global directions, while others are better described by local latent gradients. Overall, our results show that chemically meaningful steering can emerge in entangled molecular latent spaces, but only when validated through decoded molecules and controlled for representation-level confounds.

item.title: Topological Signatures of Grokking
item.author: Yifan Tang, Qiquan Wang, Inés García-Redondo, Anthea Monod
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 通过拓扑学视角研究grokking现象，利用持久同调分析模型嵌入矩阵，发现拓扑特征变化与泛化而非记忆相关。

背景: 研究神经网络在训练过程中出现的grokking现象，以及现有的谱和几何诊断方法的局限性。

目的: 识别grokking现象的拓扑签名，提供一种统一的几何和拓扑表征框架来分析表示学习。

方法: 使用持久同调分析点云，这些点云由在模运算上训练的多种模型的嵌入矩阵导出。

主要发现: 发现grokking的拓扑签名是第一同调的最大和总持久性的急剧增加；持久图显示主导的长寿命拓扑特征的出现；拓扑转换与泛化而非记忆相关。

结论: 持久同调为分析神经网络在训练期间如何内化潜在结构提供了一个原则性和可解释的框架。

翻译: 我们通过拓扑学的视角研究grokking现象。通过在一系列在模运算上训练且质数变化的模型嵌入矩阵导出的点云上使用持久同调，我们识别出了grokking的一个清晰且一致的拓扑签名：第一同调的最大和总持久性的急剧增加。持久图揭示了主导的长寿命拓扑特征的出现，以及日益结构化的次要特征，反映了任务的潜在循环结构。与现有的谱和几何诊断——特别是傅里叶分析和局部内在维数——相比，持久同调为表示学习提供了统一的几何和拓扑表征，捕捉了局部和全局的多尺度结构。跨数据集和控制设置的消融实验表明，这些拓扑转换与泛化而非记忆相关。我们的结果表明，持久同调为分析神经网络在训练期间如何内化潜在结构提供了一个原则性和可解释的框架。

Abstract

We study the grokking phenomenon through the lens of topology. Using persistent homology on point clouds derived from the embedding matrices of a range of models trained on modular arithmetic with varying primes, we identify a clear and consistent topological signature of grokking: a sharp increase in both the maximum and total persistence of first homology ($H_1$). Persistence diagrams reveal the emergence of a dominant long-lived topological feature together with increasingly structured secondary features, reflecting the underlying cyclic structure of the task. Compared to existing spectral and geometric diagnostics -- specifically, Fourier analysis and local intrinsic dimension -- persistent homology provides a unified geometric and topological characterization of representation learning, capturing both local and global multi-scale structure. Ablations across data regimes and control settings show that these topological transitions are tied to generalization rather than memorization. Our results suggest that persistent homology offers a principled and interpretable framework for analyzing how neural networks internalize latent structure during training.

item.title: SwiftI2V: Efficient High-Resolution Image-to-Video Generation via Conditional Segment-wise Generation
item.author: Liu, YaoYang, Zhang, Yuechen, Li, Wenbo, Zhao, Yufei, Liu, Rui, Chen, Long
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SwiftI2V 是一个高效的高分辨率图像到视频生成框架，通过两阶段设计和条件分段生成技术，在保持性能的同时大幅降低了计算开销。

背景: 高分辨率图像到视频生成在 2K 分辨率下极具挑战性。现有方法存在两个主要弱点：端到端模型内存和延迟过高，以及级联低分辨率生成后使用通用视频超分辨率会导致细节幻觉和结构漂移。

目的: 提出一种名为 SwiftI2V 的框架，旨在解决高分辨率 I2V 生成中的效率与保真度之间的矛盾，实现实用的 2K 分辨率生成。

方法: SwiftI2V 采用两阶段设计。首先生成低分辨率运动参考以降低代币成本和建模负担；然后基于运动引导进行强图像条件下的 2K 合成。具体技术包括条件分段生成（CSG）以控制每步代币预算，以及分段内的双向上下文交互以增强跨段连贯性和输入保真度。

主要发现: 在 VBench-I2V 的 2K 分辨率测试中，SwiftI2V 的性能与端到端基线相当，但总 GPU 时间减少了 202 倍。它支持在单张数据中心 GPU（如 H800）或消费级 GPU（如 RTX 4090）上实现实用的 2K I2V 生成。

结论: SwiftI2V 成功实现了高分辨率图像到视频的高效生成，证明了其在大规模部署上的可行性。

翻译: High-resolution image-to-video (I2V) generation aims to synthesize realistic temporal dynamics while preserving fine-grained appearance details of the input image. At 2K resolution, it becomes extremely challenging, and existing solutions suffer from various weaknesses: 1) end-to-end models are often prohibitively expensive in memory and latency; 2) cascading low-resolution generation with a generic video super-resolution tends to hallucinate details and drift from input-specific local structures, since the super-resolution stage is not explicitly conditioned on the input image. To this end, we propose SwiftI2V, an efficient framework tailored for high-resolution I2V. Following the widely used two-stage design, it addresses the efficiency--fidelity dilemma by first generating a low-resolution motion reference to reduce token costs and ease the modeling burden, then performing a strongly image-conditioned 2K synthesis guided by the motion to recover input-faithful details with controlled overhead. Specifically, to make generation more scalable, SwiftI2V introduces Conditional Segment-wise Generation (CSG) to synthesize videos segment-by-segment with a bounded per-step token budget, and adopts bidirectional contextual interaction within each segment to improve cross-segment coherence and input fidelity. On VBench-I2V at 2K resolution, SwiftI2V achieves performance comparable to end-to-end baselines while reducing total GPU-time by 202x. Particularly, it enables practical 2K I2V generation on a single datacenter GPU (e.g., H800) or consumer GPU (e.g., RTX 4090).

item.title: Preliminary Insights in Chronos Frequency Data Understanding and Reconstruction
item.author: Pagani, Alessandro, Cominelli, Marco, Han, Liying, Dong, Gaofeng, Benini, Sergio, Gringoli, Francesco, Savardi, Mattia, Srivastava, Mani B., Bihl, Trevor, Blasch, Erik P., Brigham, Daniel O., Combs, Kara, Kaplan, Lance M., Cerutti, Federico
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文分析了 Chronos 基础模型处理和内部表示频域信息的能力。

背景: 时间序列基础模型能减少特征工程需求，但它们如何编码基本信号属性（如频率）尚未得到充分表征。

目的: 通过在受控条件下分析 Chronos，特别是从离散正弦波开始，测试模型内部表示中频率信息的存在性和可分性。

方法: 使用轻量级在线最小描述长度探针应用于解码器架构，测试频率信息的存在性和可分性。

主要发现: 结果提供了关于频谱内容如何被捕获的见解，并突出了表示质量可能下降或需要特别关注的区域。

结论: 这些发现为 Chronos 在信号处理和信息融合背景下的用户提供了实用指导，并有助于提高时间序列基础模型的可解释性和评估。

翻译: 本文对 Chronos 基础模型处理和内部表示频域信息的能力进行了初步分析。处理时间序列数据的基础模型为从业者提供了一种统一架构，能够跨不同任务和领域学习通用的时间表示，减少了对特定任务特征工程的需求，并实现了跨信号模态的迁移。尽管这些模型日益普及，但此类模型编码基本信号属性的程度仍未得到充分表征。我们通过在受控条件下分析 Chronos 来解决这一差距，从最简单的信号类别开始：在固定频率下生成的离散正弦波。使用应用于解码器架构的轻量级在线最小描述长度探针，我们测试了模型内部表示中频率信息的存在性和可分性。结果提供了关于频谱内容如何被捕获的见解，并突出了表示质量可能下降或需要特别关注的区域。这些发现为 Chronos 在信号处理和信息融合背景下的用户提供了实用指导，并有助于提高时间序列基础模型的可解释性和评估的持续努力。

Abstract

This paper presents a preliminary analysis of the ability of Chronos foundation model to process and internally represent frequency domain information. Foundation models that process time-series data offer practitioners a unified architecture capable of learning generic temporal representations across diverse tasks and domains, reducing the need for task-specific feature engineering and enabling transfer across signal modalities. Despite their growing adoption, the extent to which such models encode fundamental signal properties remains insufficiently characterised. We address this gap by analysing Chronos under controlled conditions, starting from the simplest class of signals: discrete sinusoids generated at fixed frequencies. Using lightweight online minimum description length probes applied to the decoder architecture, we test for the presence and separability of frequency information in the model's internal representations. The results provide insight into how frequential content is captured across the frequency spectrum and highlight regimes in which representation quality may degrade or require particular care. These findings offer practical guidance for users of Chronos in signal processing and information fusion contexts, and contribute to ongoing efforts to improve the interpretability and evaluation of foundation models for temporal data.

item.title: Continuous-Time Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
item.author: Liu, Tao, Yan, Hao, Chen, Mengting, Hu, Taihang, Yue, Zhengrong, Pan, Zihao, Lan, Jinsong, Zhu, Xiaoyong, Cheng, Ming-Ming, Zheng, Bo, Wang, Yaxing
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种连续时间分布匹配方法，用于加速扩散模型，通过将离散锚定迁移到连续优化来提升图像生成的视觉保真度。

背景: Step distillation 是加速扩散模型的主流技术。DMD 和 Consistency Distillation 是两种代表性范式。Vanilla DMD 依赖离散时间步的稀疏监督，其离散时间 formulation 和反向 KL 散度的模式寻求特性导致视觉伪影和过度平滑，通常需要复杂的辅助模块（如 GANs 或奖励模型）来恢复视觉保真度。

目的: 为了解决 vanilla DMD 的离散时间限制和由此产生的视觉伪影问题，本文提出了一种连续时间分布匹配方法。

方法: 引入 Continuous-Time Distribution Matching (CDM)。通过两个连续时间设计实现：1. 用动态连续随机长度调度替换固定离散调度，在采样轨迹的任意点强制分布匹配；2. 提出连续时间对齐目标，在学生速度场外推的潜在空间上进行主动非轨迹匹配。

主要发现: 在 SD3-Medium 和 Longcat-Image 等不同架构上的广泛实验表明，CDM 为少步图像生成提供了高度竞争力的视觉保真度，且无需依赖复杂的辅助目标。

结论: CDM 在不依赖复杂辅助模块的情况下，实现了高质量的少步图像生成。

翻译: Step distillation 已成为加速扩散模型的主流技术，其中分布匹配蒸馏和一致性蒸馏是两种代表性范式。虽然一致性方法在完整的 PF-ODE 轨迹上强制自一致性以引导其朝向干净数据流形，但 vanilla DMD 依赖在几个预定义的离散时间步上的稀疏监督。这种受限的离散时间 formulation 和反向 KL 散度的模式寻求特性往往表现出视觉伪影和过度平滑的输出，通常需要复杂的辅助模块——如 GANs 或奖励模型——来恢复视觉保真度。在这项工作中，我们引入了连续时间分布匹配，首次将 DMD 框架从离散锚定迁移到连续优化。CDM 通过两个连续时间设计实现。首先，我们将固定的离散调度替换为随机长度的动态连续调度，以便在采样轨迹的任意点而不是仅在几个固定锚点上强制分布匹配。其次，我们提出了一种连续时间对齐目标，在通过学生速度场外推的潜在空间上执行主动非轨迹匹配，提高了泛化能力并保留了精细的视觉细节。在不同架构（包括 SD3-Medium 和 Longcat-Image）上的广泛实验表明，CDM 为少步图像生成提供了高度竞争力的视觉保真度，而无需依赖复杂的辅助目标。代码可在该 https URL 获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决扩散模型生成图像时步数过多导致速度慢的问题。它通过蒸馏技术将生成过程压缩到更少的步骤。这很重要，因为减少步数能大幅提升生成速度，使模型在实际应用中更高效。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Step distillation has become a leading technique for accelerating diffusion models, among which Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) and Consistency Distillation are two representative paradigms. While consistency methods enforce self-consistency along the full PF-ODE trajectory to steer it toward the clean data manifold, vanilla DMD relies on sparse supervision at a few predefined discrete timesteps. This restricted discrete-time formulation and mode-seeking nature of the reverse KL divergence tends to exhibit visual artifacts and over-smoothed outputs, often necessitating complex auxiliary modules -- such as GANs or reward models -- to restore visual fidelity. In this work, we introduce Continuous-Time Distribution Matching (CDM), migrating the DMD framework from discrete anchoring to continuous optimization for the first time. CDM achieves this through two continuous-time designs. First, we replace the fixed discrete schedule with a dynamic continuous schedule of random length, so that distribution matching is enforced at arbitrary points along sampling trajectories rather than only at a few fixed anchors. Second, we propose a continuous-time alignment objective that performs active off-trajectory matching on latents extrapolated via the student's velocity field, improving generalization and preserving fine visual details. Extensive experiments on different architectures, including SD3-Medium and Longcat-Image, demonstrate that CDM provides highly competitive visual fidelity for few-step image generation without relying on complex auxiliary objectives. Code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Empirical Evidence for Simply Connected Decision Regions in Image Classifiers
item.author: Swaminathan, Arjhun, Akgün, Mete
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了深度神经网络决策区域的拓扑性质，特别是简单连通性。

背景: 理解决策区域的拓扑结构对于解释深度神经网络的工作原理至关重要。先前的实证工作已经表明这些区域是路径连通的。

目的: 研究更强的拓扑问题，即决策区域内的闭合环能否在不离开该区域的情况下收缩。

方法: 提出了一种迭代四边形网格填充程序，用于构建一个有限分辨率的标签保持表面，该表面由给定闭合环界定且完全位于同一决策区域内。此外，将此构建与自然 Coons 补丁连接，以量化其与环的规范几何插值的偏差。

主要发现: 通过在多个现代图像分类模型上评估该方法，提供了支持决策区域不仅是路径连通的，而且是简单连通的假设的经验证据。

结论: 深度神经网络中的决策区域不仅是路径连通的，而且是简单连通的。

翻译: 理解决策区域的拓扑结构对于解释深度神经网络的工作原理至关重要。先前的实证工作已经表明这些区域是路径连通的。我们研究了一个更强的拓扑问题：决策区域内的闭合环能否在不离开该区域的情况下收缩。为此，我们提出了一种迭代四边形网格填充程序，用于构建一个有限分辨率的标签保持表面，该表面由给定闭合环界定且完全位于同一决策区域内。我们进一步将此构建与自然 Coons 补丁连接，以量化其与环的规范几何插值的偏差。通过在多个现代图像分类模型上评估我们的方法，我们提供了支持决策区域不仅是路径连通的，而且是简单连通的假设的经验证据。

深度解读
