如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Understanding the topology of decision regions is central to explaining the inner workings of deep neural networks. Prior empirical work has provided evidence that these regions are path connected. We study a stronger topological question: whether closed loops inside a decision region can be contracted without leaving that region. To this end, we propose an iterative quad-mesh filling procedure that constructs a finite-resolution label-preserving surface bounded by a given loop and lying entirely within the same decision region. We further connect this construction to natural Coons patches in order to quantify its deviation from a canonical geometric interpolation of the loop. By evaluating our method across several modern image-classification models, we provide empirical evidence supporting the hypothesis that decision regions in deep neural networks are not only path connected, but also simply connected.

item.title: WavCube: Unifying Speech Representation for Understanding and Generation via Semantic-Acoustic Joint Modeling
item.author: Guanrou Yang, Tian Tan, Qian Chen, Zhikang Niu, Yakun Song, Ziyang Ma, Yushen Chen, Zeyu Xie, Tianrui Wang, Yifan Yang, Wenxi Chen, Qi Chen, Wenrui Liu, Shan Yang, Xie Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种紧凑的连续潜在表示 WavCube，同时支持语音理解、重建和生成。

背景: 语音理解和生成任务需要不同的表示，导致兼容性挑战。通常语义特征来自自监督学习，声学特征来自重建，碎片化的表示阻碍了统一系统的实现。

目的: 构建同时支持语音理解、重建和生成的统一语音模型。

方法: 采用两阶段训练方案。第一阶段通过语义瓶颈过滤离群点冗余；第二阶段通过端到端重建注入细粒度声学细节，并使用语义锚定损失保持语义流形。

主要发现: 在 SUPERB 上接近 WavLM 性能（压缩 8 倍）；重建质量与现有声学表示相当；零样本 TTS 性能达到最先进水平且收敛更快；在 SUPERB-SG 基准的语音增强、分离和语音转换任务中表现出色。

结论: 两阶段方法解决了 SSL 特征在生成建模中的缺陷，为未来统一语音系统铺平道路。

翻译: 整合语音理解和生成是构建统一语音模型的关键步骤。然而，这两个任务所需的表示形式不同，目前存在显著的兼容性挑战。通常，语义导向的特征来自自监督学习，而声学导向的特征来自重建。这种碎片化的表示阻碍了真正统一语音系统的实现。我们提出了 WavCube，一种源自 SSL 语音编码器的紧凑连续潜在表示，同时支持语音理解、重建和生成。WavCube 采用两阶段训练方案。第一阶段训练语义瓶颈以过滤离群点冗余，使原始 SSL 特征对扩散模型变得可行。第二阶段通过端到端重建注入细粒度声学细节，同时语义锚定损失确保表示保持在原始语义流形内。综合实验表明，尽管维度压缩了 8 倍，WavCube 在 SUPERB 上仍接近 WavLM 的性能，重建质量与现有声学表示相当，实现了最先进的零样本 TTS 性能，且训练收敛明显更快，并在 SUPERB-SG 基准上的语音增强、分离和语音转换任务中表现出色。系统性的消融实验表明，WavCube 的两阶段方法解决了 SSL 特征在生成建模中的两个内在缺陷，为未来的统一语音系统铺平了道路。

Abstract

Integrating speech understanding and generation is a pivotal step toward building unified speech models. However, the different representations required for these two tasks currently pose significant compatibility challenges. Typically, semantics-oriented features are learned from self-supervised learning (SSL), and acoustic-oriented features from reconstruction. Such fragmented representations hinder the realization of truly unified speech systems. We present WavCube, a compact continuous latent derived from an SSL speech encoder that simultaneously supports speech understanding, reconstruction, and generation. WavCube employs a two-stage training scheme. Stage 1 trains a semantic bottleneck to filter off-manifold redundancy that makes raw SSL features intractable for diffusion. Stage 2 injects fine-grained acoustic details via end-to-end reconstruction, while a semantic anchoring loss ensures the representation remains grounded within its original semantic manifold. Comprehensive experiments show that WavCube closely approaches WavLM performance on SUPERB despite an 8x dimensional compression, attains reconstruction quality on par with existing acoustic representations, delivers state-of-the-art zero-shot TTS performance with markedly faster training convergence, and excels in speech enhancement, separation, and voice conversion tasks on the SUPERB-SG benchmark. Systematic ablations reveal that WavCube's two-stage recipe resolves two intrinsic flaws of SSL features for generative modeling, paving the way for future unified speech systems. Codes and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/yanghaha0908/WavCube.

item.title: TouchDrive: Electronics-Free Tactile Sensing Interface for Assistive Grasping
item.author: Xu, Jing, Niu, Xuezhi, Broo, Didem Gurdur, Hjort, Klas
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为TouchDrive的电子触觉传感接口，用于辅助抓取任务。

背景: 现有辅助抓取系统通常依赖电子传感和多阶段处理流程，这增加了系统复杂性并降低了可及性。

目的: 解决现有系统的局限性，提供一种低成本且无需电子元件的触觉传感接口。

方法: 通过阀门介导的开关直接将接触力转换为气动反馈，将传感、信号生成和反馈集成在单一被动机械回路中。

主要发现: 在多种机器人平台上进行了验证，能够可靠地处理水果和日常物品等辅助抓取任务。

结论: 该接口具有实用价值，能够通过触觉提示帮助用户调节抓取力，实现精确且稳健的精细操作。

翻译: 辅助机器人抓取在实现安全且自适应地操作多样化物体方面发挥着重要作用。然而，现有系统通常依赖电子传感和多阶段处理流程，增加了系统复杂性并降低了可及性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了TouchDrive，这是一种用于辅助抓取的低成本、无电子触觉传感接口。TouchDrive通过阀门介导的开关直接将接触力转换为气动反馈，将传感、信号生成和反馈集成在单一被动机械回路中。该系统可以使用气动常闭阀、压缩空气罐、传感元件和触觉反馈致动器，无需电子元件即可实现。通过提供触觉提示，TouchDrive使用户能够调节抓取力，从而实现对柔性和易碎物体的精确且稳健的精细操作。该接口已在多种机器人平台上进行了验证，在辅助抓取任务中一致地表现出可靠性能和实用性，例如处理水果和日常物品（多达20种）。

Abstract

Assistive robotic grasping plays an important role in enabling safe and adaptive manipulation of diverse objects. However, existing systems often rely on electronic sensing and multi-stage processing pipelines, increasing system complexity and reducing accessibility. To address these limitations, we present TouchDrive, a cost-effective, electronics-free tactile sensing interface for assistive grasping. TouchDrive directly converts contact forces into pneumatic feedback through valve-mediated switching, integrating sensing, signal generation, and feedback within a single passive mechanical loop. The system can be employed using a pneumatic normally closed valve, a compressed air tank, sensing element, and haptic feedback actuator without electronics. By delivering tactile cues, TouchDrive empowers users to modulate grasp forces, enabling precise and robust delicate manipulation of compliant and fragile objects. The interface has been validated across diverse robotic platforms, consistently demonstrating reliable performance and practical applicability in assistive grasping tasks, such as handling fruits and everyday items (up to 20 objects).

item.title: Invariant-Based Diagnostics for Graph Benchmarks
item.author: von Moos, Richard, Alain, Mathieu, Rieck, Bastian
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出使用图不变量作为诊断框架，以解决图基础模型基准测试中混淆节点特征和图结构贡献的问题，并验证了不变量在性能预测和结构表征方面的有效性。

背景: 图基础模型的进展受到基准测试实践的阻碍，这些实践混淆了节点特征和图结构的贡献，使得难以判断模型是否真正从连接性中学习或是否需要学习。

目的: 提出使用图不变量作为诊断框架，以解决基准测试中混淆节点特征和图结构贡献的问题，并评估结构在任务中的必要性。

方法: 提出使用图不变量，即置换不变且任务无关的结构描述符，作为诊断框架。通过实验比较不变量与标准图神经网络、Transformer和消息传递基线模型。

主要发现: 1. 不变量比标准图神经网络更具表达能力。2. 不变量表征了基准数据集内的结构异质性。3. 不变量可以预测多任务性能。4. 简单的不变量模型在26个数据集上与Transformer和消息传递基线模型竞争激烈，有时甚至超过它们。5. 表达能力不是预测性能的主要驱动力。

结论: 在结构重要的任务中，不可训练的结构代理通常能匹配训练好的消息传递模型。因此，不变量基线应成为评估任务是否需要结构以及模型是否捕捉到结构的标准，作为迈向图基础模型的垫脚石。

翻译: 图基础模型的进展受到基准测试实践的阻碍，这些实践混淆了节点特征和图结构的贡献，使得难以判断模型是否真正从连接性中学习或是否需要学习。我们提出使用图不变量来解决这一问题，即置换不变且任务无关的结构描述符，作为图基准测试的诊断框架。我们表明，(i) 不变量比标准图神经网络更具表达能力，(ii) 不变量表征了基准数据集内的结构异质性，(iii) 不变量预测多任务性能，以及 (iv) 简单的不变量模型在26个数据集上与Transformer和消息传递基线模型竞争激烈，有时甚至超过它们。我们的结果表明，表达能力不是预测性能的主要驱动力，并且在结构重要的任务中，不可训练的结构代理通常能匹配训练好的消息传递模型。因此，我们主张不变量基线应成为评估任务是否需要结构以及模型是否捕捉到结构的标准，作为迈向图基础模型的垫脚石。

Abstract

Progress on graph foundation models is hindered by benchmark practices that conflate the contributions of node features and graph structure, making it hard to tell whether a model actually learns from connectivity, or whether it even needs to. We propose addressing this using graph invariants, i.e., permutation-invariant, task-agnostic structural descriptors that serve as a diagnostic framework for graph benchmarks. We show that (i) invariants are more expressive than standard GNNs, (ii) invariants characterize structural heterogeneity within and across benchmark datasets, (iii) invariants predict multi-task performance, and (iv) simple invariant-based models are competitive with, and sometimes exceed, transformer and message-passing baselines across 26 datasets. Our results suggest that expressivity is not the main driver of predictive performance, and that on tasks where structure matters, a non-trainable structural proxy often matches trained message-passing models. We thus posit that invariant baselines should become a standard for evaluating whether structure is required for a task and whether a model picks up on it, serving as a stepping stone towards graph foundation models.

item.title: Diversity Curves for Graph Representation Learning
item.author: Katharina Limbeck, Nadja Häusermann, Martin Carrasco, Guy Wolf, Bastian Rieck
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于结构多样性的图嵌入方法，通过跟踪图在粗化层级中的结构多样性来生成可解释、高效的图表示。

背景: 图级表示是刻画图结构差异的关键工具，但在比较不同基数（大小）的图时仍具有挑战性，特别是在无监督任务中需要可解释、可扩展且可靠的感知大小的图表示。

目的: 解决比较不同基数图时的挑战，提供一种可解释、高效且可靠的感知大小的图表示方法。

方法: 通过跟踪图在粗化层级中的结构多样性，利用边收缩粗化技术，并引入一种新的等距不变量“spread”来编码图的度量多样性和几何结构。

主要发现: 该方法生成的嵌入被称为多样性曲线，在多种基准方法中表现出色。具体应用包括：聚类和可视化不同大小的模拟图；区分单细胞图的几何结构；比较分子图数据集的结构；以及刻画几何形状。

结论: 该方法生成的多样性曲线具有可解释性、高效性，且可直接跨粗化层级比较，优于仅使用结构描述符的表示方法。

翻译: 图级表示是刻画图之间结构差异的关键工具。然而，比较基数不同的图仍然具有挑战性，即使它们来自相同的底层分布。特别是无监督任务需要可解释、可扩展且可靠的感知大小的图表示。我们的工作通过跟踪图在粗化层级中的结构多样性来解决这些问题。由此产生的图嵌入，我们称之为多样性曲线，由构造可知是可解释的、高效的，并且可以直接跨粗化层级进行比较。具体而言，我们跟踪图的“spread”，这是一种新的等距不变量，天生适合编码图的度量多样性和几何结构。我们利用边收缩粗化并证明这提高了表达能力，从而产生了比仅使用结构描述符更强大的图级表示。在实践中的多种基准方法上证明了它们的效用，我们使用多样性曲线来（i）聚类和可视化不同大小的模拟图，（ii）区分单细胞图的几何结构，（iii）比较分子图数据集的结构，以及（iv）刻画几何形状。

Abstract

Graph-level representations are crucial tools for characterising structural differences between graphs. However, comparing graphs with different cardinalities, even when sampled from the same underlying distribution, remains challenging. Unsupervised tasks in particular require interpretable, scalable, and reliable size-aware graph representations. Our work addresses these issues by tracking the structural diversity of a graph across coarsening levels. The resulting graph embeddings, which we denote diversity curves, are interpretable by construction, efficient, and directly comparable across coarsening hierarchies. Specifically, we track the spread of graphs, a novel isometry invariant that is inherently well-suited for encoding the metric diversity and geometry of graphs. We utilise edge contraction coarsening and prove that this improves expressivity, thus leading to more powerful graph-level representations than structural descriptors alone. Demonstrating their utility over a range of baseline methods in practice, we use diversity curves to (i) cluster and visualise simulated graphs across varying sizes, (ii) distinguish the geometry of single-cell graphs, (iii) compare the structure of molecular graph datasets, and (iv) characterise geometric shapes.

item.title: Hitting Time Isomorphism for Multi-Stage Planning with Foundation Policies
item.author: Magnus Victor Boock, Abdullah Akgül, Mustafa Mert Çelikok, Melih Kandemir
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于算子理论的离线强化学习表示学习框架，并据此设计了 Isomorphic Embedding Learning (IEL) 算法，旨在从击中时间观测中恢复控制马尔可夫过程的定向时序几何。

背景: 现有方法通常产生对称距离或无法满足三角不等式。

目的: 从击中时间观测中恢复控制马尔可夫过程的定向时序几何，并学习一种希尔伯特空间位移几何。

方法: 提出算子理论表示学习框架，利用击中时间观测恢复几何结构；具体算法为 Isomorphic Embedding Learning (IEL)，结合了 HILP 风格的一致性目标和显式的击中时间回归。

主要发现: 该表示在潜在线性闭包下存在且唯一可识别；在有限维实现中，全局击中时间误差受一步转移误差和环境瞬态谱半径放大的限制；提供了考虑近似、统计复杂性和轨迹标签不匹配的有限样本保证；IEL 算法在离线迷宫运动数据上改进了学习基础策略的现有技术水平。

结论: 该框架确保学习到的几何结构反映实际的决策时间进度，支持基于图的长期导航多阶段规划。

翻译: 我们提出了一种用于离线强化学习的算子理论表示学习框架，该框架能够从击中时间观测中恢复控制马尔可夫过程的定向时序几何。虽然现有技术通常产生对称距离或无法满足三角不等式，但我们的框架学习了一种希尔伯特空间位移几何，其中期望击中时间被实现为潜在位移的线性泛函。我们证明了在潜在线性闭包下该表示的存在性，且在界定的线性同构下唯一可识别。对于有限维实现，我们表明全局击中时间误差受一步转移误差和环境瞬态谱半径放大的限制。此外，我们提供了考虑近似、统计复杂性和轨迹标签不匹配的有限样本保证。基于该理论，我们策划了 Isomorphic Embedding Learning (IEL) 作为一种新的目标无关基础策略学习算法，它将 HILP 风格的一致性目标与显式的击中时间回归相结合，以确保学习到的几何结构反映实际的决策时间进度。这种非对称和组合结构使得基于图的长期导航多阶段规划变得稳健。我们的实验表明，IEL 改进了从离线迷宫运动数据中学习基础策略的现有技术水平。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/MagnusBoock/IEL 找到。

Abstract

We present a new operator-theoretic representation learning framework for offline reinforcement learning that recovers the directed temporal geometry of a controlled Markov process from hitting time observations. While prior art often produces symmetric distances or fails to satisfy the triangle inequality, our framework learns a Hilbert-space displacement geometry where expected hitting times are realized as linear functionals of latent displacements. We prove that this representation exists under latent linear closure and is uniquely identifiable up to a bounded linear isomorphism. For finite-dimensional implementations, we show that global hitting-time error is bounded by one-step transition error amplified by the environment's transient spectral radius. Furthermore, we provide finite-sample guarantees accounting for approximation, statistical complexity, and trajectory-label mismatch. Derived from this theory, we curate Isomorphic Embedding Learning (IEL) as a new goal-agnostic foundation policy learning algorithm that anchors a HILP-style consistency objective with explicit hitting-time regression to ensure that the learned geometry reflects actual decision-time progress. This asymmetric and compositional structure enables robust graph-based multi-stage planning for long-horizon navigation. Our experiments demonstrate that IEL improves the state of the art of learning foundation policy policies from offline maze locomotion data. Our code can be found on https://github.com/MagnusBoock/IEL

item.title: GA3T: A Ground-Aerial Terrain Traversability Dataset for Heterogeneous Robot Teams in Unstructured Environments
item.author: Siwei Cai, Knut Peterson, Quan Tran, Christian Ricks, Dhanush Parthasarathy, Amir Kaidarov, Neil Deshpande, Sukaina Najm, David Han, Lifeng Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GA3T是一个真实世界的多机器人协作感知数据集，由地面无人车和无人机在非结构化环境中收集，旨在支持跨视角感知、地形可通行性估计等研究。

背景: 异构空地机器人团队结合互补的感知模态、移动特性和空间视角，能显著增强复杂户外环境的感知能力。然而，多机器人协作感知的进展受到缺乏真实世界非结构化地形数据集的限制。

目的: 提供一个专门用于支持跨视角感知、空地视角融合、地形可通行性估计以及真实越野环境中协作场景理解研究的数据集。

方法: 使用Clearpath Husky UGV和Autel EVO II无人机在森林小径、岩石小径、泥泞地形、雪堆和草地等4种独特环境中收集数据。地面平台提供3D激光雷达、立体相机、IMU和GPS数据；空中平台提供RGB图像、热成像/红外观测和GPS数据。数据包含超过13,000个同步帧和8,000多张手动标注图像。

主要发现: 数据集在早春采集，稀疏的树冠允许无人机通过树木部分观察地面机器人和地形，实现了遮挡感知的协作感知。数据集包含SAM3零样本分割结果。

结论: GA3T数据集填补了非结构化地形中多模态观测数据的空白，特别关注遮挡感知和跨视角融合，区别于以往专注于SLAM或模拟驾驶的数据集。

翻译: GA3T is a real-world multi-robot collaborative perception dataset collected by a ground robot and an aerial robot in unstructured environments, designed to support research on cross-view perception, traversability estimation, and collaborative scene understanding.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决异构机器人团队在非结构化环境中进行地形可通行性判断的问题。这个问题很重要，因为现实中的非结构化环境地形复杂，单一类型的机器人难以胜任，而地面和空中机器人协同工作能更好地完成任务，但缺乏专门的数据集限制了相关算法的发展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一个名为 GA3T 的数据集，旨在解决非结构化环境中异构机器人团队的地形可通行性问题。

Abstract

Heterogeneous air-ground robot teams combine complementary sensing modalities, mobility characteristics, and spatial viewpoints that can significantly enhance perception in complex outdoor environments. However, progress in multi-robot collaborative perception has been constrained by the lack of real-world datasets featuring overlapping multi-modal observations from platforms operating in unstructured terrain. We present GA3T (Ground-Aerial Team for Terrain Traversal), a real-world multi-robot collaborative perception dataset collected using a Clearpath Husky UGV and an Autel EVO~II UAV across diverse unstructured environments, including forest trails, rocky paths, muddy terrain, snow piles, and grass-covered fields. The ground platform provides 3D LiDAR, stereo camera, IMU, and GPS data, while the aerial platform contributes RGB imagery, thermal/infrared observations, and GPS from a complementary overhead viewpoint, allowing for rich cross-modal and cross-view perception. The dataset is collected in 4 unique environments, with over 13,000 synchronized frames across approximately 29 minutes of operation, and includes both SAM~3-based zero-shot segmentation and over 8,000 manually labeled images. A unique aspect of the dataset is its early-spring collection period, during which sparse tree canopies allow the aerial robot to partially observe the ground robot and terrain through the trees, allowing for occlusion-aware collaborative perception. Unlike prior multi-robot datasets that focus on SLAM or simulated cooperative driving, GA3T is specifically designed to support research on cross-view perception, air-ground viewpoint fusion, traversability estimation, and collaborative scene understanding in real off-road environments.

item.title: MARBLE: Multi-Aspect Reward Balance for Diffusion RL
item.author: Zhao, Canyu, Chen, Hao, Tong, Yunze, Qiao, Yu, Li, Jiacheng, Shen, Chunhua
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 强化学习微调已成为对齐扩散模型的主流方法，但现有方法在处理多维度奖励时存在样本不匹配和计算成本高的问题。本文提出MARBLE框架以解决这些问题。

背景: 图像评估本质上是一个多维度任务，需要同时优化多个评估标准。现有做法包括训练专家模型、使用加权求和奖励或顺序微调，但这些方法要么无法统一训练，要么需要大量人工调参。

目的: 解决现有方法在多维度奖励优化中因使用简单的加权求和导致样本监督被稀释的问题，并提高训练效率。

方法: 提出MARBLE框架，这是一个梯度空间优化框架。它维护每个奖励的独立优势估计器，计算每个奖励的策略梯度，并通过求解二次规划问题将它们和谐地整合为一个更新方向。此外，还提出了利用扩散NFT损失仿射结构的分摊公式，将每步成本从K+1次反向传播降低到接近单奖励基准成本，并使用指数移动平均平滑平衡系数。

主要发现: 在SD3.5 Medium模型上使用五个奖励进行测试，MARBLE同时提升了所有五个奖励维度。它将最不匹配奖励的梯度余弦值在80%的小批量中从负值变为正值，且训练速度是基线的0.97倍。

结论: MARBLE框架能够有效解决多维度奖励对齐问题，无需人工调参即可实现所有奖励维度的同时提升，且训练效率高。

翻译: 强化学习微调已成为对齐扩散模型与人类偏好的主导方法。然而，评估图像本质上是一个多维任务，需要同时优化多个评估标准。现有做法通过为每个奖励训练一个专家模型，优化加权求和奖励，或使用手工设计的阶段顺序进行微调来处理多个奖励。这些方法要么无法产生可以在所有奖励上联合训练的统一模型，要么需要繁重的人工调参顺序训练。我们发现失败源于使用简单的加权求和奖励聚合。这种方法存在样本级不匹配，因为大多数回放是专家样本，对某些奖励维度高度信息丰富但对其他维度无关；因此，加权求和稀释了它们的监督。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MARBLE，这是一个梯度空间优化框架，它维护每个奖励的独立优势估计器，计算每个奖励的策略梯度，并通过求解二次规划问题将它们和谐地整合为一个更新方向，无需人工调参的奖励加权。我们进一步提出了分摊公式，利用扩散NFT中使用的损失的仿射结构，将每步成本从K+1次反向传播降低到接近单奖励基准成本，并结合在平衡系数上的指数移动平均，以稳定对抗瞬时单批次波动的更新。在SD3.5 Medium上使用五个奖励，MARBLE同时提升了所有五个奖励维度，将最不匹配奖励的梯度余弦值在80%的小批量中从加权求和下的负值变为一致的正值，并以基线训练速度的0.97倍运行。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Reinforcement learning fine-tuning has become the dominant approach for aligning diffusion models with human preferences. However, assessing images is intrinsically a multi-dimensional task, and multiple evaluation criteria need to be optimized simultaneously. Existing practice deal with multiple rewards by training one specialist model per reward, optimizing a weighted-sum reward $R(x)=\sum_k w_k R_k(x)$, or sequentially fine-tuning with a hand-crafted stage schedule. These approaches either fail to produce a unified model that can be jointly trained on all rewards or necessitates heavy manually tuned sequential training. We find that the failure stems from using a naive weighted-sum reward aggregation. This approach suffers from a sample-level mismatch because most rollouts are specialist samples, highly informative for certain reward dimensions but irrelevant for others; consequently, weighted summation dilutes their supervision. To address this issue, we propose MARBLE (Multi-Aspect Reward BaLancE), a gradient-space optimization framework that maintains independent advantage estimators for each reward, computes per-reward policy gradients, and harmonizes them into a single update direction without manually-tuned reward weighting, by solving a Quadratic Programming problem. We further propose an amortized formulation that exploits the affine structure of the loss used in DiffusionNFT, to reduce the per-step cost from K+1 backward passes to near single-reward baseline cost, together with EMA smoothing on the balancing coefficients to stabilize updates against transient single-batch fluctuations. On SD3.5 Medium with five rewards, MARBLE improves all five reward dimensions simultaneously, turns the worst-aligned reward's gradient cosine from negative under weighted summation in 80% of mini-batches to consistently positive, and runs at 0.97X the training speed of baseline training.

item.title: Is One Layer Enough? Understanding Inference Dynamics in Tabular Foundation Models
item.author: Balef, Amir Rezaei, Koshil, Mykhailo, Eggensperger, Katharina
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对六种最先进的表格模型进行了大规模机制研究，揭示了推理机制中的深度冗余，并提出了一种轻量级模型。

背景: Transformer-based tabular foundation models (TFMs) 在小到中等规模的表格预测基准任务中占据主导地位，但其推理机制在很大程度上仍未被探索。

目的: 对六种最先进的表格上下文学习模型进行大规模的逐层动力学机制研究，探索预测如何随深度出现，识别推理阶段，并揭示潜在空间动力学。

方法: 对六种最先进的表格上下文学习模型进行大规模的逐层动力学机制研究。

主要发现: 多个模型之间存在巨大的深度冗余，表明推理阶段存在迭代优化和重叠计算；潜在空间动力学与语言模型不同。

结论: 基于这些见解，设计了一个概念验证的循环单层模型，仅使用原始模型 20% 的参数，同时实现了相当的性能。

翻译: 基于 Transformer 的表格基础模型在小型到中型的表格预测基准任务中占据主导地位，但其推理机制在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们对六种最先进的表格上下文学习模型进行了首次大规模的逐层动力学机制研究。我们探索了预测如何随深度出现，识别了推理的 distinct 阶段，并揭示了与语言模型不同的潜在空间动力学。我们的发现表明多个模型之间存在巨大的深度冗余，表明推理阶段存在迭代优化和重叠计算。受这些见解的启发，我们设计了一个概念验证的循环单层模型，仅使用原始模型 20% 的参数，同时实现了相当的性能。代码可在该 https URL 获取。

Abstract

Transformer-based tabular foundation models (TFMs) dominate small to medium tabular predictive benchmark tasks, yet their inference mechanisms remain largely unexplored. We present the first large-scale mechanistic study of layerwise dynamics in 6 state-of-the-art tabular in-context learning models. We explore how predictions emerge across depth, identify distinct stages of inference and reveal latent-space dynamics that differ from those of language models. Our findings indicate substantial depthwise redundancy across multiple models, suggesting iterative refinement with overlapping computations during inference stages. Guided by these insights, we design a proof-of-concept, looped single-layer model that uses only 20% of the original model's parameters while achieving comparable performance. The code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Agentic AIs Are the Missing Paradigm for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Foundation Models
item.author: Wang, Xin, Chen, Haibo, Liu, Wenxuan, Zhu, Wenwu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出基础模型的分布外问题是一个结构上独特的问题，无法仅靠模型中心范式解决，需要引入代理系统范式。

背景: 基础模型在分布偏移常态化的开放世界环境中部署，面临知识边界、能力天花板、组合偏移等OOD现象，且预训练和微调分布往往不可见。

目的: 论证基础模型的OOD问题需要通过代理系统范式来解决，并证明其相对于模型中心范式的优势。

方法: 通过四个步骤进行论证：1. 提出适应部分观测多阶段训练分布的阶段感知OOD形式化；2. 证明参数覆盖天花板；3. 定义代理OOD系统的四个结构属性；4. 回应反论点。

主要发现: 存在模型中心方法无法处理的实际相关输入（参数覆盖天花板）；代理系统通过感知、策略选择、外部行动和闭环验证四个属性，严格扩展了可达集。

结论: 代理方法并不取代模型中心方法，两者互补。FM-OOD的进步需要明确将代理范式作为首要研究方向。

翻译: Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly deployed in open-world settings where distribution shift is the rule rather than the exception. The out-of-distribution (OOD) phenomena they face -- knowledge boundaries, capability ceilings, compositional shifts, and open-ended task variation -- differ in kind from the settings that have shaped prior OOD research, and are further complicated because the pretraining and post-training distributions of modern FMs are often only partially observed. Our position is that OOD for foundation models is a structurally distinct problem that cannot be solved within the prevailing model-centric paradigm, and that agentic systems constitute the missing paradigm required to address it. We defend this claim through four steps. First, we give a stage-aware formalization of OOD that accommodates partially observed multi-stage training distributions. Second, we prove a parameter coverage ceiling: there exist practically relevant inputs that no model-centric method (training-time or test-time) can handle within tolerance $extbackslash$varepsilon, for reasons intrinsic to parameter-based representation. Third, we characterize agentic OOD systems by four structural properties -- perception, strategy selection, external action, and closed-loop verification -- and show that they strictly extend the reachable set beyond the ceiling. Fourth, we respond to seven counterarguments, conceding two, and outline a research agenda. We do not claim that agentic methods subsume model-centric ones; we argue that the two are complementary, and that progress on FM-OOD requires explicit recognition of the agentic paradigm as a first-class research direction.

Abstract

Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly deployed in open-world settings where distribution shift is the rule rather than the exception. The out-of-distribution (OOD) phenomena they face -- knowledge boundaries, capability ceilings, compositional shifts, and open-ended task variation -- differ in kind from the settings that have shaped prior OOD research, and are further complicated because the pretraining and post-training distributions of modern FMs are often only partially observed. Our position is that OOD for foundation models is a structurally distinct problem that cannot be solved within the prevailing model-centric paradigm, and that agentic systems constitute the missing paradigm required to address it. We defend this claim through four steps. First, we give a stage-aware formalization of OOD that accommodates partially observed multi-stage training distributions. Second, we prove a parameter coverage ceiling: there exist practically relevant inputs that no model-centric method (training-time or test-time) can handle within tolerance $\varepsilon$, for reasons intrinsic to parameter-based representation. Third, we characterize agentic OOD systems by four structural properties -- perception, strategy selection, external action, and closed-loop verification -- and show that they strictly extend the reachable set beyond the ceiling. Fourth, we respond to seven counterarguments, conceding two, and outline a research agenda. We do not claim that agentic methods subsume model-centric ones; we argue that the two are complementary, and that progress on FM-OOD requires explicit recognition of the agentic paradigm as a first-class research direction.

item.title: On the Safety of Graph Representation Learning
item.author: Xiaoguang Guo, Zehong Wang, Ziming Li, Shawn Spitzel, Soonwoo Kwon, Tianyi Ma, Yanfang Ye, Chuxu Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GRL-Safety 是一个用于图表示学习安全性的多轴评估基准，旨在评估模型在部署压力下的可靠性。

背景: 图表示学习已从拓扑嵌入发展到图基础模型，但现有评估主要关注干净迁移，缺乏对部署压力下可靠性的考量。

目的: 引入 GRL-Safety 基准，以评估图表示学习方法在面临信号、上下文、标签支持、结构群体或预测证据等部署压力时的安全性。

方法: 在25个数据集上评估了12种代表性方法，涵盖拓扑嵌入、监督GNN、自监督模型和图基础模型。评估包含五个安全轴：数据损坏鲁棒性、OOD泛化、类别不平衡、公平性和可解释性，并按轴和子条件报告结果。

主要发现: 1. 安全行为由表示设计与受压图因素的相互作用决定，而非仅由方法家族决定。2. 图基础模型显示出特定轴的优势，而非全面的安全主导。3. 即使是最佳评估方法，在某些部署场景下仍存在困难，揭示了需要超越模型选择的新鲁棒性、适应或训练目标。

结论: 该基准、评估协议和代码已开源，为未来研究提供了新的视角和方向。

翻译: 图表示学习已从仅关注拓扑的图嵌入发展到特定任务的监督GNN，最近又发展到可复用表示和图基础模型。然而，现有评估主要衡量干净迁移、适应和任务覆盖率。当部署压力影响图信号、图上下文、标签支持、结构群体或预测证据时，GRL方法是否保持可靠尚不清楚。我们介绍了GRL-Safety，一个用于GRL的多轴安全评估基准。GRL-Safety在标准化评估条件下，在25个图数据集上评估了12种代表性方法，包括拓扑嵌入方法、监督GNN、自监督图模型和GFMs，同时保留了方法原生的适应能力。评估涵盖五个安全轴：数据损坏鲁棒性、OOD泛化、类别不平衡、公平性和可解释性，按轴和子条件报告，而不是单一的总分。我们的分析得出了三个跨轴见解，可以启发未来的研究。首先，安全行为由表示设计与受压图因素之间的相互作用决定，而不仅仅是方法家族。其次，基础时代的方法显示出特定轴的优势，而不是广泛的安全主导。第三，即使对于最佳评估方法，某些部署场景仍然困难，揭示了需要超越模型选择的新鲁棒性、适应或训练目标。基准、评估协议和代码可在以下网址获得：https://github.com/GXG-CS/GRL-Safety。

Abstract

Graph representation learning (GRL) has evolved from topology-only graph embeddings to task-specific supervised GNNs, and more recently to reusable representations and graph foundation models (GFMs). However, existing evaluations mainly measure clean transfer, adaptation, and task coverage. It remains unclear whether GRL methods stay reliable when deployment stresses affect graph signals, graph contexts, label support, structural groups, or predictive evidence. We introduce GRL-Safety, a multi-axis safety evaluation benchmark for GRL. GRL-Safety evaluates twelve representative methods, spanning topology-only embedding methods, supervised GNNs, self-supervised graph models, and GFMs, on twenty-five graph datasets under standardized evaluation conditions while preserving method-native adaptation. The evaluation covers five safety axes: corruption robustness, OOD generalization, class imbalance, fairness, and interpretation, with per-axis and sub-condition reporting rather than a single aggregate score. Our analysis yields three cross-axis insights that can inspire future research. First, safety behavior is shaped by the interaction between representation design and the stressed graph factor, rather than by method family alone. Second, foundation-era methods show axis-specific strengths rather than broad safety dominance. Third, several deployment regimes remain difficult even for the best evaluated method, revealing capability gaps that require new robustness, adaptation, or training objectives beyond model selection. The benchmark, evaluation protocols, and code are available at: https://github.com/GXG-CS/GRL-Safety.

item.title: UniSD: Towards a Unified Self-Distillation Framework for Large Language Models
item.author: Yiqiao Jin, Yiyang Wang, Lucheng Fu, Yijia Xiao, Yinyi Luo, Haoxin Liu, B. Aditya Prakash, Josiah Hester, Jindong Wang, Srijan Kumar
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出UniSD统一框架，通过整合多种互补机制提升自蒸馏效果，构建了UniSDfull集成管道，显著提升模型性能。

背景: 自蒸馏是无需外部强教师适应大语言模型的有前景路径，但在自回归LLM中仍面临挑战，如轨迹自由形式、正确性依赖任务、监督信号不稳定等。现有方法多孤立考察设计选择。

目的: 提出UniSD统一框架，系统研究自蒸馏，揭示自蒸馏何时优于静态模仿、哪些组件驱动性能提升以及组件间的交互作用。

方法: UniSD集成了多种互补机制，包括多教师一致性、EMA教师稳定化、令牌级对比学习、特征匹配和发散裁剪，以解决监督可靠性、表示对齐和训练稳定性问题。

主要发现: 在六个基准测试和六个模型上，UniSD揭示了自蒸馏何时优于静态模仿，哪些组件带来增益以及组件间的交互方式。基于这些发现构建的UniSDfull在六个基准测试中表现最强。

结论: 自蒸馏是一种实用且可引导的高效LLM适应方法，无需更强的外部教师。UniSDfull在基准测试中表现优异，相比基座模型提升5.4点，相比最强基线提升2.8点。

翻译: Self-distillation (SD) offers a promising path for adapting large language models (LLMs) without relying on stronger external teachers. However, SD in autoregressive LLMs remains challenging because self-generated trajectories are free-form, correctness is task-dependent, and plausible rationales can still provide unstable or unreliable supervision. Existing methods mainly examine isolated design choices, leaving their effectiveness, roles, and interactions unclear. In this paper, we propose UniSD, a unified framework to systematically study self-distillation. UniSD integrates complementary mechanisms that address supervision reliability, representation alignment, and training stability, including multi-teacher agreement, EMA teacher stabilization, token-level contrastive learning, feature matching, and divergence clipping. Across six benchmarks and six models from three model families, UniSD reveals when self-distillation improves over static imitation, which components drive the gains, and how these components interact across tasks. Guided by these insights, we construct UniSDfull, an integrated pipeline that combines complementary components and achieves the strongest overall performance, improving over the base model by +5.4 points and the strongest baseline by +2.8 points. Extensive evaluation highlights self-distillation as a practical and steerable approach for efficient LLM adaptation without stronger external teachers.

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一个名为 UniSD 的统一自蒸馏框架，用于大语言模型。

Abstract

Self-distillation (SD) offers a promising path for adapting large language models (LLMs) without relying on stronger external teachers. However, SD in autoregressive LLMs remains challenging because self-generated trajectories are free-form, correctness is task-dependent, and plausible rationales can still provide unstable or unreliable supervision. Existing methods mainly examine isolated design choices, leaving their effectiveness, roles, and interactions unclear. In this paper, we propose UniSD, a unified framework to systematically study self-distillation. UniSD integrates complementary mechanisms that address supervision reliability, representation alignment, and training stability, including multi-teacher agreement, EMA teacher stabilization, token-level contrastive learning, feature matching, and divergence clipping. Across six benchmarks and six models from three model families, UniSD reveals when self-distillation improves over static imitation, which components drive the gains, and how these components interact across tasks. Guided by these insights, we construct UniSDfull, an integrated pipeline that combines complementary components and achieves the strongest overall performance, improving over the base model by +5.4 points and the strongest baseline by +2.8 points. Extensive evaluation highlights self-distillation as a practical and steerable approach for efficient LLM adaptation without stronger external teachers.

item.title: When and Why SignSGD Outperforms SGD: A Theoretical Study Based on $\ell_1$-norm Lower Bounds
item.author: Hongyi Tao, Dingzhi Yu, Lijun Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 基于符号的优化算法在大型基础模型训练中表现出色，但缺乏理论理解。本文通过分析特定问题几何结构，证明了基于符号的方法在特定条件下优于标准方法。

背景: 基于符号的算法如SignSGD和Muon在训练大型基础模型时表现优异，但缺乏对其为何优于标准随机梯度下降（SGD）的理论解释。在标准平滑度和有限方差条件下，SGD在寻找L2范数平稳点方面是最优的，阻碍了基于符号方法获得复杂度收益。

目的: 为了克服这一障碍，建立基于符号优化算法的理论理解，阐明其在何种情况下优于标准SGD。

方法: 分析利用L1范数平稳性、L无穷平滑度和可分离噪声模型的基于符号优化器。将框架扩展到矩阵域以分析Muon优化器。

主要发现: 在特定问题几何结构下，推导了SignSGD的匹配上下界。在稀疏噪声条件下，SignSGD将复杂度降低了d倍。将框架扩展到矩阵域，证明了Muon优化器保留了最优的维度缩放特性。

结论: 理论上的优势准确预测了在124M参数GPT-2模型预训练中SignSGD的更快收敛速度。

翻译: Sign-based optimization algorithms have shown remarkable performance in training large foundation models, yet lack theoretical understanding. This paper analyzes specific problem geometries to prove that sign-based methods outperform standard methods under certain conditions.

Abstract

Sign-based optimization algorithms, such as SignSGD and Muon, have garnered significant attention for their remarkable performance in training large foundation models. Despite this empirical success, we still lack a theoretical understanding of when and why these sign-based methods outperform vanilla SGD. The core obstacle is that under standard smoothness and finite variance conditions, SGD is known to be minimax optimal for finding stationary points measured by $\ell_2$-norms, thereby fundamentally precluding any complexity gains for sign-based methods in standard settings. To overcome this barrier, we analyze sign-based optimizers leveraging $\ell_1$-norm stationarity, $\ell_\infty$-smoothness, and a separable noise model, which can better capture the coordinate-wise nature of signed updates. Under this distinct problem geometry, we derive matched upper and lower bounds for SignSGD and explicitly characterize the problem class in which SignSGD provably dominates SGD. Specifically, we compare the \emph{upper bound of SignSGD} with the \emph{lower bound of SGD}, illustrating that SignSGD effectively reduces the complexity by a factor of $d$ under \emph{sparse noise}, where $d$ is the problem dimension. Furthermore, we elevate this framework to the matrix domain, providing an equivalent optimal lower bound for the Muon optimizer, proving that extending the sign operator to matrices preserves this optimal scaling with dimensionality. Finally, we bridge our theoretical bounds to practice, demonstrating that the theoretical superiority of SignSGD accurately predicts its faster convergence during the pretraining of a 124M parameter GPT-2 model.

item.title: Can RL Teach Long-Horizon Reasoning to LLMs? Expressiveness Is Key
item.author: Wang, Tianle, Wang, Zhaoyang, Lan, Guangchen, Wei, Xinpeng, Zhang, Sipeng, Qiu, Guanwen, Saparov, Abulhair
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了ScaleLogic框架，用于研究强化学习在大型语言模型推理中的训练规模与任务难度的关系。

背景: 虽然强化学习已被用于改进LLM推理，但缺乏受控的可扩展环境来系统研究训练规模如何随任务难度变化。此外，LLM在长跨度推理方面的局限性引发了关于其是否是自回归Transformer架构根本性缺陷的担忧。

目的: 引入ScaleLogic框架，以独立控制推理深度和逻辑表达能力这两个难度轴，从而系统研究训练规模与任务难度的关系。

方法: 提出了ScaleLogic合成逻辑推理框架，支持从简单的蕴含逻辑到包含合取、析取、否定和全称量词的一阶推理等多种逻辑。通过该框架进行强化学习训练。

主要发现: 1. RL训练计算量随推理深度呈幂律关系，且幂律指数随逻辑表达能力单调递增。2. 在下游数学和通用推理基准测试中，表达能力更强的训练设置能带来更大的性能增益和更高的计算效率。3. 幂律关系在多种强化学习方法中成立，基于课程的学习能显著提高扩展效率。

结论: LLM在长跨度推理方面的局限性并非架构的根本性缺陷，可以通过改进的训练方法和数据来解决。

翻译: Reinforcement learning has been applied to improve large language model reasoning, yet the systematic study of how training scales with task difficulty has been hampered by the lack of controlled, scalable environments. Observed LLM shortcomings in long-horizon reasoning have raised the prospect that these shortcomings are fundamental to the autoregressive transformer architecture. We introduce ScaleLogic, a synthetic logical reasoning framework that offers independent control over two axes of difficulty: the depth of the required proof planning and the expressiveness of the underlying logic. Our proposed framework supports a wide range of logics: from simple implication-only logic towards more expressive first-order reasoning with conjunction, disjunction, negation, and universal quantification. Using this framework, we show that the RL training compute follows a power law with respect to reasoning depth, and that the scaling exponent increases monotonically with logical expressiveness. On downstream mathematics and general reasoning benchmarks, more expressive training settings yield both larger performance gains and more compute-efficient transfer compared to less expressive settings, demonstrating that what a model is trained on, not just how much it is trained, shapes downstream transfer. We further show that the power-law relationship holds across multiple RL methods, and curriculum-based training substantially improves scaling efficiency. More broadly, our results demonstrate that LLM shortcomings in long-horizon reasoning are not fundamental to the underlying architecture, and can be addressed by improved training methodology and data.

Abstract

Reinforcement learning (RL) has been applied to improve large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet the systematic study of how training scales with task difficulty has been hampered by the lack of controlled, scalable environments. Observed LLM shortcomings in long-horizon reasoning have raised the prospect that these shortcomings are fundamental to the autoregressive transformer architecture. We introduce ScaleLogic, a synthetic logical reasoning framework that offers independent control over two axes of difficulty: the depth of the required proof planning (i.e., the horizon) and the expressiveness of the underlying logic. Our proposed framework supports a wide range of logics: from simple implication-only logic ("if-then") towards more expressive first-order reasoning with conjunction ("and"), disjunction ("or"), negation ("not"), and universal quantification ("for all"). Using this framework, we show that the RL training compute $T$ follows a power law with respect to reasoning depth $D$ ($T \propto D^{\gamma}$, $R^{2} > 0.99$), and that the scaling exponent $\gamma$ increases monotonically with logical expressiveness, from $1.04$ to $2.60$. On downstream mathematics and general reasoning benchmarks, more expressive training settings yield both larger performance gains (up to $+10.66$ points) and more compute-efficient transfer compared to less expressive settings, demonstrating that what a model is trained on, not just how much it is trained, shapes downstream transfer. We further show that the power-law relationship holds across multiple RL methods, and curriculum-based training substantially improves scaling efficiency. More broadly, our results demonstrate that LLM shortcomings in long-horizon reasoning are not fundamental to the underlying architecture, and can be addressed by improved training methodology and data.

item.title: When No Benchmark Exists: Validating Comparative LLM Safety Scoring Without Ground-Truth Labels
item.author: Sushant Gautam, Finn Schwall, Annika Willoch Olstad, Fernando Vallecillos Ruiz, Birk Torpmann-Hagen, Sunniva Maria Stordal Bjørklund, Leon Moonen, Klas Pettersen, Michael A. Riegler
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出无基准比较安全评分方法，通过场景审计评估语言模型安全性，并验证了其有效性。

背景: 在相关语言、行业或监管制度缺乏标注基准的情况下，部署前需要比较候选语言模型的安全性。

目的: 形式化无基准比较安全评分设置，并指定基于场景的审计如何被解释为部署证据的合同。

方法: 使用工具效度链代替真实标签，包括对受控安全与擦除对比的响应性、目标驱动方差的主导性以及重运行期间的稳定性。在名为 SimpleAudit 的工具中实例化该方法，并在挪威安全包上进行验证。

主要发现: 在挪威安全包上，安全与擦除目标的分离度 AUROC 值在 0.89 到 1.00 之间；目标身份是主要方差成分（约 52%）；严重程度概况在十次重运行后稳定。挪威公共部门采购案例显示，更安全的模型取决于场景类别和风险度量。

结论: 差异主要源于链上游的声明-合同执行和部署适配。因此，必须报告分数、匹配的差值、关键率、不确定性以及使用的审计员和法官，而不是合并为单一排名。

翻译: 许多部署必须在相关语言、行业或监管制度存在标注基准之前，比较候选语言模型的安全性。我们将此设置形式化为无基准比较安全评分，并指定了基于场景的审计可被解释为部署证据的合同。分数仅在固定的场景包、评分细则、审计员、法官、采样配置和重运行预算下有效。由于没有可用标签，我们用工具效度链代替真实标签的一致性：对受控安全与擦除对比的响应性、目标驱动方差对审计员和法官伪影的主导性，以及重运行期间的稳定性。我们在 SimpleAudit 中实例化了该链，这是一个本地优先的评分工具，并在挪威安全包上进行了验证。安全与擦除目标的分离度 AUROC 值在 0.89 到 1.00 之间，目标身份是主要方差成分（约 52%），严重程度概况在十次重运行后稳定。将相同的链应用于 Petri 显示它支持这两种工具。重大差异源于链上游的声明-合同执行和部署适配。挪威公共部门采购案例比较了 Borealis 和 Gemma 3，展示了实际证据：更安全的模型取决于场景类别和风险度量。因此，分数、匹配的差值、关键率、不确定性以及使用的审计员和法官必须一起报告，而不是合并为单一排名。

Abstract

Many deployments must compare candidate language models for safety before a labeled benchmark exists for the relevant language, sector, or regulatory regime. We formalize this setting as benchmarkless comparative safety scoring and specify the contract under which a scenario-based audit can be interpreted as deployment evidence. Scores are valid only under a fixed scenario pack, rubric, auditor, judge, sampling configuration, and rerun budget. Because no labels are available, we replace ground-truth agreement with an instrumental-validity chain: responsiveness to a controlled safe-versus-abliterated contrast, dominance of target-driven variance over auditor and judge artifacts, and stability across reruns. We instantiate the chain in SimpleAudit, a local-first scoring instrument, and validate it on a Norwegian safety pack. Safe and abliterated targets separate with AUROC values between 0.89 and 1.00, target identity is the dominant variance component ($η^2 \approx 0.52$), and severity profiles stabilize by ten reruns. Applying the same chain to Petri shows that it admits both tools. The substantial differences arise upstream of the chain, in claim-contract enforcement and deployment fit. A Norwegian public-sector procurement case comparing Borealis and Gemma 3 demonstrates the resulting evidence in practice: the safer model depends on scenario category and risk measure. Consequently, scores, matched deltas, critical rates, uncertainty, and the auditor and judge used must be reported together rather than collapsed into a single ranking.

item.title: CASCADE: Case-Based Continual Adaptation for Large Language Models During Deployment
item.author: Guo, Siyuan, Du, Yali, Chen, Hechang, Chang, Yi, Wang, Jun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种部署时学习框架CASCADE，通过显式记忆机制使LLM在部署过程中无需修改参数即可通过经验持续改进。

背景: 现代大语言模型（LLM）的生命周期受限于训练与部署的刚性分离，部署后学习即停止，这与自然智能通过环境交互持续适应的特性形成对比。

目的: 将部署时学习（DTL）形式化为LLM生命周期的第三阶段，旨在使LLM智能体在部署过程中能够从经验中改进，无需修改模型参数。

方法: 提出CASCADE框架，为LLM智能体配备显式且不断演变的情景记忆，并将经验重用建模为上下文赌博机问题，以实现探索与利用的权衡。

主要发现: 在16个涵盖医疗诊断、法律分析、代码生成等多样化任务的测试中，CASCADE相比零样本提示提升了20.9%的宏平均成功率，并持续优于基于梯度和记忆的基线方法。

结论: 通过将部署重新定义为自适应学习过程，为持续改进AI系统奠定了基础。

翻译: Large language models (LLMs) have become a central foundation of modern artificial intelligence, yet their lifecycle remains constrained by a rigid separation between training and deployment, after which learning effectively ceases. This limitation contrasts with natural intelligence, which continually adapts through interaction with its environment. In this paper, we formalise deployment-time learning (DTL) as the third stage in the LLM lifecycle that enables LLM agents to improve from experience during deployment without modifying model parameters. We present CASCADE (CASe-based Continual Adaptation during DEployment), a general and principled framework that equips LLM agents with an explicit, evolving episodic memory. CASCADE formulates experience reuse as a contextual bandit problem, enabling principled exploration-exploitation trade-offs and establishing no-regret guarantees over long-term interactions. This design allows agents to accumulate, select, and refine task-relevant cases, transforming past experience into actionable knowledge. Across 16 diverse tasks spanning medical diagnosis, legal analysis, code generation, web search, tool use, and embodied interaction, CASCADE improves macro-averaged success rate by 20.9% over zero-shot prompting while consistently outperforming gradient-based and memory-based baselines. By reframing deployment as an adaptive learning process, this work establishes a foundation for continually improving AI systems.

Large language models (LLMs) have become a central foundation of modern artificial intelligence, yet their lifecycle remains constrained by a rigid separation between training and deployment, after which learning effectively ceases. This limitation contrasts with natural intelligence, which continually adapts through interaction with its environment. In this paper, we formalise deployment-time learning (DTL) as the third stage in the LLM lifecycle that enables LLM agents to improve from experience during deployment without modifying model parameters. item.title: From Storage to Experience: A Survey on the Evolution of LLM Agent Memory Mechanisms
item.author: Luo, Jinghao, Tian, Yuchen, Cao, Chuxue, Luo, Ziyang, Lin, Hongzhan, Li, Kaixin, Kong, Chuyi, Yang, Ruichao, Ma, Jing
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于大语言模型智能体记忆机制的新颖进化框架，将发展过程形式化为存储、反思和体验三个阶段，并分析了核心驱动力和机制。

背景: 大语言模型智能体通过集成外部工具和规划能力重塑了人工智能。虽然记忆机制已成为这些系统的架构基石，但当前研究在操作系统工程和认知科学之间分裂，阻碍了统一的技术综合和连贯的进化视角。

目的: 桥接当前研究的理论分歧，提出一种新颖的 LLM 智能体记忆机制进化框架，定义三个阶段，分析核心驱动力，探索机制，并提供设计原则和路线图。

方法: 提出新颖的进化框架，将发展过程形式化为存储、反思和体验三个阶段。分析三个核心驱动力：长程一致性的必要性、动态环境中的挑战以及持续学习的最终目标。探索前沿体验阶段的两个变革性机制：主动探索和跨轨迹抽象。

主要发现: 提出了包含存储、反思和体验三个阶段的进化框架。识别出三个核心驱动力：长程一致性的必要性、动态环境中的挑战以及持续学习的最终目标。发现了两个变革性机制：主动探索和跨轨迹抽象。

结论: 通过综合这些不同的观点，该工作提供了稳健的设计原则和下一代 LLM 智能体开发的清晰路线图。

翻译: 基于大语言模型的智能体通过集成外部工具和规划能力从根本上重塑了人工智能。虽然记忆机制已成为这些系统的架构基石，但当前研究仍然支离破碎，在操作系统工程和认知科学之间摇摆。这种理论分歧阻碍了对技术综合的统一观点和连贯的进化视角。为了弥合这一差距，本文提出了一种用于大语言模型智能体记忆机制的新颖进化框架，将发展过程形式化为三个阶段：存储（轨迹保存）、反思（轨迹精炼）和体验（轨迹抽象）。我们首先正式定义这三个阶段，然后分析这一进化的三个核心驱动力：长程一致性的必要性、动态环境中的挑战以及持续学习的最终目标。此外，我们特别探索了前沿体验阶段的两个变革性机制：主动探索和跨轨迹抽象。通过综合这些不同的观点，这项工作为下一代大语言模型智能体的发展提供了稳健的设计原则和清晰的路线图。

Abstract

Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have fundamentally reshaped artificial intelligence by integrating external tools and planning capabilities. While memory mechanisms have emerged as the architectural cornerstone of these systems, current research remains fragmented, oscillating between operating system engineering and cognitive science. This theoretical divide prevents a unified view of technological synthesis and a coherent evolutionary perspective. To bridge this gap, this survey proposes a novel evolutionary framework for LLM agent memory mechanisms, formalizing the development process into three stages: Storage (trajectory preservation), Reflection (trajectory refinement), and Experience (trajectory abstraction). We first formally define these three stages before analyzing the three core drivers of this evolution: the necessity for long-range consistency, the challenges in dynamic environments, and the ultimate goal of continual learning. Furthermore, we specifically explore two transformative mechanisms in the frontier Experience stage: proactive exploration and cross-trajectory abstraction. By synthesizing these disparate views, this work offers robust design principles and a clear roadmap for the development of next-generation LLM agents.

item.title: STDA-Net: Spectrogram-Based Domain Adaptation for cross-dataset Sleep Stage Classification
item.author: Unaza Tallal, Shruti Kshirsagar, Ankita Shukla
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于二维频谱图和对抗域适应的睡眠分期网络STDA-Net，在跨数据集任务中表现出优异的性能和稳定性。

背景: 跨数据集睡眠分期分类面临挑战，主要由于EEG通道配置、采样率、记录环境和受试人群的差异。现有方法多依赖一维EEG信号表示，而二维频谱图在无监督域适应框架中的应用尚未被充分探索。

目的: 提出STDA-Net框架，利用二维频谱图、CNN、BiLSTM和DANN进行特征提取、时间建模和域适应，旨在实现无需目标域标签的跨数据集睡眠分期。

方法: 结合CNN进行频谱图特征提取，BiLSTM模块进行睡眠动力学的时间建模，以及DANN进行源到目标的特征对齐，无需目标域标签。

主要发现: 在三个公开数据集上，平均准确率达到89.03%，平均宏F1分数达到87.64%，优于现有的1D基线方法，且具有更低的方差，表明稳定性和可重复性更高。

结论: 二维频谱图表示结合时间建模和对抗域适应，为跨数据集睡眠分期提供了稳健且具有竞争力的替代方案。

翻译: 跨数据集的准确睡眠分期分类仍然具有挑战性，这是由于EEG通道配置、采样率、记录环境和受试人群的变异性。尽管深度学习在自动睡眠分期方面显示出相当大的前景，但大多数现有的跨数据集方法依赖于一维EEG信号表示，而在无监督域适应框架中使用二维频谱图输入在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们提出了STDA-Net（基于频谱图的时间域适应网络），这是一个结合了用于基于频谱图的特征提取的卷积神经网络（CNN）、用于睡眠动力学时间建模的双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）模块，以及用于源到目标特征对齐的域对抗神经网络（DANN）的框架，无需在训练期间需要任何标记的目标域数据。在三个公开可用的数据集Sleep-EDF、SHHS-1和SHHS-2上进行了六个跨数据集传输设置的实验。结果表明，所提出的框架实现了89.03%的平均准确率和87.64%的平均宏F1分数，在平衡分类性能方面始终优于现有的1D基线方法，并且在五个独立运行中具有显著更低的方差，表明具有更高的稳定性和可重复性。总的来说，这些发现表明，2D频谱图表示，结合时间建模和对抗域适应，为跨数据集睡眠分期提供了稳健且具有竞争力的替代方案，以替代传统的1D EEG输入。

Abstract

Accurate sleep stage classification across datasets remains challenging due to variability in EEG channel montages, sampling rates, recording environments, and subject populations. Although deep learning has shown considerable promise for automated sleep staging, most existing cross-dataset methods rely on one-dimensional EEG signal representations, whereas the use of two-dimensional spectrogram-based inputs within an unsupervised domain adaptation framework has remained largely unexplored. Here, we propose STDA-Net (Spectrogram-based Temporal Domain Adaptation Network), a framework that combines a convolutional neural network (CNN) for spectrogram-based feature extraction, a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) module for temporal modeling of sleep dynamics, and a domain-adversarial neural network (DANN) for source-to-target feature alignment without requiring any labeled target-domain data during training. Experiments are conducted on three publicly available datasets Sleep-EDF, SHHS-1, and SHHS-2 under six cross-dataset transfer settings. Results show that the proposed framework achieves an average accuracy of 89.03% and an average macro F1-score of 87.64%, consistently outperforming existing 1D baseline methods in terms of balanced classification performance, with substantially lower variance across five independent runs, indicating improved stability and reproducibility. Overall, these findings demonstrate that 2D spectrogram-based representations, combined with temporal modeling and adversarial domain adaptation, provide a robust and competitive alternative to conventional 1D EEG inputs for cross-dataset sleep staging.

item.title: IntentGrasp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Intent Understanding
item.author: Yin, Yuwei, Li, Chuyuan, Carenini, Giuseppe
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了 IntentGrasp 基准测试，并提出了 Intentional Fine-Tuning (IFT) 方法来提升大语言模型的意图理解能力。

背景: 准确理解语音、对话和写作背后的意图对于开发有用的 LLM 助手至关重要。

目的: 评估大语言模型的意图理解能力，并提出方法以增强该能力。

方法: 构建了包含大规模训练集和两个评估集的 IntentGrasp 基准测试。提出了 Intentional Fine-Tuning (IFT) 方法，在训练集上对模型进行微调。

主要发现: 现有模型表现不理想，得分低于百分之六十。大多数模型在 Gem Set 上的表现甚至不如随机猜测。IFT 方法显著提升了模型性能。IFT 具有很强的跨领域泛化能力。

结论: 通过基准测试和 IFT 方法，该研究为开发更有意图、更强大且安全的 AI 助手指明了方向。

翻译: 准确理解语音、对话和写作背后的意图对于开发有用的 LLM 助手至关重要。本文介绍了 IntentGrasp，这是一个用于评估 LLM 意图理解能力的综合基准测试。IntentGrasp 源自四十九个高质量、开放许可的语料库，涵盖十二个不同领域，通过数据集筛选、意图标签上下文化和任务格式统一构建而成。它包含一个大规模训练集和两个评估集：包含一万二千九百零九个测试用例的 All Set 和包含四百七十个用例的更平衡且具有挑战性的 Gem Set。对二十个 LLM 的广泛评估表明，其表现不令人满意，在 All Set 上得分低于百分之六十，在 Gem Set 上得分低于百分之二十五。值得注意的是，二十个测试模型中有十七个在 Gem Set 上的表现甚至不如随机猜测基线，而估计的人类表现约为百分之八十一点一，显示出巨大的改进空间。为了增强这种能力，本文提出了 Intentional Fine-Tuning (IFT)，即在 IntentGrasp 的训练集上对模型进行微调，在 All Set 上获得了超过三十个 F1 分的提升，在 Gem Set 上获得了超过二十个分点的提升。值得注意的是，leave-one-domain-out 实验进一步证明了 IFT 的强跨领域泛化能力，验证了它是大幅提升 LLM 意图理解能力的有前途的方法。总的来说，通过基准测试和提升意图理解能力，本研究为人类利益和社会福祉开发更有意图、更强大且更安全的 AI 助手指明了有前途的道路。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Accurately understanding the intent behind speech, conversation, and writing is crucial to the development of helpful Large Language Model (LLM) assistants. This paper introduces IntentGrasp, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the intent understanding capability of LLMs. Derived from 49 high-quality, open-licensed corpora spanning 12 diverse domains, IntentGrasp is constructed through source datasets curation, intent label contextualization, and task format unification. IntentGrasp contains a large-scale training set of 262,759 instances and two evaluation sets: an All Set of 12,909 test cases and a more balanced and challenging Gem Set of 470 cases. Extensive evaluations on 20 LLMs across 7 families (including frontier models such as GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and Claude-Opus-4.7) demonstrate unsatisfactory performance, with scores below 60% on All Set and below 25% on Gem set. Notably, 17 out of 20 tested models perform worse than a random-guess baseline (15.2%) on Gem Set, while the estimated human performance is ~81.1%, showing substantial room for improvement. To enhance such ability, this paper proposes Intentional Fine-Tuning (IFT), which fine-tunes the models on the training set in IntentGrasp, yielding significant gains of 30+ F1 points on All Set and 20+ points on Gem Set. Tellingly, the leave-one-domain-out (Lodo) experiments further demonstrate the strong cross-domain generalizability of IFT, verifying that it is a promising approach to substantially enhancing the intent understanding of LLMs. Overall, by benchmarking and boosting intent understanding ability, this study sheds light on a promising path towards more intentional, capable, and safe AI assistants for human benefits and social good.

item.title: Knowledge Transfer Scaling Laws for 3D Medical Imaging
item.author: Ho Hin Lee, Dongna Du, Chu Wang, Yuankai Huo, Shi Gu, James C. Gee, Yifan Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于缩放律的数据分配方法，通过识别‘枢纽-岛屿’结构来优化3D医学图像的预训练，显著提升了模型性能。

背景: 视觉基础模型正从2D向3D医学成像扩展，跨模态统一预训练对临床任务有价值，但当前混合策略缺乏理论依据。

目的: 解决异构医学成像域混合训练中的数据分配问题，提高预训练模型在临床任务中的表现。

方法: 基于对域间知识转移不对称性和幂律趋势的观察，将数据分配制定为缩放律优化问题。

主要发现: 不同医学成像域在预训练中缩放速率不同，知识转移具有不对称性；数据分配呈现出可解释的‘枢纽-岛屿’结构。

结论: 转移感知的数据分配策略优于传统的数据比例采样，泛化能力强，且在下游任务中提供了更强的预训练表示。

翻译: 视觉基础模型正越来越多地超越2D领域，进入3D医学成像等体素域，其中跨不同成像模态（即CT、MRI和PET）的统一预训练可以为多样化的临床任务提供基础模型。然而，训练此类模型需要混合异构成像域，而当前的混合策略在很大程度上仍然是启发式的。在这项工作中，我们观察到不同的医学成像域在预训练期间以不同的速率缩放，域之间的知识转移具有很强的不对称性：在一个域上训练可以显著改善另一个域，但反过来可能要弱得多。有趣的是，MAE重建损失和跨域转移都遵循具有域特定行为的可预测幂律趋势。受这些发现的启发，我们将数据分配制定为缩放律优化问题。推导出的分配揭示了可解释的枢纽和岛屿结构：高可转移域作为枢纽出现，使许多其他域受益并值得战略分配，而孤立域作为岛屿，需要直接投资。经验上，转移感知的分配比数据比例采样高出多达58%，并且能很好地泛化到未见过的预算，相关系数为0.989。在疾病分类和器官/病变分割上的下游验证进一步证实，推导出的转移感知混合为临床3D医学成像任务提供了更强的预训练表示。

Abstract

Vision foundation models are increasingly moving beyond 2D to volumetric domains such as 3D medical imaging, where unified pretraining across different imaging modalities (i.e. CT, MRI, and PET) could provide foundational models for diverse clinical tasks. However, training such models requires mixing heterogeneous imaging domains, and current mixture strategies remain largely heuristic. In this work, we observe that different medical imaging domains scale at variable rates during pretraining, and knowledge transfer between domains is strongly asymmetric: training on one domain can substantially improve another, but the reverse may be much weaker. Interestingly, both MAE reconstruction loss and cross-domain transfer follow predictable power-law trends with domain-specific behaviors. Motivated by these findings, we formulate data allocation as a scaling-law optimization problem. The derived allocations reveal an interpretable hub-and-island structure: highly transferable domains emerge as hubs that benefit many others and deserve strategic allocation, while isolated domains act as islands requiring direct investment. Empirically, transfer-aware allocation outperforms data-proportional sampling by up to 58% and generalizes well to unseen budgets with r=0.989. Downstream validation on disease classification and organ/lesion segmentation further confirms that the derived transfer-aware mixtures provide stronger pretrained representations for clinical 3D medical imaging tasks.

item.title: Bi3: A Biplatform, Bicultural, Biperson Dataset for Social Robot Navigation
item.author: Andrew Stratton, Phani Teja Singamaneni, Pranav Goyal, Rachid Alami, Christoforos Mavrogiannis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Bi3 是一个关于社交机器人在受限实验室空间内与人群进行导航的数据集。

背景: 现有的社交机器人导航数据收集工作存在差异，Bi3 在实验设计、算法、平台和参与者多样性上具有独特性。

目的: 提供一个具有独特多样性和建模复杂性的基准数据集，以促进对人类和机器人在受限环境中协作的理解，并支持密集拥挤空间中的导航模型训练。

方法: 包含产生近距离遭遇的原始实验设计、5种导航算法、2种机器人平台、74名来自美国和法国的参与者，以及包含10.5小时运动轨迹、RGB视频和用户印象的多模态数据流。

主要发现: 通过交互密度和人类速度等指标分析，Bi3 展示了独特多样性和建模复杂性。

结论: Bi3 有助于理解人类与机器人在受限环境中的协作，并可作为训练密集拥挤空间中导航模型和机器人控制策略的资源。

翻译: We contribute Bi3, a dataset of social robot navigation among groups of people in a constrained lab space. Compared to prior data collection efforts for social robot navigation, our dataset is unique in that it features: an original experiment design giving rise to close navigation encounters between two humans and a robot; five different navigation algorithms; two different robot platforms; a diverse participant pool of 74 people recruited from two sites in the USA and France; multimodal data streams including 10.5 hours of human and robot ground-truth motion tracks, RGB video, and user impressions over robot performance. Our analysis of the collected dataset through metrics like interaction density and human velocity suggests that Bi3 represents a benchmark of unique diversity and modeling complexity. Bi3 contributes towards understanding how humans and robots can productively mesh their activities in constrained environments, and can be a resource for training models of human motion prediction and robot control policies for navigation in densely crowded spaces.

Abstract

We contribute Bi3, a dataset of social robot navigation among groups of people in a constrained lab space. Compared to prior data collection efforts for social robot navigation, our dataset is unique in that it features: an original experiment design giving rise to close navigation encounters between two humans and a robot; five different navigation algorithms; two different robot platforms; a diverse participant pool of 74 people recruited from two sites in the USA and France; multimodal data streams including 10.5 hours of human and robot ground-truth motion tracks, RGB video, and user impressions over robot performance. Our analysis of the collected dataset through metrics like interaction density and human velocity suggests that Bi3 represents a benchmark of unique diversity and modeling complexity. Bi3 contributes towards understanding how humans and robots can productively mesh their activities in constrained environments, and can be a resource for training models of human motion prediction and robot control policies for navigation in densely crowded spaces.

item.title: One Operator for Many Densities: Amortized Approximation of Conditioning by Neural Operators
item.author: Panos Tsimpos, Edoardo Calvello, Ayoub Belhadji, Nicholas H. Nelsen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出通过识别一个将联合密度映射到条件密度的算子来解决概率条件化问题，该算子可用神经网络算子近似。

背景: 概率条件化是科学和工程应用中建模不确定性的关键，传统机器学习方法通常针对固定的联合分布直接学习条件分布。

目的: 引入新视角，通过识别单个算子来求解条件化问题，从而对联合-条件对进行摊销。

方法: 提出将条件化算子近似为神经网络算子，基于新的连续性结果进行证明，并使用神经网络算子学习高斯混合类的条件化映射。

主要发现: 条件化算子可以用神经网络算子以任意精度近似；证明了条件化算子在合适的密度类上的连续性。

结论: 为通用、摊销的概率条件化方法（如贝叶斯推理的基础模型）提供了理论基础。

翻译: 概率条件化关注的是在给定一个随机变量的情况下确定另一个随机变量的分布。它是科学和工程应用中的关键，在这些应用中建模不确定性至关重要。这个问题在机器学习中传统上通过直接学习固定联合分布的条件分布来解决。本文引入了一个新视角：我们提出通过识别单个算子来解决条件化问题，该算子将任何联合密度映射到其条件密度，从而对联合-条件对进行摊销。我们证明了条件化算子可以用神经网络算子以任意精度近似。我们的证明依赖于新的结果，即建立了条件化算子在合适的密度类上的连续性。最后，我们使用神经网络算子学习了一类高斯混合的条件化映射，展示了我们框架的潜力。这项工作为通用、摊销的概率条件化方法（如贝叶斯推理的基础模型）提供了理论基础。

Abstract

Probabilistic conditioning is concerned with the identification of a distribution of a random variable $X$ given a random variable $Y$. It is a cornerstone of scientific and engineering applications where modeling uncertainty is key. This problem has traditionally been addressed in machine learning by directly learning the conditional distribution of a fixed joint distribution. This paper introduces a novel perspective: we propose to solve the conditioning problem by identifying a single operator that maps any joint density to its conditional, thus amortizing over joint-conditional pairs. We establish that the conditioning operator can be approximated to arbitrary accuracy by neural operators. Our proof relies on new results establishing continuity of the conditioning operator over suitable classes of densities. Finally, we learn the conditioning map for a class of Gaussian mixtures using neural operators, illustrating the promise of our framework. This work provides the theoretical underpinnings for general-purpose, amortized methods for probabilistic conditioning, such as foundation models for Bayesian inference.

item.title: A$^2$RD: Agentic Autoregressive Diffusion for Long Video Consistency
item.author: Long, Do Xuan, Song, Yale, Kan, Min-Yen, Pfister, Tomas, Le, Long T.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为A2RD的架构，用于解决长视频合成中的语义漂移和叙事崩溃问题，通过自回归扩散模型实现长视频的一致性和连贯性合成。

背景: 长视频合成仍是一个基本挑战，现有方法在长跨度下容易出现语义漂移和叙事崩溃。

目的: 提出一种能够合成一致且连贯的长视频的方法，将创意合成与一致性约束解耦。

方法: 提出了A2RD架构，将长视频合成视为一个闭环过程，通过检索、合成、细化和更新循环逐段合成和自我改进。包含三个核心组件：多模态视频记忆、自适应分段生成和分层测试时自我改进。

主要发现: 在公共和LVBench-C基准测试（1到10分钟视频）上，A2RD在一致性上比最先进基线高出最多30%，在叙事连贯性上高出20%。人类评估证实了这些改进，并突出了运动和过渡平滑度的显著提升。

结论: A2RD在长视频合成任务中表现优异，显著提升了视频的一致性、叙事连贯性以及运动和过渡的平滑度。

翻译: 合成一致且连贯的长视频仍然是一个基本挑战。现有方法在长跨度下容易出现语义漂移和叙事崩溃。我们提出了A2RD，一种代理自回归扩散架构，将创意合成与一致性约束解耦。A2RD将长视频合成制定为一个闭环过程，通过检索、合成、细化和更新循环逐段合成和自我改进视频。它包含三个核心组件：跨模态跟踪视频进度的多模态视频记忆；在生成模式间切换以实现自然进展和视觉一致性的自适应分段生成；以及在帧和视频级别自我改进每个分段以防止错误传播的分层测试时自我改进。我们进一步引入了LVBench-C，这是一个具有非线性实体和环境转换的具有挑战性的基准，用于对长跨度一致性进行压力测试。在跨越一到十分钟视频的公共和LVBench-C基准测试上，A2RD在最先进基线的一致性上高出最多30%，在叙事连贯性上高出20%。人类评估证实了这些收益，同时也突出了运动和过渡平滑度的显著改进。
